scripts.text:
[Nihil]
Now I can see you.
I've been waiting for a good while.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
現在能見到你了。
我等你很久了。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
There is something important.
Actually, there is much to be said by the esteemed daughter of Nerius.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
有件重要的事要談。
實際上，內裡烏斯家族的千金也有很多話想說。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Yes, right. Spica is now investigating several things.
That's why I look like this again.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
是啊，沒錯。斯皮卡正在調查幾件事。
所以我才又變回了這副模樣。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Actually, there is another task that Spica gave Crux during the banquet.
And Crux seems to have done it very well.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
其實宴會期間，斯皮卡還交給克魯克斯另一項任務。
而克魯克斯似乎完成得很出色。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
I heard about recently.
Spica told Crux to investigate the maid who gave me a glass with a drug during the banquet the other day.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
我最近聽說了這件事。
斯皮卡讓克魯克斯調查那個在宴會上給我下藥的女僕。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Spica is so sharp in those things.
After all, she put me in this position as her substitute and is doing what she has to do.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
斯皮卡在這種事上很敏銳。
畢竟，她讓我代替她站在這個位置上，自己則去處理該做的事。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
She told us to wait for her. She said she would bring us some good news.
Since there are eyes everywhere, she told me to go to the Hero's Room.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
她讓我們等她，說會帶來好訊息。
因為到處都有眼線，她讓我去英雄的房間。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
That's why we had to come here unwillingly without talking to you in advance.
Sorry for your inconvenience. Please wait for a while.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
所以我們才沒能提前通知你，就不得不直接過來。
抱歉給你添麻煩了，請稍等。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
Maybe we should listen to her first.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
也許我們該先聽聽她怎麼說。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
As I told you before, you are the freest person among us.
So I am requesting you.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
正如我之前所說，你是我們當中最能自由行動的人。
所以我想拜託你。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
^4d4dffBruno^000000.. His destination must be ^4d4dffLighthalzen^000000.
Although it's my guess, I'm quite sure of it.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
^4d4dff布魯諾^000000...他的目的地一定是^4d4dff裡希塔樂鎮^000000。
雖然只是推測，但我很有把握。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
He doesn't go to the Schwaltzvalt area even though he has an airship.
... He knows that he can be tracked.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
他有飛空艇，卻不去施瓦茨瓦爾特地區。
...他知道這樣會暴露行蹤。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
So you have to ^4d4dffmeet Crux^000000 at ^4d4dffLighthalzen Airport^000000. Then you have to narrow the range based upon the points that Crux has already investigated.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
所以你要在^4d4dff裡希塔樂鎮機場^000000與^4d4dff克魯克斯會合^000000。然後根據克魯克斯已經調查的地點縮小範圍。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
Not many of us can move freely. So we are asking you to take this task.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
我們當中能自由行動的人不多，所以這件事得拜託你了。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
Skia is coming with you. She will be very helpful.
The Nerius family has great skill with swords.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
斯基亞會和你同行，她會幫上大忙。
內裡烏斯家族的劍術很出色。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
I am counting on you.
You go separately and ^4d4dffmeet Crux and Skia at Lighthalzen Airport^000000.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
拜託你了。
請單獨行動，在^4d4dff裡希塔樂鎮機場與克魯克斯和斯基亞會合^000000。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
I look forward to hearing good news from you.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
我期待聽到你的好訊息。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
See you at ^4d4dffLighthalzen Airport^000000, hero!
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
在^4d4dff裡希塔樂鎮機場^000000見，英雄！

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Now, please excuse me.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
現在，請原諒我失陪了。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
Welcome. We have been talking about it already.
We are sorry about it.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
歡迎。我們剛才一直在談這件事。
抱歉讓你久等了。

scripts.text: We don't need so much formality between us ...
scripts.translation: 我們之間不用這麼拘謹...

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
Can we talk freely?
Thanks.
It's my pleasure.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
我們可以坦誠地聊聊嗎？
謝謝你。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
This is what I like about you.
Being able share confidences without sticking to formality is important.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
這就是我欣賞你的地方。
能拋開禮節、坦誠交流很重要。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
By the way, let's talk about Bruno. How long do we have to proceed confidentially?
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
對了，談談布魯諾吧。我們還要保密多久？

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
I'm sure the daughter of the Nerius family knows more about it than I do.
We must make a definite plan to resolve the situation.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
我相信內裡烏斯家族的千金比我更瞭解情況。
我們必須制定明確的計劃來解決這件事。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
Everyone here knows that an Enterprise is behind him.
But he is outwardly innocent.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
這裡的人都知道他背後有企業撐腰。
但表面上，他看起來毫無嫌疑。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
That's why we are being swayed by him.
In my opinion, we'd better make a plan to track the whereabouts of the stolen ^4d4dffTerra Gloria^000000 and reclaim it.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
所以我們才會被他牽著鼻子走。
我認為應該設法追查被盜的^4d4dff泰拉格洛麗亞^000000，並將其奪回。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
For that reason, it will be interesting.
This Bruno guy will give you a fresh insight.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
這事會很有意思。
布魯諾會給你帶來新的線索。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
How can you be so sure?
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
你怎麼能這麼確定？

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Because I trust Crux.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
因為我信任克魯克斯。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
Sorry I'm late.
I found out a lot about Bruno.
scripts.translation:
[克魯克斯]
抱歉來晚了。
我查到了不少關於布魯諾的情報。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
During the extradition procedure, I had to receive a little help from the Schwaltzvalt government.
scripts.translation:
[克魯克斯]
引渡過程中，我不得不向施瓦茨瓦爾特政府尋求一些協助。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
It was due to my position, and I am not a free adventurer ... Lady Skia handled it quite well for me ...
scripts.translation:
[克魯克斯]
這是職位所限，畢竟我不是能自由行動的冒險者...斯基亞女士替我處理得很好...

scripts.text:
[Crux]
There was an unexpected bonus.
I managed to get detailed data about the man and got a confession without making much fuss.
scripts.translation:
[克魯克斯]
還有個意外收穫：我拿到了那個人的詳細資料，也讓他在沒鬧出大動靜的情況下招了供。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
I think it was possible because we convinced both sides that we would guarantee their security.
scripts.translation:
[克魯克斯]
我想是因為我們讓雙方都相信，我們會保障他們的安全。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
I passed some of the unimportant details of the man's confession to the Schwartz government. Also, I handed Bruno to Schwartz.
scripts.translation:
[克魯克斯]
我把那個人供詞中不重要的部分透露給了施瓦茨瓦爾特政府，也把布魯諾交給了他們。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
That's good.
After all, he would have been a burden to us even if we kept him.
So, the important information is ...
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
那就好。
反正就算留著他，對我們也只是個累贅。
那麼，重要的情報是...

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
... It must be about a certain facility.
I mean, from the details on your report.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
...應該是關於某個設施。
我是根據你的報告判斷的。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
... Considering the political situation of Schwaltzvalt ...
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
...再考慮到施瓦茨瓦爾特的政治局勢...

scripts.text: President?
scripts.translation: 總統？

scripts.text: Can we escape the Enterprise's attention?
scripts.translation: 我們能避開企業的耳目嗎？

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
It's not an easy job to inspect a facility in another country as part of the royal family's affair.
We cannot ask other families and leaders for cooperation yet.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
以王室事務為由調查他國設施，並不容易。
我們暫時還不能請求其他家族和領袖協助。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
Lady Spica. I believe you have already prepared a strategy.
The fact that Skia isn't here today might have something to do with your plan ...
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
斯皮卡小姐，我想你已經準備好對策了。
斯基亞今天不在場，應該也和你的計劃有關...

scripts.text:
[Spica]
I guess public approval is not something we can count on.
You are right. I sent Skia on another task.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
看來我們不能指望公眾支援。
你說得對，我派斯基亞去執行另一項任務了。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Prince Nihil. As you predicted, now we have to secure help from the Schwartz government.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
尼希爾王子，正如你所料，我們現在必須爭取施瓦茨瓦爾特政府的協助。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
And the Schwartz government knows of this as a private but important matter of the royal family of Nerius. That's because Skia made up a good story when delivering Bruno to Schwartz.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
施瓦茨瓦爾特政府知道，這是內裡烏斯家族一項私下進行卻至關重要的事務。
斯基亞把布魯諾交給他們時，編了個不錯的說辭。

scripts.text: What was it?
scripts.translation: 是什麼？

scripts.text:
[Spica]
{0}.
Since you are playing an important role, you need to know it as well.
Something extremely important to our family has been stolen.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
{0}。
既然你也參與其中，就應該知道詳情。
我們家族有件極其重要的東西被盜了。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Currently, that important thing is said to be located in a suspicious facility. Now we have to investigate it.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
據說那件重要物品如今就在一處可疑設施裡。我們必須調查那裡。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
To investigate the facility, we need permission from the Schwartz government.
Outwardly, the Nerius family is the concerned party. That's why Skia is there now.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
調查那處設施需要施瓦茨瓦爾特政府批准。
明面上，內裡烏斯家族是相關方，所以斯基亞現在正在那裡交涉。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
We need more help.
Crux must report quickly. He will be busy again.
......
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
我們還需要更多人手。
克魯克斯得儘快回來報告，他馬上又要忙起來了。
...

scripts.text:
[Spica]
I see.
Crux must go to Skia immediately.
And I must go to Yuno.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
我明白了。
克魯克斯必須立刻去找斯基亞。
我則要去尤諾。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
Then you will borrow the name of the Nerius family.
In any case, I will try to do the best in my position.
And for the hands we lack ...
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
那麼，你們就以內裡烏斯家族的名義行動。
無論如何，我會盡力做好分內之事。
至於缺少的人手...

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
{0}.
I feel so lucky that you are with us.
Please escort Miss Spica.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
{0}。
有你和我們一起行動，我很慶幸。
請護送斯皮卡小姐。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
Escorting is not so difficult.
Your job is to wait until Miss Spica completes her task and bring her back safely.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
護送的任務並不複雜。
你只要等斯皮卡小姐辦完事，再安全地護送她回來。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
... I'm counting on you for Miss Spica.
Then I will go to Yuno now.
scripts.translation:
[克魯克斯]
...斯皮卡小姐就拜託你了。
我現在去尤諾。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
Now we have the big picture.
It depends on how the Schwartz government reacts to us.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
現在我們已經掌握了大致情況。
接下來要看施瓦茨瓦爾特政府如何回應。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
For that issue, please trust the next leader of the Nerius family.
Then {0}, you come to ^4d4dffYuno Airport^000000.
We will continue our conversation there.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
這件事就交給內裡烏斯家族的下一任領袖處理吧。
{0}，請到^4d4dff尤諾機場^000000來。
我們在那裡繼續談。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Let me speak plainly.
This is becoming more serious that we expected.
Crux did a wonderful job, so I thought we almost got them.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
我就直說了。
情況比我們預想的嚴重。
克魯克斯做得很好，我原以為我們快要得手了。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
But they are not so stupid.
Crux struggled to find the suspicious chamberlain who you saw at first.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
但他們也沒那麼好糊弄。
克魯克斯費了好大勁，才找到你最初見到的那個可疑侍從長。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
But the maid who passed the glass was easily found.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
但那個遞酒杯的女僕很快就查出來了。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
She had been ordered to recommend a drink to the son of the Heine family. Someone told her that it was his favorite drink.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
有人命令她給海爾內家的兒子推薦一種飲料，還告訴她那是他最喜歡的飲料。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
And you haven't found any special clues?
You have no more to investigate. Why did you come alone without Crux?
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
你沒查到什麼特別的線索嗎？
既然沒有更多線索可查，為什麼沒和克魯克斯一起來？

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Well, not really.
I got a clue about the chamberlain who gave the drink to the maid. His hometown is Schwaltzvalt.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
也不算完全沒有。
我查到那個把飲料交給女僕的侍從長來自施瓦茨瓦爾特。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Crux has left to find that man.
He keeps me updated on his current location. He has now passed Yuno.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
克魯克斯已經去找那個人了。
他一直向我報告行蹤，現在已經過了尤諾。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
If that man is from Schwaltzvalt, this is not going to be easy.
In particular, the royal family should not take an official action.
We cannot officially announce this situation either.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
如果那個人來自施瓦茨瓦爾特，事情就棘手了。
尤其王室不能公開採取行動，
也不能正式公佈這件事。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
The leaders of other families already know about the chamberlain. And, they called a conference to discuss how to handle that issue.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
其他家族的領袖已經知道侍從長的事。他們召開會議，商量該如何處理。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
I have been in the conference so far. Seems like every family has a different idea.
So I decided to do as I wish.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
我一直在參加會議。看來各家族都有不同的想法。
所以我決定按自己的方式行動。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
The problem is where that chamberlain is headed. Regardless of his final destination, it will be quite tough for Crux alone.
{0}, could you please go for backup?
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
問題是侍從長正前往何處。無論他最終去哪兒，只靠克魯克斯一個人都很棘手。
{0}，可以請你去支援他嗎？

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Then let me go too.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
那我也去吧。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
As you wish.
This is the report from Crux.
I don't like outside missions. So I will just stick to my room. Hahaha ...
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
隨你吧。
這是克魯克斯的報告。
我不喜歡外出任務，就待在房間裡好了。哈哈哈...

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
... You are helping us so much.
Thanks a lot.
But why are you so eager to help us?
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
...你幫了我們這麼多。
非常感謝。
不過，你為什麼這麼熱心地幫我們？

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Hmm, I find it interesting.
And I think a change is needed.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
嗯，我覺得這很有趣。
而且我覺得需要改變一下。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Soon, our day will come.
And I find it stuffy.
The unusual obsession of the Heine family ...
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
我們的時代很快就要到來了。
不過，海爾內家族那種異乎尋常的執著，真讓人喘不過氣...

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Well, let me stop here.
If I continue, it will be too rude of me.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
好了，我就說到這裡。
如果繼續說下去，就太失禮了。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
... But you look quite happy.
Whatever. We will talk about more details of the story later.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
...不過你看起來倒是很開心。
算了，之後再詳細談吧。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
I handed part of Crux's report to Prince Nihil.
For your schedule from now on, you'll have to talk to Prince Nihil.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
我把克魯克斯報告的一部分交給了尼希爾王子。
你接下來的安排，去和尼希爾王子談吧。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
I look forward to hearing good news from you.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
我期待聽到你的好訊息。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
See you at ^4d4dffLighthalzen Airport^000000, hero!
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
英雄，我們在^4d4dff裡希塔樂鎮機場^000000見！

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Now, please excuse me.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
現在，請原諒我失陪了。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Welcome!
Sorry for having entered the room while the owner was not present.
But I had nothing to do.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
歡迎！
抱歉趁房間主人不在時擅自進來了。
我實在閒得無聊。

scripts.text: What about others?
scripts.translation: 其他人呢？

scripts.text:
[Skia]
I reclaimed the Blessing Star.
There was a conference.
Nihil and Spica participated.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
我把祝福之星拿回來了。
之前開過一次會，尼希爾和斯皮卡都參加了。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Now I feel like everything is back to normal.
The recent tasks have been so wonderful and interesting.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
現在總算覺得一切恢復正常了。
最近這些任務又精彩又有趣。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
... I had always been operating in the shadows behind Spica's back.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
...我一直在暗中替斯皮卡辦事。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
If my mother finds out about this, she will be quite upset.
My father will be concerned. But he will tell me it's okay, as usual.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
要是母親知道了，她肯定會很生氣。
父親會擔心，不過他還是會像往常一樣說沒關係。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
....
By the way, hero.
I think I am unwell lately.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
...
對了，英雄。
我最近覺得身體不太舒服。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
I occasionally have a shooting pain near my heart. And my heart beats faster than usual. Sometimes I become hot even though I don't have a fever.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
我偶爾會覺得心口一陣刺痛，心跳也比平時快。有時明明沒發燒，身體卻會發熱。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Is this because I didn't have enough training due to the banquets? There might be a problem with my health.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
是不是因為宴會太多，訓練不夠？我的身體該不會出問題了吧？

scripts.text: Do you feel it all the time?
scripts.translation: 你一直都有這種感覺嗎？

scripts.text: When is it most serious?
scripts.translation: 什麼時候最嚴重？

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Not always ...
Recently ... Oh! It was when I was waiting for the adventurer at the Einbroch hotel ...
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
不是一直這樣...
最近...啊！是在艾音布羅克的旅館等那位冒險者時...

scripts.text:
[Skia]
When I asked him whether I could use the Scroll of Movement ...
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
當我問他能不能使用移動卷軸時...

scripts.text:
[Skia]
When he told me to wait for a while in this room ...
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
當他讓我在這間房裡等一會兒時...

scripts.text: Who told you to wait?
scripts.translation: 誰讓你等的？

scripts.text:
[Skia]
It was Nihil. He said he would come after finishing everything.
...
Ah! My heart is beating fast again!
What's wrong with me ...
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
是尼希爾。他說處理完事情就會過來。
...
啊！我的心跳又加快了！
我到底怎麼了...

scripts.text: ... A heart disease.
scripts.translation: ...是心臟病

scripts.text: Perhaps it's love?
scripts.translation: 該不會是戀愛了吧？

scripts.text:
[Spica]
... What? A heart disease?
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
...什麼？心臟病？

scripts.text:
[Spica]
... Love??
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
...戀愛？？

scripts.text: Skia told Spica about her symptoms.
scripts.translation: 斯基亞向斯皮卡講述了自己的症狀。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Oh my god! Skia!
What do you like about Prince Nihil?
Is it his handsome face?
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
天哪，斯基亞！
你喜歡尼希爾王子的什麼？
是他那張英俊的臉嗎？

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Oh, what?
Why do you keep mentioning Nihil?
The hero asked me the same thing ...
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
啊？什麼？
你怎麼老提尼希爾？
英雄也問過我同樣的問題...

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Come on, my sister.
What you mentioned so far were the moments when you were with Prince Nihil.
................
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
拜託，姐姐。
你剛才說的全都是和尼希爾王子在一起時發生的事。
...

scripts.text:
[Spica]
As I expected ............
Let's talk about this later.
Oh ... You will be in trouble once my mother knows this.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
果然如此...
這件事以後再談。
啊...要是讓母親知道，你可就慘了。

scripts.text:
[Bel]
Prince Grantz has arrived.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾]
格蘭茨王子到了。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
Hmm. The esteemed daughters of the Nerius family are here too.
First of all, {0} I have come to show my gratitude to you.
scripts.translation:
[克羅內克]
嗯，內裡烏斯家的千金們也在。
首先，{0}，我是來向你道謝的。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
Thanks to your support, we kept the tradition of our royal family. And we avoided the dirty tricks of malicious people.
scripts.translation:
[克羅內克]
多虧了你們，我們保住了皇室傳統，也挫敗了那些心懷惡意之人的詭計。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
It is true that Nihil overstepped his place during the process. But we removed the dishonor on our family.
scripts.translation:
[克羅內克]
尼希爾在過程中確實有些越權，不過我們總算洗刷了家族的恥辱。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Prince, didn't we finish the discussion in the conference?
Thanks to the Prince, you have gained an advantage in the trade with the Schwaltzvalt government.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
王子殿下，我們在會議上不是已經談妥了嗎？
多虧了您，我們在與施瓦茨瓦爾特政府的貿易談判中佔了上風。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
... Right.
Although Fritz and I were involved, Nihil did quite a good job in terms of domestic affairs.
scripts.translation:
[克羅內克]
...是啊。
雖然弗裡茨和我也參與了，但尼希爾處理內政確實做得不錯。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Prince. You still don't want to accept him. Do you?
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
王子殿下。您還是不想接納他，是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
It is not true.
I also learned a lot during this event.
It was an unexpected result.
scripts.translation:
[克羅內克]
不是那樣的。
這次的事也讓我學到了很多。
結果出乎我的意料。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
On second thought, I didn't give any opportunity to Nihil. And he may have been sad about it.
... Anyhow ... He must have.
scripts.translation:
[克羅內克]
仔細想想，我從沒給過尼希爾機會。他大概因此很難過吧。
...總之...他一定是這麼想的。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
Thanks to this event, the Heine family learned a lot.
All we hope now is for Peter, who is in the hospital, to wake up.
scripts.translation:
[克羅內克]
這次的事讓海爾內家族學到了很多。
現在只希望住院的彼得能醒過來。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
Hmm, let me stop talking about private stuff.
I have {0} come to compensate
scripts.translation:
[克羅內克]
嗯，私事就說到這裡吧。
我帶了{0}來作為補償。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
This might be a small reward considering what you have done for us.
... But please take it.
scripts.translation:
[克羅內克]
和你為我們做的一切相比，這點謝禮微不足道...
不過請收下。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
You can continue to enjoy everything you did as a guest. We have agreed on it.
As you always have shown us honest faith.
scripts.translation:
[克羅內克]
我們已經說好了，你們可以繼續享受貴賓待遇。
畢竟你們一直真誠地信任我們。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
Then I will let you young people enjoy the conversation.
See you later.
scripts.translation:
[克羅內克]
那我就不打擾你們年輕人聊天了。
回頭見。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
See you later. I will contact you.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
回見。我會聯絡你的。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Skia?
Why don't you have a quiet conversation with me?
{0} seems like most things are arranged. Now I will leave with my poor sister.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
斯基亞？
要不要和我單獨聊聊？
{0}，看來事情大多安排妥當了。我先帶我可憐的姐姐離開。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Ah ... Hero.
Next time, please visit the Nerius family again!
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
啊...英雄。
下次再來內裡烏斯家做客吧！

scripts.text:
[Spica]
By the way, I received a letter from ^4d4dffPhilopontess^000000.
He told you to visit him at ^4d4dffWerner Laboratory Entrance^000000. Don't forget to visit him.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
對了，我收到了^4d4dff菲洛龐特斯^000000的信。
他請你去^4d4dff維爾納實驗室入口^000000找他，別忘了。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
I don't know why he used me as a contact point. What a brave young man.
I will see you later.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
不知道他為什麼讓我當聯絡人，真是個勇敢的年輕人。
回頭見。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
Oh, hello.
Nice to meet you here.
Me? I am just doing the task the Lady gave me.
scripts.translation:
[克魯克斯]
哦，你好。
很高興在這裡見到你。
我？我只是在執行女士交代的任務。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
Ah, have you arrived?
Have you come alone?
I heard Skia was coming too ...
scripts.translation:
[克魯克斯]
啊，你到了？
你是一個人來的嗎？
我聽說斯基亞也會來...

scripts.text:
[Crux]
Oh! You've arrived.
The Prince of the Heine family ordered me, so I came to Lighthalzen. Do you think that man will show up?
scripts.translation:
[克魯克斯]
哦，你到了。
海爾內家的王子命我來裡希塔樂鎮。你覺得那個人會露面嗎？

scripts.text:
[Skia]
I think he will.
That man who used to be a chamberlain ... Didn't you write on the report that he was trying to contact someone?
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
我想會的。
那個曾經當過侍從長的人...你不是在報告裡說，他想聯絡某個人嗎？

scripts.text:
[Crux]
Yes. I did.
I thought he was seeking the person behind the chamberlain.
He was also asking for more payment.
scripts.translation:
[克魯克斯]
是的。
我以為他是在找侍從長背後的人。
他還要求加錢。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
According to Nihil, the person behind the chamberlain is likely to be in Lighthalzen.
Here or Einbroch. But Nihil said those guys would probably hate a city full of smoke.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
尼希爾認為，侍從長背後的人很可能就在裡希塔樂鎮或艾音布羅克。
不過他說，那些人應該不喜歡煙霧瀰漫的城市。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
Hmm. Really?
Then the person behind him may be in a high position or have authority. Or he/she might be rich.
scripts.translation:
[克魯克斯]
嗯，是嗎？
那幕後之人可能身居高位、手握權力，也可能非常富有。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Umm. Anyway, what we have to do is find that guy here in Lighthalzen.
And what do we know about his features and clothes?
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
嗯。總之，我們得在裡希塔樂鎮找到那傢伙。
你知道他長什麼樣、穿什麼衣服嗎？

scripts.text:
[Crux]
A man with a neat appearance, with light brown hair down to his shoulders.
His name is Bruno ... Since it's such a common name, it may be an alias.
scripts.translation:
[克魯克斯]
是個衣著整潔的男人，留著及肩的淺棕色頭髮。
他叫布魯諾...這名字很常見，可能是假名。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
I will investigate southern Lighthalzen, and the lady will investigate nearby the department store and hotel.
Adventurer, please search ^4d4dffthe north and northeast area^000000.
scripts.translation:
[克魯克斯]
我去調查裡希塔樂鎮南部，女士去百貨公司和旅館附近。
冒險者，請搜尋^4d4dff北部和東北部區域^000000。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
Once you find anything, ^4d4dffplease meet in front of the central department store and we'll share information^000000.
Now let us move quickly.
scripts.translation:
[克魯克斯]
找到線索後，^4d4dff請到中央百貨公司前會合，我們再交換情報^000000。
現在趕緊行動吧。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Oh, yes.
Crux ... You are a great actor.
See you later.
You too, hero!
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
哦，對了。
克魯克斯...你演得真好。
回頭見。
英雄，也回頭見！

scripts.text:
[Crux]
I will investigate southern Lighthalzen, including the airport.
Adventurer, please take care of the north and northeast areas.
scripts.translation:
[克魯克斯]
我會調查裡希塔樂鎮南部，包括機場。
冒險者，北部和東北部就交給你了。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
Once you find anything, ^4d4dffplease meet in front of the central department store and we'll share information^000000.
scripts.translation:
[克魯克斯]
找到線索後，^4d4dff請到中央百貨公司前會合，我們再交換情報^000000。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
Really? He headed to the slum?
We are in trouble.
I will follow you with the lady by any means.
Adventurer, please go there first.
scripts.translation:
[克魯克斯]
真的嗎？他去了貧民窟？
這下麻煩了。
我會和女士儘快趕過去。
冒險者，請你先去。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
You mean ... Bruno?
It will be difficult to use the airship. So we are moving separately.
scripts.translation:
[克魯克斯]
你是說...布魯諾？
坐飛空艇不方便，我們分頭行動吧。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
Don't worry about me, I will see you again in the palace.
Please give my regards to Lady Spica.
scripts.translation:
[克魯克斯]
別擔心我，我們在宮殿再會。
請代我向斯皮卡女士問好。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
Don't you have to go to Yuno?
scripts.translation:
[克魯克斯]
你不是該去尤諾嗎？

scripts.text:
[Crux]
I have an appointment in the hotel in Lighthalzen.
Let's go.
scripts.translation:
[克魯克斯]
我和人在裡希塔樂鎮的旅館有約。
走吧。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
I don't like leaving you like this for a long time ...
... I have no other choice.
scripts.translation:
[克魯克斯]
我不想讓你一個人等太久...
...但我也別無選擇。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
This is what you want.
scripts.translation:
[克魯克斯]
這就是你想要的結果。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
So far, I haven't seen anyone suspicious!
But I will find him soon.
I don't know why, but I have a strong belief about it.
The belief that he must be here!
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
到目前為止，我還沒發現可疑的人！
不過我很快就會找到他。
不知道為什麼，我有種強烈的預感——他一定就在這裡！

scripts.text:
He must have gone to the slum!
We have to find a way to get there.
scripts.translation:
他一定去了貧民窟！
我們得想辦法過去。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
I will tell Crux. You go after that guy first, please.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
我會通知克魯克斯。你先去追那個人。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Let's go back to the palace now.
Crux took that Bruno guy.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
我們現在回宮殿吧。
克魯克斯已經抓到了布魯諾。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
I always wanted to visit this place as a tourist. I never imagined to come here this way.
Wonderful city.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
我一直想以遊客的身份來這裡看看，沒想到會以這種方式來到這裡。
這座城市真美。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Let's go back to the palace.
Crux will take care of Bruno.
Then we will get ready for the investigation, right?
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
我們回宮吧。
克魯克斯會處理布魯諾的事。
然後我們就準備調查，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Skia]
I have to tell Nihil about this.
Let's go back.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
我必須把這件事告訴尼希爾。
我們回去吧。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
I have been waiting.
Since there has been a change in the schedule, we might miss each other.
scripts.translation:
[克魯克斯]
我等你很久了。
日程有變，我們可能會錯過彼此。

scripts.text: You are escorting Spica, right?
scripts.translation: 你在護送斯皮卡，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Crux]
That's what I would like to talk about.
Do you know Lady Skia and I requested a meeting in Yuno earlier?
scripts.translation:
[克魯克斯]
我正想和你談這件事。
你還記得之前我和斯基亞小姐請求在朱諾會面嗎？

scripts.text:
[Crux]
Since there are too many eyes in Yuno as well as the presidential residence, they wanted to meet us in a different location.
scripts.translation:
[克魯克斯]
朱諾和總統官邸附近眼線太多，所以她們想換個地方見面。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
I thought Lady Spica would draw their attention if she stayed too long in Yuno. So she moved to the appointed place immediately.
scripts.translation:
[克魯克斯]
我擔心斯皮卡小姐在朱諾待太久會引人注意，所以她立刻去了約定地點。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
She disguised herself as a tourist ... and is now in ^4d4dffthe hotel in Lighthalzen^000000.
scripts.translation:
[克魯克斯]
她喬裝成遊客 ... 現在人在^4d4dff裡希塔樂鎮的旅館^000000。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
I wanted to send her a note to update the changed schedule. But I thought I would meet her here ... So I've been waiting.
scripts.translation:
[克魯克斯]
我本想留張便條告訴她日程有變，但想著反正會在這裡碰面 ... 所以就一直等著。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
... ...
Since we do these things secretly, this happens quite often.
I know it's funny, but I am sorry that your trip was in vain.
scripts.translation:
[克魯克斯]
... ...
我們一直在秘密行動，這種事經常發生。
我知道聽起來有點好笑，但害你白跑一趟，實在抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
But the Schwartz government is positive about it.
However, I don't know what kind of card the ladies showed them ...
scripts.translation:
[克魯克斯]
施瓦茨瓦爾特政府對此倒是很積極。
不過我不知道那幾位小姐拿什麼說服了他們 ...

scripts.text:
[Crux]
Well, I have to take care of my task.
Then let us go to ^4d4dffLighthalzen^000000.
scripts.translation:
[克魯克斯]
好了，我得去處理我的任務了。
那我們去^4d4dff裡希塔樂鎮^000000吧。

scripts.text: I will count on you.
scripts.translation: 拜託你了

scripts.text: Wait a minute.
scripts.translation: 等一下

scripts.text:
[Crux]
Please tell me when you are ready.
Then we will get going.
scripts.translation:
[克魯克斯]
準備好後告訴我。
然後我們就出發。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
This way ...
scripts.translation:
[克魯克斯]
這邊走 ...

scripts.text:
[Crux]
Let's go to Lighthalzen.
scripts.translation:
[克魯克斯]
我們去裡希塔樂鎮。

scripts.text: I will count on you.
scripts.translation: 拜託你了

scripts.text: Wait a minute.
scripts.translation: 等一下

scripts.text:
[Crux]
Please tell me when you are ready.
Then we will get going.
scripts.translation:
[克魯克斯]
請告訴我您準備好了。
然後我們就出發。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
This way ...
scripts.translation:
[克魯克斯]
這邊走 ...

scripts.text:
[Crux]
The appointed place is ^4d4dffEinbroch train station^000000.
An agent named ^4d4dffLazy^000000 is waiting for us.
We have to hurry.
scripts.translation:
[克魯克斯]
約定地點是^4d4dff艾音布羅克火車站^000000。
一位名叫^4d4dff懶散^000000的特工正在等我們。
我們得快點。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
I never imagined that I would be traveling overseas ... I hope everything goes well.
scripts.translation:
[克魯克斯]
我從沒想過自己會出國 ... 希望一切順利。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
You've arrived on time!
Sorry for what happened in Yuno.
They say we'd better move to another place.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
你來得正好！
朱諾那邊的事，抱歉了。
他們說最好換個地方見面。

scripts.text: Who said that?
scripts.translation: 誰說的？

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Let me introduce you this person.
He has been sent by the president of Schwaltzvalt.
From now on, you will talk with him before deciding what to do.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
我來介紹一下這位。
他是施瓦茨瓦爾特總統派來的。
接下來要做什麼，先和他商量再決定。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Tess will explain.
Let's listen to him.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
泰絲會解釋的。
我們聽聽他怎麼說。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
Please talk to the representative of the Schwaltzvalt government along with the lady.
scripts.translation:
[克魯克斯]
請陪同小姐與施瓦茨瓦爾特政府的代表談談。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
The appointed place is ^4d4dffEinbroch train station^000000.
An agent named Lazy is waiting for you.
We have to hurry.
scripts.translation:
[克魯克斯]
約定的地點是^4d4dff艾音布羅克火車站^000000。
一位名叫懶散的特工在那裡等你。
我們得快點。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
My name is Philopontess. You can call me Tess.
Naturally, you have to talk to the president about this ... I am sorry we have to meet you this way.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
我叫菲洛龐泰絲，叫我泰絲就好。
這件事自然得和總統談 ... 很抱歉只能用這種方式與你見面。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
The big picture has already been drawn ...
Do you need a detailed explanation?
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
大致安排已經定下來了 ...
需要我詳細說明嗎？

scripts.text: Let us hear it.
scripts.translation: 讓我們聽聽

scripts.text: Please tell us what to do from now on.
scripts.translation: 請告訴我們接下來該怎麼做

scripts.text:
[Tess]
Thank you ... for your concern.
Saying the same thing again is quite hard.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
謝謝 ... 承蒙關心。
要把同樣的話再說一遍，還真不容易。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Haha, it must be a tough job.
Philopontess? Please go ahead.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
哈哈，這工作肯定很辛苦。
菲洛龐泰絲？請繼續。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
{0} I'm not sure how much you know about this. The political condition in Schwaltzvalt is not good.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
{0}，我不確定你對此瞭解多少。施瓦茨瓦爾特的政局並不穩定。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
If you remember the collapse of the Secret Wing, maybe you will know a lot about it.
But the Secret Wing was not destroyed entirely.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
如果你還記得秘密之翼覆滅一事，應該就瞭解不少。
不過秘密之翼並沒有被徹底剷除。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
Although it's only a small number, there are agents who are working on information warfare.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
雖然人數不多，仍有一些特工在從事情報戰。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
I am one of them. Usually, I work as a secretary.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
我就是其中一員，平時擔任秘書。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
The reason I am involved in this issue is that the case requested by the Nerius family is very special.
As you know, the government does not have a very good relationship with the enterprise. And we need cooperation for the facility of the enterprise.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
我會捲入此事，是因為內裡烏斯家族委託的案件情況特殊。
你也知道，政府和企業的關係不太好，但我們需要藉助企業的設施。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
So we are taking this opportunity to execute what we have planned.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
所以我們打算借這個機會，執行早已擬定的計劃。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
That organization was destroyed once, so they must be lacking in armed forces. We will be supporting them.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
那個組織曾遭到重創，武裝力量肯定不足。我們會支援他們。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
And you are the key player in that mission.
I will count on you.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
而你是這次任務的關鍵人物。
就拜託你了。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
So this will be a cooperative relationship.
We give you the information and discharge surveillance and legal restriction on the facility.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
因此，這會是一次合作。
我們會提供情報，並解除對該設施的監視和法律限制。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
Then we want to disable the Enterprisebeyond repair.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
然後，我們要徹底摧毀企業，讓它再也無法運作。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
To avoid surveillance by the enterprise, our president came here secretly and went back immediately.
His excellency entrusted me with the rest, so you can work with me from now on.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
為了避開企業的監視，總統秘密來此後便立刻返回了。
他把剩下的事交給我，從現在起由我與你合作。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
Now, I will let you know the future plans.
The princess is trying to reclaim the secret treasure of your family, right?
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
現在我來說明接下來的計劃。
公主想奪回你們家族的秘寶，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Tess]
We estimate that the one who took it is a trustee of the enterprise. And the facility we have to investigate is the ^4d4dffabandoned factory area near Einbroch^000000.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
我們推測，拿走秘寶的是企業的一名理事。我們要調查的設施是^4d4dff艾音布羅克附近的廢棄工廠區^000000。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
We know a lot about this facility.
It is one of the facilities we were planning to investigate.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
我們對這個設施瞭解很多。
它也是我們計劃調查的設施之一。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
We can send an official letter to the Enterpriserequesting their cooperation in the investigation. But as far as we are concerned, such an official request would only give them time to hide things.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
我們可以正式致函企業，請求他們配合調查。但這麼做只會給他們時間藏匿證據。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
Since the royal family of Rune Midgarts is helping us, we decided to run a random inspection.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
既然盧恩·米德加茲王室願意協助，我們決定進行突擊檢查。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
Sorry to interrupt you, but the only agents who can fight here are the adventurer and me ...
scripts.translation:
[克魯克斯]
抱歉打斷一下，不過這裡能戰鬥的只有冒險者和我 ...

scripts.text:
[Tess]
I see. An experienced adventurer and a bodyguard ...
We do realize that we do not have enough armed forces. So we have prepared some other strategies.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
明白了。一位身經百戰的冒險者和一名保鏢 ...
我們也知道人手不足，所以準備了其他方案。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
But here, if necessary, we need the help from the adventurer ... What's your name?
{0}, your cooperation is required.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
不過必要時，我們還需要冒險者幫忙 ... 你叫什麼名字？
{0}，希望你能協助我們。

scripts.text: I am all right.
scripts.translation: 我沒事

scripts.text:
[Tess]
Actually, I have a military group in mind to work with us. I'm sure you know them.
It's ^4d4dffRebellion^000000.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
其實我想到了一個能與我們合作的武裝團體，你應該聽說過。
就是^4d4dff反叛者^000000。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
After the Mercenary Rebellion, those who opposed the Enterprise allied and established the Rebellion.
They will accept our proposal.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
傭兵叛亂之後，反對企業的人們聯合起來，成立了反叛者組織。
他們會接受我們的提議。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Rebellion? Those guys? Are you serious?
It was the government that ignored the mercenaries who were in trouble.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
反叛者？就是那群人？你認真的嗎？
當初可是政府不管那些陷入困境的傭兵。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
That's why they organized a military group themselves and have grown so far ... Do you really think they will be on our side?
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
他們才會自行組建武裝團體，一路發展到今天 ... 你真覺得他們會幫我們？

scripts.text:
[Tess]
You know quite a lot about it.
Of course, I expect some buzz.
That's why we need {0}.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
看來你很瞭解內情。
我當然也預料到會有些風波。
所以我們才需要{0}。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
Since they hate us, there has been no progress in the negotiation. That's the problem.
This time, {0} and the royal family are with us. So the president thinks that we have a strong chance.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
他們憎恨我們，談判才會毫無進展。這正是問題所在。
這次有{0}和王室支援，總統認為成功的機會很大。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
If the adventurer talks to them, they will listen.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
由冒險者出面，他們才願意聽我們說。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
The important thing is that we must get the cooperation of the Rebellion.
We must be able to use the military force of the Rebellion.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
關鍵是要爭取反叛者合作。
我們必須藉助他們的武力。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
And inspecting the facility must be through the Rebellion and the organization. Only then can we approve your investigation to reclaim the secret treasure.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
而且，必須由反叛者和那個組織帶我們檢查設施。只有這樣，我們才能批准你為奪回秘寶而展開調查。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
You are saying that ... if we don't get help from the Rebellion, you cannot approve the investigation of the facility?
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
你的意思是 ... 如果沒有反叛者幫忙，你們就不批准調查那座設施？

scripts.text:
[Spica]
You already know that they will hate it if the government contacts them.
Then there is one thing we have to do.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
你也知道，要是政府直接聯絡他們，他們肯定會反感。
那我們就只剩一件事可做了。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
We have to rely on the heroic adventurer to borrow the military force of the Rebellion ...
I got it.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
只能靠英勇的冒險者借來反叛者的兵力 ...
我明白了。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
After all, what we need is an investigation of the ^4d4dfffacility^000000.
There is nothing more we want. Now let us finish the conversation.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
說到底，我們只想調查^4d4dff設施^000000。
沒有別的要求。就先談到這裡吧。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
And then, {0} I would like to explain our schedule ...
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
接下來，{0}，我想說明一下行動安排 ...

scripts.text:
[Spica]
We have no other choice.
They say it has to be you. No one else ...
{0}... Will you help us?
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
我們也別無選擇。
他們說非你不可 ...
{0}...你願意幫我們嗎？

scripts.text: Once we start, we have to finish it.
scripts.translation: 只要開始了，就得完成到底

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Haha. {0} you never disappoint me.
But I can't vacate my seat for too long.
I am sorry that I cannot be with you until the end of this mission.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
哈哈。{0}，你果然沒讓我失望。
但我不能離席太久。
很抱歉，沒法陪你執行完整個任務。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
So you are going back, princess.
{0}. Please meet ^4d4dffLazy^000000 in ^4d4dffEinbroch^000000 and work with him. He is a negotiator who we have prepared.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
公主殿下要回去了嗎？
{0}，請到^4d4dff艾音布羅克^000000和^4d4dff懶散^000000會合，跟他一起行動。他是我們安排的談判代表。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
An agent named ^4d4dffLazy^000000 will be waiting for you at the ^4d4dffEinbroch train station^000000.
Please don't forget it.
If possible, please hurry.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
一位名叫^4d4dff懶散^000000的特工會在^4d4dff艾音布羅克火車站^000000等你。
別忘了。
方便的話，請儘快趕去。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
From now on, this is a race against time.
Thank you for your support in advance.
I will go to the president for a report.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
從現在起，我們得爭分奪秒。
先謝謝你的協助。
我得去向總統彙報了。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
... What a straightforward man.
Let's go back now.
Seems like we have finished our job.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
...真是個爽快的人。
我們也回去吧。
看來我們的工作告一段落了。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
I have to entrust you to meet ^4d4dffLazy in Einbroch^000000... For additional issues, I will go back to the palace and handle them with the prince of the Heine family.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
接下來就拜託你去^4d4dff艾音布羅克找懶散^000000了 ... 至於其他事，我會回宮和海爾內家的王子商量處理。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Then, {0}.
I wish you fortune in war.
Crux, let's go back.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
那麼，{0}。
祝你旗開得勝。
克魯克斯，我們回去吧。

scripts.text:
[Someone crazy about Yuno]
Yuno~ Visit Yuno~ If you were born as a human, go to Yuno~ If you have come to Schwaltzvalt, go to Yuno~ If you are breathing, go to Yuno~
scripts.translation:
[痴迷朱諾的人]
朱諾~快來朱諾~只要你是個人，就該來朱諾~只要你到了施瓦茨瓦爾特，就該來朱諾~只要你還在呼吸，就該來朱諾~

scripts.text:
[???]
Yuno~ Visit Yuno~ If you were born as a human, go to Yuno~ If you have come to Schwaltzvalt, go to Yuno~ If you are breathing, go to Yuno~
scripts.translation:
[???]
朱諾~快來朱諾~只要你是個人，就該來朱諾~只要你到了施瓦茨瓦爾特，就該來朱諾~只要你還在呼吸，就該來朱諾~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
They told me to meet the agent of the Secret Wings. Could it be that person? Well, by no means...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他們讓我來見秘密之翼的特工。難道是那個人？不，不可能...

scripts.text:
[???]
Yo! Nice to meet you!
scripts.translation:
[???]
嘿！很高興見到你！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, it should never be him... Let's ignore him for now.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不，絕對不可能是他...先不理他。

scripts.text:
[???]
A heron swallows a fish alone.
scripts.translation:
[???]
白鷺獨自吞下一條魚。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Heron wants to drink water?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
白鷺想喝水？

scripts.text:
[???]
In that case, you should say 'A heron hides its secret in the wings'. Didn't you hear that before leaving?
scripts.translation:
[???]
這時候你應該說“白鷺把秘密藏在翅膀裡”。出發前沒人告訴你嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You must be confusing me with someone else...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你一定是認錯人了...

scripts.text:
[???]
{0} Isn't it you...? It must be you! Why do you pretend as you are not?
scripts.translation:
[???]
{0}，是你吧...? 肯定是你！為什麼要裝作不認識？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I am {1} that person. But...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我就是{1}那個人。不過...

scripts.text:
[???]
Are you sure you don't know anything? My name is ^0000cdLazy^000000. Of course it's not my real name. For now, you can just remember that name.
scripts.translation:
[???]
你確定自己什麼都不知道？我叫^0000cd懶散^000000。當然不是真名。暫時記住這個名字就行。

scripts.text:
[???]
I have been assigned to this mission with you. We have to ask the Rebellion for cooperation.
scripts.translation:
[???]
我被派來和你一起執行這項任務。我們得爭取反叛者合作。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
If you are Lazy, you must be the agent of the Secret Wings. Right?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你要是懶散，那就是秘密之翼的特工了，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Pipe down~ You must not say that word in a public place like this! You must always be careful! Remember that we are in the middle of a mission!
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
小聲點~在這種公共場合絕不能提那個名字！隨時都得小心！記住，我們正在執行任務！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, Yes.

[Lazy]
Just by looking at you, I know they have brought someone very smart. And the callus in your hand indicates that you are a man of the world.
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
看你這模樣，我就知道他們派來的人很機靈。你手上的老繭也說明你閱歷豐富。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
You are also taking someone off his/her guard by pretending to be a little naive. You deserve to be trusted by the royal families of Rune Midgarts.
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
你還會裝得有點天真，讓別人放鬆戒心。難怪盧恩·米德加茲王室會信任你。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
When I read about you in the report, I thought you would look a bit scary. But by seeing you directly, you seem to be different from what I heard. That's why we have to meet someone directly to know him/her well.
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
我在報告裡看到你時，還以為你會長得挺嚇人。現在親眼一看，發現你和傳聞中不太一樣。果然，想了解一個人還是得親自見面。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
By the way, how are you? Have you been to Arunafeltz?
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
對了，你最近怎麼樣？去過阿魯納菲茲嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, yes. Kind of...

[Lazy]
Wow- Have you met the Pope? Her highness is great. I really like her.
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
哇，你見過教皇嗎？她可了不起了，我特別喜歡她。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Oh, Pope... !!

[Lazy]
I'd really love to meet the Pope. But I am not mentally ready to see the holy face of her highness. I guess I might black out once I see the Pope. If you have time later on, please take me to the Pope.
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
我好想見教皇，可還沒做好瞻仰陛下聖容的心理準備。我怕一見到她就會昏過去。你之後有空的話，帶我去見她吧。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
By the way, what are we doing here? Aren't we supposed to meet in ^0000cdEinbech^000000? I have been waiting for a long time and came here. And I found you here.
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
對了，我們現在在這裡做什麼？不是約好在^0000cd艾音貝赫^000000見面嗎？我等了好久才趕來，結果卻在這裡遇見你。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
They told me to come here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他們讓我來這裡。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Hey~ Who? Who said that? There must have been some misunderstanding during the communication. We must go to Einbech.
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
哎~誰？誰讓你來的？溝通時肯定出了什麼差錯。我們得去艾音貝赫。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Well, since I like a train, it doesn't matter how many times I take it.
scripts.translation:

[懶散]
快走吧，路還遠著呢。

我們現在要去哪裡？

[懶散]
最危險的地方。

[懶散]

[{0}]

既然要和反叛者談判，為什麼去艾音貝赫而不是艾音布羅克？

[懶散]

[懶散]

Some of the remnants went to Figel, But the rest of them gathered in Einbech and Einbroch to organize the Rebellion. By the way, Einbroch is a large city where many people live ans pass by. Isn't it?

[懶散]
一部分殘黨逃到了菲格爾，其餘的人則聚集在艾音貝赫和艾音布羅克，成立了反叛者組織。艾音布羅克人來人往，是座大城市，對吧？

scripts.text:

So the Rebellion put their guild in Einbroch. The rest of them were hiding somewhere else in Einbroch. That's why I suggested you to meet in Einbech..
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
反叛者把公會設在艾音布羅克，其他成員則藏身在艾音布羅克的其他地方。這就是我提議在艾音貝赫見面的原因。

[懶散]

[懶散]

[懶散]

[{0}]

[懶散]

[懶散]

[懶散]

[懶散]

[{0}]

I really don't understand the relationship between being tense and free riding.

We are going to take a train here. Do you see ^0000cdvery small hole^000000 in the sewer down there?

穿成這樣說這種話，實在沒什麼說服力。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
He won't wake up immediately, but he'll save his life anyway. If we were too late, he would have died.
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
他不會馬上醒來，不過至少保住性命了。要是再晚一點，他恐怕就沒命了。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
What are you doing? Carry him.
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
你還愣著幹什麼？把他背起來。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Are we carrying him? I thought we were on a secret mission.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
要揹著他走？我還以為我們在執行秘密任務呢。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
We ^0000cdmust bring^000000 him. No matter what happens, we must bring this man. He will be our ticket to the base.
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
我們^0000cd必須帶上^000000他。無論如何都得把他帶走，他會是我們進入基地的通行證。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Who's this man?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這個人是誰？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Good question. But since we don't have enough time, let me explain later. We must deliver him before he dies.
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
問得好。不過時間緊迫，我之後再解釋。得趕在他斷氣前把他送出去。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
What are you doing? I told you to follow me.
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
你在幹什麼？我讓你跟著我。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Are you here now?
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
你現在在這裡嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Put down what you have carried.
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
放下你背上的東西。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Where am I? There's nobody here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我在哪兒？這裡一個人也沒有。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
You can see as much as you know. That's why I'm always tired. People all want me to look at them.
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
你能看到多少，取決於你知道多少。所以我才總是這麼累，人人都想讓我替他們看清一切。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Anyway, let's get in here.
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
總之，我們進去吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So, where am I?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
所以，我在哪？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
You talk too much! I told you we don't have much time. You can listen to my explanation later. Someone who was standing in front of this detected me already and went inside. We don't know what they will prepare.
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
你話太多了！我說過時間不多，解釋之後再說。剛才有人守在這裡，發現我之後就進去了。我們不知道他們會有什麼準備。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wait, are we going to leave him here?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等等，要把他留在這裡嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Yeah. Is there any problem? Is it a problem? Could it be a problem?
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
是啊。有問題嗎？這有問題嗎？這會有問題嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You said that we should bring the injured man. Then you told me to carry him all the way here. Now you are abandoning him here?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你剛才還說得帶上傷者，讓我一路把他背到這裡。現在卻要把他丟在這兒？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Don't worry about him. He's not going to die. Humans do not die so easily. The fact I'm still alive is the evidence.
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
別擔心，他死不了。人沒那麼容易死，我還活著就是證據。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That's not the issue here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這不是重點。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Come on, let's get in. We don't have much time. Let's talk inside. Aren't you curious to know what's in there?
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
快進去，時間不多了。進去再聊。你不好奇裡面有什麼嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
We have to see something to get in there.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我們得先找到入口才能進去吧。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Look at this. There's an entrance here. This is ^0000cdan entrance hidden in the wall of the beach^000000. It is so fishy. Let's get inside and check what's there.
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
看這裡，這裡有個入口。^0000cd入口藏在海灘的牆壁裡^000000，真可疑。進去看看裡面有什麼。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
What are you doing? Come in!
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
你在幹什麼？快進來！

scripts.text:
[Eri]
Oh, welcome. This is a weapon store, Clana Nemieri.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
哦，歡迎光臨。這是克拉納·內米埃裡武器店。

scripts.text:
[Eri]
In this store, even a small sound creates a huge resonant due to its structure. Please be quite when entering here.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
這家店的結構會讓細微的聲音產生很大的迴響。進來時請保持安靜。

scripts.text:
[Nemi]
A real customer!! We have a customer in this period...
scripts.translation:
[內米]
有客人！！這種時候居然還有客人...

scripts.text:
[Nemi]
Be quite when entering.
scripts.translation:
[內米]
進來時請保持安靜。

scripts.text:
[Lucky]
Who are you? This is not a place where anyone can come in. Please leave.
scripts.translation:
[拉基]
你是誰？這裡不是誰都能進來的地方。請離開。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Ouch! The store looks smaller that it looks from outside. Is there a space behind the pillar?
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
哎喲！這家店裡面看起來比外面還小。柱子後面是不是還有空間？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Is this a firearm store?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這是一家槍械店嗎？

scripts.text:
[Shopkeeper]
A real customer?
scripts.translation:
[店主]
有客人？

scripts.text:
[Shopkeeper]
Welcome. This is ^0000cdClana Nemieri^000000 and we handle various firearms.
scripts.translation:
[店主]
歡迎光臨，這裡是^0000cd克拉納·內米埃裡^000000，專營各種槍械。

scripts.text:
[Shopkeeper]
Take a look around and tell me if there is anything you are looking for.
scripts.translation:
[店主]
請隨意看看，想找什麼就告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Yeah.. I hope we have what you're looking for.
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
嗯...希望這裡有你要找的東西。

scripts.text:
[Shopkeeper]
By the way... How did you find us? This is a small store that only limited people visit.
scripts.translation:
[店主]
對了...你是怎麼找到這裡的？這家小店平時沒幾個人來。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
I wanted to buy a self-defense gun. And someone recommended me this store.
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
我想買把防身槍，有人推薦我來這家店。

scripts.text:
[Shopkeeper]
Who.. was it?
scripts.translation:
[店主]
誰...推薦的？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
What would you do if I tell you who that person is?
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
我告訴您那個人是誰，您又打算怎麼辦？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Wow, this looks cool. Is this the way you hold it?
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
哇，這個看起來挺酷。是這樣握的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Shopkeeper]
Sir. That stuff is quite sensitive and you shouldn't tough it inconsiderately.
scripts.translation:
[店主]
先生，那東西很精密，請不要隨便碰。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Didn't you tell me to look all I want? This is so small! Can it ever fire a bullet? Look at the dust here. I guess you're out of business here.
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
不是您讓我隨便看的嗎？這也太小了！真能打出子彈嗎？看看上面的灰，看來你們生意不太好啊。

scripts.text:
[Shopkeeper]
Oh.. That's one of the most popular products in our store.
scripts.translation:
[店主]
哦...那可是本店最暢銷的商品之一。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Is this a popular product? I can imagine the quality of this store.
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
這是暢銷貨？我都能想像這家店的品質了。

scripts.text:
[Shopkeeper]
What did you say? Are you insulting my gun now?
scripts.translation:
[店主]
你說什麼？你是在侮辱我的槍嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
No, I don't mean it. But if you heard it that way, then it's an insult.
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
我不是那個意思。不過您要是這麼理解，那就算我侮辱您了。

scripts.text:
[Shopkeeper]
Calm down, Nemi. He's a customer.
scripts.translation:
[店主]
冷靜點，內米。他是客人。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Hmm... This looks quite good. How much is it?
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
嗯...這個看起來不錯，多少錢？

scripts.text:
[Shopkeeper]
3.4 million Zeny.
scripts.translation:
[店主]
340萬澤尼。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
That's the price of a snack. Give me one.
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
這價錢跟零食差不多。給我來一把。

scripts.text:
[Shopkeeper]
Since it is a display product, we have to place an order. There are too many orders and you have to wait for eight months. Can you wait?
scripts.translation:
[店主]
這是展示品，得另外訂購。訂單太多，要等八個月。你等得了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
I'm not the one who's short-tempered. I guess it's you.
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
脾氣急的人可不是我，我看是你吧。

scripts.text:
[Shopkeeper]
Calm down, Nemi.
scripts.translation:
[店主]
冷靜點，內米。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Rather than these, show me what you actually sell here. For example, ^0000cdFast Grinder Cutting through the Wind^000000?
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
比起這些，拿點你們真正賣的東西給我看看。比如^0000cd疾風切割機^000000？

scripts.text:
[Shopkeeper]
Hey, who the hell are you?
scripts.translation:
[店主]
喂，你到底是什麼人？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Can't you see? I am a tourist and this is my secretary.
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
看不出來嗎？我是遊客，這是我的秘書。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Sec, secretary...?

[Shopkeeper]
Which tourist comes all the way to the weapon store in a mining village where there is nothing to see? Where do you come from?
scripts.translation:
[店主]
哪個遊客會大老遠跑到這座沒什麼景點的礦業村，專程來武器店？你們從哪兒來的？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
I just arrived from Yuno. I went there and it was so~ wonderful.
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
我剛從朱諾來。那裡真是~太棒了。

scripts.text:
[Shopkeeper]
Go back. We don't have what you want.
scripts.translation:
[店主]
回去吧，這裡沒有你要的東西。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
So you're kicking us out? Mr. Nemieri. You can't do this.
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
所以你要趕我們走？內米埃裡先生，您不能這樣。

scripts.text:
[Shopkeeper]
Why can't I kick you out? Go away before call someone.
scripts.translation:
[店主]
我為什麼不能趕你走？趁我叫人之前，趕緊離開。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
You'd better take a look who's out there. His name was... ^0000cdGonie^000000. Right?
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
你最好出去看看是誰來了。他叫...^0000cd戈尼^000000，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Shopkeeper]
What are you talking about?
scripts.translation:
[店主]
你在說什麼？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Just go outside and check it yourself.
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
你自己出去看看不就知道了。

scripts.text:
[Shopkeeper]
I won't tolerate you if you're playing shallow tricks.
scripts.translation:
[店主]
要是你敢耍什麼小把戲，我可不會放過你。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Can he carry him alone?
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
他一個人能把那人抬走嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Is the collapsed guy from here?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那個昏倒的人是從這裡出來的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Didn't you know? That's why we struggled to bring him all the way here. Now look. He will use a magic after a short while.
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
你還不知道嗎？我們費了好大勁才把他一路帶到這裡。看著吧，他等會兒就會施法。

scripts.text:
[Shopkeeper]
Arrgh...

[Shopkeeper]
Oh, my goodness. Gonie! What happened!
scripts.translation:
[店主]
天哪！戈尼！怎麼回事！

scripts.text:
[Shopkeeper]
Eri. Go and bring ^0000cdLucky^000000.
scripts.translation:
[店主]
繪理，去把^0000cd拉基^000000叫來。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Lucky?
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
拉基？

scripts.text:
[Shopkeeper]
Hey, what did you to this guy?
scripts.translation:
[店主]
喂，你們對這傢伙做了什麼？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Well, we did something. He was nearly dead and we brought him all the way here by keeping him alive. That was a great job.
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
是，我們確實做了點事。他當時都快沒命了，我們一路把他救活、帶到這裡。我們可是幫了大忙。

scripts.text:
[Shopkeeper]
Didn't you hurt him to take him as a hostage?
scripts.translation:
[店主]
你們是不是為了把他當人質，才把他弄傷的？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Why would I hand over the person I took hostage to you? If you really don't know what happened, wake him up and ask him. What would you do if we didn't hurt him?
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
我抓了人質，怎麼還會把他交給你們？你要是真不知道發生了什麼，就叫醒他問問。要是我們沒傷他，你又打算怎麼辦？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
You'll be so embarrassed, sorry and ashamed. Would you even lift your head up?
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
到時候你會尷尬、愧疚又羞愧，恐怕連頭都抬不起來吧？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Why are you doubting us so much? Enough is enough. Not many villains try to swindle with an injured person.
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
你們幹嗎這麼懷疑我們？夠了吧。哪有惡棍會拿傷員來騙人？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
This is unfair. I've been victimized! Father! Mother!!
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
這不公平！明明是我受了委屈！爸爸！媽媽！！

scripts.text:
[Lucky]
Nemi, what happened? Is Gonie dead?
scripts.translation:
[拉基]
內米，怎麼回事？戈尼死了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Shopkeeper]
No, he's not.
scripts.translation:
[店主]
不，他沒死。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
He was nearly dead and we brought him all the way here by keeping him alive~ It was so tough~~
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
他都快沒命了，我們一路把他救活帶到這裡~可累壞我了~~

scripts.text:
[Lucky]
He's not doing very well. We have to take him there and lay him down. Wake up, Gonie. Can you walk?
scripts.translation:
[拉基]
他情況不太好。得把他抬到那邊躺下。戈尼，醒醒。能走嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
It will be difficult now. You will have to carry him. If it is hard for you, you can order my strong secretary to lift him~
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
他現在走不了，得有人揹他。你要是背不動，可以叫我這位強壯的秘書來幫忙哦~

scripts.text:
[??]
Arrgh, yeah!!
Bump!
scripts.translation: 砰！

scripts.text:
[Gonie]
....!

[Lazy]
Oh, dear! You dropped him. Maybe you have been overworking.
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
哎呀！你把他摔了。看來你最近太累了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
He opened his eyes! Looks like he is conscious!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他睜眼了！好像醒過來了！

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
No, he opened his eyes instinctively due to the impact. He's still unconscious.
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
不，他只是被撞得本能地睜開眼睛，還沒醒呢。

scripts.text:
[??]
Gonie! Are you all right? Stand up.
scripts.translation:
[??]
戈尼！你沒事吧？站起來。

scripts.text: Bump!
scripts.translation: 砰！

scripts.text:
[Gonie]
....!

[Lazy]
My god! You dropped him again. Don't work too hard.
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
天哪！你又把他摔了。別太勉強自己啊。

scripts.text:
[??]
Gonie! What happened to you? Stand up again.
scripts.translation:
[??]
戈尼！你怎麼了？再站起來試試。

scripts.text: Bump!
scripts.translation: 砰！

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Gosh, why is your arm you so weak? Seems like this place is in trouble. You have no manpower so you hired such a weak person? My god.
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
天哪，你胳膊怎麼這麼沒勁？看來這裡真是缺人手，才會僱這麼弱的人？我的天。

scripts.text:
[??]
I don't know who you are. But I hear what you're saying!
scripts.translation:
[??]
我不知道你是誰，不過我聽見你說的話了！

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Hear what? I was just speaking inside!
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
聽見什麼？我只是在心裡說說而已！

scripts.text: Bump!
scripts.translation: 砰！

scripts.text:
[??]
Gonie! Why are you so bloody? Did they attack you?
scripts.translation:
[??]
戈尼！你怎麼渾身是血？他們襲擊你了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Shopkeeper]
you! It's because of you! You just can't lift him! Come on. Let's carry him together. You are so weak that you cannot lift anything heavier than a spoon.
scripts.translation:
[店主]
你！都是你害的！你根本抬不動他！來，我們一起把他抬起來。你弱得連比勺子重的東西都拿不動。

scripts.text:
[Shopkeeper]
Don't give Lucky too much pressure.
scripts.translation:
[店主]
別給拉基太大壓力。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
I barely saved his life and now you're trying to kill him. It's a fortune that he is unconscious and cannot feel the pain.
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
我好不容易才救了他的命，你們現在卻要害死他。幸好他昏迷了，感覺不到疼。

scripts.text:
[??]
Thanks, Nemi. Arrgh. Let's bring him and lay him down.
scripts.translation:
[??]
謝了，內米。啊...我們把他抬過去放下吧。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Hey. Don't you have anything to tell us?
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
喂，你們就沒什麼要跟我們說的嗎？

scripts.text:
[??]
Oh, I heard about you briefly. Thank you very much for saving my friend and taking him all the way here. The shop owner will compensate you.
scripts.translation:
[??]
哦，我大概聽說你們的事了。非常感謝你們救了我的朋友，還一路把他送到這裡。店主會補償你們的。

scripts.text:
[??]
See you later.

[Lazy]
Wait! They're sending us away like this? Seems like they are. Did I get it wrong?
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
等等！就這樣給點錢把我們打發走了？好像還真是。我是不是理解錯了？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Oops? They went inside! Come on!
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
咦？他們進去了！快跟上！

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
You are sending us back after giving some money? You can't do this! At least, you should give me a cup of tea!
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
給了錢就想把我們打發走？哪有這樣的！至少也該請我喝杯茶吧！

scripts.text:
[Shopkeeper]
Please, customer. You shouldn't do this.
scripts.translation:
[店主]
客人，求您了，別這樣。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Then tell them to come out! Come out now! Come out! Come out!
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
那就叫他們出來！現在就出來！出來！快出來！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hmm, Lazy. This is a little embarrassing. Let's go back now. We have a mission.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
懶散，這樣有點丟臉。我們還是回去吧，別忘了還有任務。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Never! I am impervious to shame so I will keep shouting until they come out! Hey! Rookie! Come out! Come out!
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
絕不！我臉皮厚得很，不把他們喊出來我就不走！喂，新人！出來！快出來！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm feeling ashamed...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我都覺得丟臉了...

scripts.text:
[Shopkeeper]
Be quiet. If you keep making a fuss, I will call someone to get you out of here.
scripts.translation:
[店主]
安靜點。你再鬧，我就叫人把你趕出去。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Who kicks me out! That's impossible! I will lie down here! Come out!
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
誰敢趕我？沒門！我就躺在這裡！出來！

scripts.text:
[Lucky]
Phew...

[Lazy]
He's here!!!
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
他來了！！！

scripts.text:
[Lucky]
Your voice is so loud that it hurts my ears. Normally, stupid people have huge voices.
scripts.translation:
[拉基]
你的聲音太大了，吵得我耳朵疼。通常，愚蠢的人聲音都很大。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
I can do something worse.
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
我能做出更糟糕的事。

scripts.text:
[Lucky]
I see. Come in. We can give you a cup of tea as you wish.
scripts.translation:
[拉基]
我明白了。進來吧。我們可以按你的要求給你倒杯茶。

scripts.text:
[Shopkeeper]
Are you sure it's okay?
scripts.translation:
[店主]
你確定這樣沒問題嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lucky]
Look at him. He can't even hurt us.
scripts.translation:
[拉基]
看看他。他連傷害我們的能力都沒有。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
I feel weird, but I will skip it. Oh! I'm so thirsty~
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
我覺得有點奇怪，但我就免了吧。哦！我渴死了~

scripts.text:
[Lucky]
Follow me. It's this way.
scripts.translation:
[拉基]
跟我來。這邊請。

scripts.text:
[Squadder]
These guys are quite loud.
I would never be bored.
scripts.translation:
[斯誇德]
這些人真吵。
我絕對不會感到無聊。

scripts.text:
[Squadder]
Someone has come, and I think he is looking for you.
I let him come in, even though I had a bad feeling about it.
scripts.translation:
[斯誇德]
有人來了，我想他是來找你的。
雖然我有種不好的預感，但我還是讓他進來了。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
These people are really rude.
... How can they ever put a visitor outside like this?
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
這些人真沒禮貌。
...怎麼能把客人晾在外面呢？

scripts.text:
[Squadder]
Hey, dude. You talk very politely, don't you?
Without this case, we would never cooperate with the government guys!
scripts.translation:
[斯誇德]
嘿，夥計。你說話真客氣啊。
要不是因為這件事，我們才不會跟政府的人合作呢！

scripts.text:
[Tess]
There is a visitor from Rune Midgarts. I escorted the visitor to ^4d4dffthe Einbroch hotel^000000.
I don't know how things are going on here.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
有一位來自魯恩·米德加特的訪客。我把他帶到了^4d4dff艾音布羅克旅館^000000。
我不清楚這裡的情況如何。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
Since I was able to come in here, I guess the negotiation was successful.
... Where is the field of operations?
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
既然我能進來，看來談判是成功了。
...行動地點在哪裡？

scripts.text:
[Squadder]
That's what I was about to tell you!
Without you, I've already told him all about it!
scripts.translation:
[斯誇德]
這正是我正要告訴你的！
沒有你，我已經把一切都告訴他了！

scripts.text:
[Squadder]
Well, I don't know if you are a visitor or not. But you're going to Einbroch? It's good.
We are going to Einbroch, too.
scripts.translation:
[斯誇德]
嗯，我不知道你是不是訪客。但你要去艾音布羅克？很好。
我們也是要去艾音布羅克。

scripts.text:
[Squadder]
Einbroch hotel? Nice.
If you take a train here, you will arrive at Einbroch in a moment.
scripts.translation:
[斯誇德]
艾音布羅克旅館？不錯。
如果你坐火車來這裡，很快就會到達艾音布羅克。

scripts.text: The heron ...
scripts.translation: 蒼鷺...

scripts.text:
[Tess]
The heron? Oh, Lazy?
I'm sure he will take care of getting himself there.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
蒼鷺？你是說懶散？
我想他能自己想辦法過去。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
See you at ^4d4dffEinbroch hotel^000000.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
我們在^4d4dff艾音布羅克旅館^000000見。

scripts.text:
[Squadder]
Well, let me escort you to the train station.
Shall we depart now?
scripts.translation:
[斯誇德]
我送你去火車站吧。
現在出發嗎？

scripts.text: Yes!
scripts.translation: 準備好了！

scripts.text: We will go on our own.
scripts.translation: 我們自己去

scripts.text:
[Squadder]
From Einbech station to Einbroch, you go on your own.
Now you know the direction.
scripts.translation:
[斯誇德]
從艾音貝赫站到艾音布羅克的路，你自己走吧。
現在你知道怎麼去了。

scripts.text:
[Squadder]
You said it is ^4d4dffEinbroch hotel^000000.
We will send someone you might know well.
scripts.translation:
[斯誇德]
你說的是^4d4dff艾音布羅克旅館^000000吧。
我們會派一個你熟悉的人過去。

scripts.text:
[Squadder]
Maybe it's our chance to give a huge gift to the enterprise~
scripts.translation:
[斯誇德]
也許這是給企業送上一份大禮的好機會~

scripts.text: Since you do not have the ^00ffff{0}^000000, you cannot proceed any further.
scripts.translation: 由於你沒有^00ffff{0}^000000，無法繼續前進。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
What is going on here?
There's something in the air.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
這裡怎麼了？
氣氛有些不對勁。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
Well, I have to hand it to you.
I've never stepped back before.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
好吧，這次算你厲害。
我以前從沒退讓過。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
It's not a big deal, is it?
We are doing this for our mutual benefit.
It's not so definite yet
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
沒什麼大不了的，對吧？
我們這麼做是為了雙方的利益。
事情還沒定論。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
The president will make the final decision anyway.
... But I believe his excellency will accept it without any opposition.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
最終還是由總統拍板。
...不過我相信他會毫無異議地接受。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
But I am still upset.
... It's just a personal feeling.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
不過我心裡還是不太舒服。
...這只是我的個人感受。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Would you please let me know what you have been talking about?
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
能告訴我你們剛才在討論什麼嗎？

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
It's not so serious.
We have been discussing diplomatic issues that could arise during our operation. Also, we talked about the relationship with the Enterpriseand other plans.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
沒什麼大事。
我們討論了行動期間可能遇到的外交問題，以及與企業的關係和其他計劃。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
We also talked about the possible gains and losses for our two sides during this cooperation ...
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
我們還談了這次合作中雙方可能得到什麼、又會失去什麼...

scripts.text:
[Tess]
... Although it was committed by the enterprise, we cannot deny that it happened in our country. So we have to take some responsibility.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
...雖然這是企業做的，但事情畢竟發生在我國境內，我們不能推卸責任。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
Yes. That's it.
But I'm not sure whether they could feel more comfortable with this kind compensation or contract ...
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
沒錯，就是這樣。
但我不確定他們是否會接受這樣的補償或協議...

scripts.text: They?
scripts.translation: 他們？

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
Once we sent delegates to Schwaltzvalt.
... And they never came back.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
我們之前派過代表去施瓦茨瓦爾特。
...結果他們再也沒回來。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
Come to think of it, you must have cleared your mission.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
仔細想想，你應該已經完成了任務。

scripts.text: Give him the Blessing Star.
scripts.translation: 給他祝福之星

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
... Terra Gloria, the surface is gone.
Only the star is remaining.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
...泰拉格洛麗亞的表面已經不見了。
只剩下這顆星。

scripts.text: Is there any problem?
scripts.translation: 有什麼問題嗎？

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
No, the surface is just a means to cover the star.
What matters is the star.
You have brought the right stuff.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
不，外殼只是用來包住這顆星的。
重要的是這顆星。
你帶回了真正重要的東西。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
Hmm? It's just a gem, isn't it?
Why on earth did they steal this?
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
嗯？這不就是顆寶石嗎？
他們為什麼要偷這個？

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Because it is like a fine magic stone.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
因為它就像一塊精美的魔法之石。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
.. Now they steal the materials for experiments?
There are several more facilities that are presumed to have secret laboratories like this.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
...他們現在連實驗材料都偷？
據說還有好幾處設施裡藏著類似的秘密實驗室。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
Are you freaking out about the future?
We have already finished talking about it.
I told you that I would support you if you need it.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
你是在擔心接下來會怎樣嗎？
我們已經談妥了。
我說過，需要的話我會支援你。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
... That was in reference to the mutual agreement. So please don't take the credit for yourself.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
...那是雙方協議裡說好的。別把功勞都攬到自己身上。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
Credit? I was just telling the truth.
Now, I don't have to be here anymore.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
功勞？我只是在說實話。
好了，我也沒必要繼續待在這裡了。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
You are so cold.
Are you leaving right after obtaining what you want?
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
你可真冷淡。
拿到想要的東西就馬上要走嗎？

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
We will meet again, if necessary.
Tess, if you visit Prontera, you will be more than welcome.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
有需要的話，我們還會再見。
泰絲，歡迎你來普隆德拉。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
Besides, I don't have much time.
I have many things to handle when I get back.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
再說，我時間不多。
回去後還有一堆事要處理。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
{0}.
Go back to the palace and wait in your room.
I will make sure that you get enough compensation.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
{0}。
回宮後就在房間等著。
我會給你應得的報酬。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Are we going back now?
I have a Scroll of Movement made by Nilem, the palace magician. Shall I use it?
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
現在回去嗎？
我有尼勒姆這個宮廷魔法師製作的移動卷軸。要用嗎？

scripts.text: Let me join you!!
scripts.translation: 讓我也一起去！！

scripts.text:
[Tess]
No, {0}, please talk to me for a while.
I would like to get some more!
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
不，{0}，請再陪我聊一會兒。
我還想再問你幾件事！

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
Skia, activate it.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
斯基亞，發動它。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Yes~
Mr. Philopontess, so long!
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
好~
菲洛龐泰絲先生，再見！

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
Good to see you again.
I am glad you are safe.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
又見面了。
很高興你平安無事。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
This happened because of me. So I came to resolve the crisis myself.
... It would be shameful of me to keep relying on others.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
這場危機因我而起，所以我親自來解決。
...一直依賴別人，我會覺得很羞愧。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
... Although I cannot help you physically,
I can take care of the information analysis and diplomatic affairs.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
...雖然我無法親自出力，
但可以負責情報分析和外交事務。

scripts.text: Have you been released from confinement?
scripts.translation: 你被解除禁閉了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Hmm~ Unfortunately, no.
I reported to the elders of our royal family about this affair. I was scolded and barely got permission to come here.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
嗯~很遺憾，還沒有。
我向王室長老彙報了這件事，捱了一頓訓，好不容易才獲准來這裡。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
In the process, I took advantage of your name.
Officially, you are the key person resolving this crisis and I am the one who takes the responsibility. And Lady Skia is observing me.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
這件事上我借用了你的名義。
官方說法是，你是解決危機的關鍵人物，而我負責承擔責任。斯基亞小姐則負責監督我。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
Since they all know about you, everyone is expecting you resolve this by any means.
I apologize for having taken advantage of your name without informing you earlier.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
大家都知道你，所以都指望你無論如何也要解決這場危機。
之前沒告訴你就借用了你的名義，很抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Without it, they would never have approved you.
They would have claimed that you had made things worse.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
不這麼說，他們根本不會批准你來。
他們只會說你把事情弄得更糟。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
Let's talk about the operation ... Is your name Philopontess?
We are cooperating now, so may I tell you my opinion?
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
說說行動安排吧...你叫菲洛龐泰絲？
既然現在是合作關係，我可以談談我的看法嗎？

scripts.text:
[Tess]
Of course.
And please call me Tess.
The Rebellion will be in charge of the military operation. But ...
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
當然可以。
叫我泰絲就好。
軍事行動由反叛者負責，不過...

scripts.text:
[Tess]
In terms of strategy, we are superior.
And we only have a single chance. So you are welcome to give us a good idea.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
戰略方面我們佔優勢。
但我們只有一次機會，所以歡迎你提出好建議。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Wow, he sure has a big mouth~
If my sister Elena heard it, she might have shot him in the head!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
哇，他可真會說大話~
要是我姐姐埃琳娜聽見，恐怕早就一槍崩了他！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
We've picked out the combatants. Since this operation is confidential, we selected those who we can fully trust.
And the investigation of the buildings and geographical features?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
作戰人員已經選好了。行動是機密，所以我們只挑了絕對信得過的人。
那麼，建築和地形的調查呢？

scripts.text:
[Tess]
Of course, we have provided it.
We have been investigating this place for quite a long time.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
當然已經準備好了。
我們調查這裡很久了。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
I read the document.
The funny thing is here ... I don't know why. But there is
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
我看過資料。
奇怪的是...我也說不上來，但這裡...

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
no retreat path in the area where the facility is located.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
這處設施所在區域沒有撤退路線。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Hmm. Then all we have to do is get in there and block the only entrance?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
嗯。那我們只要進去，封鎖唯一的入口就行了？

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
They might have installed a gate for teleport. We must disable it first.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
他們可能設定了傳送門，我們得先讓它失效。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
We must do it quickly, so that the enemy cannot take any countermeasures even if they recognize it.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
必須迅速行動，免得敵人察覺後採取對策。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Leave it to us!
The Rebellion hasn't just been napping.
Then the rest here are all surplus manpower?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
交給我們吧！
反叛者可不是一直在睡大覺。
那留在這裡的人都是預備隊嗎？

scripts.text:
[Tess]
Did you say 'surplus'!?
Have you already forgotten who provided this information?
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
“多餘”？你說這種話！？
你忘了這份情報是誰提供的嗎？

scripts.text: ... The meeting is getting too long.
scripts.translation: ...這會議開得也太久了。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Hmm ... It's boring, isn't it?
Things have been decided to some degree.
I won't be able to help you directly.
I'm here to watch Nihil.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
嗯...無聊吧？
事情已經大致談妥了。
我沒法直接幫你們。
我來這裡是為了監督尼希爾。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
What you have to concentrate on in this facility is the central room.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
在這處設施裡，你們要重點調查的是中央房間。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
What you are looking for might be in the place called the ^4d4dffcentral room^000000.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
你們要找的東西可能就在^4d4dff中央房間^000000。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
I stepped in to ensure a safe, successful procedure. But actually, we had already provided you with everything we can.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
我介入是為了確保行動安全順利。不過，我們已經把能提供的都給你們了。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
{0}, once the Rebellion occupies the laboratory, you have to rush to the central room faster than anyone else.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
{0}，反叛者一旦佔領實驗室，你就要搶在所有人前面衝進中央房間。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
And there ... you will find it.
I have a strong feeling that it is here.
I am counting on you.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
在那裡...你會找到它。
我有強烈的預感，它就在那兒。
拜託你了。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Now let's get going.
It will be dark soon.
It's the end of the week, so security might not be so tight.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
出發吧。
天快黑了。
而且快到週末了，警戒可能沒那麼嚴。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
The location is ^4d4dffOperation Spot in one o'clock, Northern field in Einbroch^000000.
In the field, please cooperate with the Rebellion.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
行動地點是^4d4dff艾音布羅克北部原野的一點鐘方向^000000。
到了原野後，請配合反叛者行動。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
The exact ^4d4dffcoordinates of the operation spot are 280, 332^000000. The person in charge of the operation may be ... ^4d4dffJulian^000000.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
行動地點的精確^4d4dff座標是280, 332^000000。負責人可能是...^4d4dff朱利安^000000。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Go find Julian!
Of course I'm going too.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
去找朱利安！
當然，我也會去。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
... Don't forget.
You absolutely must reach the central room and find the ^4d4dffTerra Gloria^000000.
I wish you fortune in war.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
...別忘了。
一定要抵達中央房間，找到^4d4dff泰拉格洛麗亞^000000。
祝你旗開得勝。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
I will take a chance and participate.
Take care of yourself!
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
我也冒險進去幫忙。
多保重！

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
... Don't forget.
You absolutely must reach the central room and find the ^4d4dffTerra Gloria^000000.
I wish you fortune in war.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
...別忘了。
一定要抵達中央房間，找到^4d4dff泰拉格洛麗亞^000000。
祝你旗開得勝。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
The location is ^4d4dffOperation Spot in one o'clock, Northern field in Einbroch^000000.
In the field, please cooperate with the Rebellion.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
行動地點是^4d4dff艾音布羅克北部原野的一點鐘方向^000000。
到了原野後，請配合反叛者行動。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Well, it seems like everyone is here. Maybe I can step out?
From now on, Rookie, the heron emeritus agent, will handle it!
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
看來人都到齊了，我是不是可以撤了？
接下來交給新人吧，我這隻退役的蒼鷺特工就功成身退啦！

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
I've done my job~
Now I'm counting on Rookie!
I'm on vacation from now on!
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
我的任務完成啦~
接下來就拜託你了，新人！
我從現在開始休假！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Most of the squadron will be standing by in the operation spot.
They will take a chance to start it, right?
I think they will get in when it gets dark ...
scripts.translation:
[新人]
大部分隊員會在行動地點待命。
等機會一到，他們就會動手，對吧？
我想他們會趁天黑潛入...

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Let's get there before it's too late.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
趁還來得及，我們趕緊過去。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
I will be in the shade.
Oh~ I'm excited to use a sword after such a long time!
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
我會躲在暗處。
啊~好久沒用劍了，真讓人興奮！

scripts.text:
[Tess]
The location is ^4d4dffOperation Spot in one o'clock, Northern field in Einbroch^000000.
In the field, please cooperate with the Rebellion.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
行動地點是^4d4dff艾音布羅克北部原野的一點鐘方向^000000。
到了原野後，請配合反叛者行動。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
... I really hate training ...
scripts.translation:
[新人]
...我最討厭訓練了...

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
^4d4dffJulian^000000 is the person in charge of the operation here.
Please go and ask him.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
^4d4dff朱利安^000000是這裡的行動負責人。
去找他吧。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
They are like rats in a trap. All we have to do is the cleanup~ I'm going in, too.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
他們就像甕中之鱉，剩下的只是清理工作~我也要進去。

scripts.text: Good. I'm counting on you.
scripts.translation: 好，拜託你了

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
It's natural.
You haven't found that thing you were looking for yet.
I will let you go. Could you just find that thing?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
那是當然。
你還沒找到要找的東西吧？
我放你進去，先把那東西找出來好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
As they occupied this place, they are remodeling some of the routes to make a training camp.
... Oh ... I hate it already.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
他們佔領這裡後，正在改造部分通道，準備當作訓練場。
...唉...我已經開始討厭這裡了。

scripts.text: Enter the military base.
scripts.translation: 進入軍事基地

scripts.text: Good. I'm counting on you.
scripts.translation: 好，拜託你了

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Oh ... arg ...

[Rookie]
There are still come remnants inside the research facilities.
Actually ... they are more like monsters.
Anyway, take care of yourself.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
研究設施裡還有些殘黨...
其實...更像是魔物。
總之，小心點。

scripts.text: - Cannot progress with quest because you have too many items in your possession. -
scripts.translation: - 你的物品欄裡東西太多，無法繼續任務。 -

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
The ^4d4dffcentral area^000000 seems to be located in this laboratory, ^4d4dffdeep inside the building's basement^000000.
Since we, the Rebellion, have completely occupied this place, please feel free to go there.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
^4d4dff中央區域^000000似乎在這座實驗室裡，^4d4dff位於建築物地下深處^000000。
反叛者已經完全控制了這裡，你儘管進去吧。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Teleport?
They cannot use it.
We have blocked it.
Actually, it's something we had never thought of ...
scripts.translation:
[新人]
傳送？
他們用不了。
我們已經封鎖了。
其實這辦法我們以前也沒想到...

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
The man with shiny blonde hair told me to block magic related to movement as well.
Well, I know that the magic is more common in Rune Midgarts. Isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
那個金髮男人還讓我封鎖所有移動魔法。
嗯，我聽說這類魔法在盧恩·米德加茲很常見，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
After all, I hope you will find what you are looking for as soon as possible.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
總之，希望你儘快找到要找的東西。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Wow, welcome back.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
哇，歡迎回來。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
I heard a loud sound inside the central room. I tried to get in there, but it had already been blocked.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
我聽見中央房間裡傳來一聲巨響，想進去看看，但入口已經被封住了。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Right. I was bounced out by an unknown force and could not defend the entrance until the end.
I am sorry.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
是啊，我被一股不明力量彈開了，沒能守住入口。
抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
... What on earth was it?
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
...那到底是什麼？

scripts.text:
[Skia]
On my god ... Seyren Windsor?
And you've found it?
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
天哪...塞倫·溫莎？
你找到它了？

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Then we must go back quickly.
Our mission is completed.
Let's go back to the hotel first.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
那我們得趕緊回去。
任務完成了。
先回旅館吧。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Yeah. The rest of it is our task.
There are still plenty of monster experimental subjects inside, but
That's what we have to contend with.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
嗯，剩下的交給我們。
裡面還有很多魔物實驗體，
但那些就由我們來處理。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Damn, go away!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
可惡，滾開！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Oh, I hate it here.
I want to go back to our hidout soon.
Shall we get out of here?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
唉，我討厭這裡。
真想趕緊回據點。
要離開這裡嗎？

scripts.text: Leave.
scripts.translation: 離開

scripts.text: Stay.
