scripts.translation: 留下

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Hmm, are you the type of person who looks for trouble?
Well, we appreciate it if you help us clean up the remnants.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
嗯，你是喜歡自找麻煩的人嗎？
不過你願意幫忙清理殘黨，我們很感激。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Follow me, then.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
那跟我來。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Shall we leave now?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
現在要離開嗎？

scripts.text: About the monster in the central room
scripts.translation: 關於中央房間裡的魔物

scripts.text: Leave.
scripts.translation: 離開

scripts.text: Stay.
scripts.translation: 留下

scripts.text: About YSF01
scripts.translation: 關於YSF01

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Follow me, then.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
那跟我來。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Since this fuss is likely to continue for a while, we'd be glad if you would stay here and help us~
scripts.translation:
[新人]
這場騷亂恐怕還會持續一陣子。你願意留下來幫忙的話，我們會很感激~

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Why did Werner do that?
I don't understand.
... No. Maybe it's weird to understand a lunatic.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
維爾納為什麼要這麼做？
我不明白。
...不，想弄懂瘋子的想法本來就很奇怪。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Anyways, We have to observe the central room's core.
As long as there are magic inside, the same thing will happen again.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
總之，我們得監視中央房間的核心。
只要裡面還有魔力，同樣的事情就會再次發生。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Welcome.
Without any further ado,
We would like to hunt the ^4d4dffpet child^000000 guy. Will you join us?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
歡迎。
我就直說了，
我們想獵殺那個^4d4dff小可愛^000000，願意加入嗎？

scripts.text: I am the pet child hunter!
scripts.translation: 我是小可愛獵人！

scripts.text: Reject!
scripts.translation: 拒絕！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
No, why?
It's just a monster!
We just have to kill it!
Then who should we ask to do it?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
為什麼不行？
它只是一隻魔物！
殺掉它就行了！
那我們還能找誰幫忙？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Let's reveal its secret!
Let's find out why it keeps showing up!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
揭開它的秘密吧！
查清它為什麼一直出現！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
It's in the central room. The place full of strange spirits in the middle of the central room.
Let me open the door for you first.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
它就在中央房間裡，那個滿是奇怪精靈的地方。
我先替你開門。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Great! You're so cool!
Was it a replication of the former experimental subject? Self-replication?
They haven't found out the exact mechanism yet.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
太棒了！真厲害！
那是先前實驗體的複製品嗎？會自我複製？
他們還沒弄清楚具體機制。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Anyhow, thank you for your support.
We will count on you again next time.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
總之，多謝你幫忙。
下次還得拜託你。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
The same monster is regenerated every single day. Isn't it a bit odd?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
每天都會出現同一種魔物，不覺得奇怪嗎？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Maybe this guy is one of the objects that were split by transplanting the hearts of Ymir ...
scripts.translation:
[新人]
也許這傢伙是移植伊米爾之心後分裂出來的個體之一...

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Anyway, let's see if that guy shows up again.
It's so~ interesting.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
總之，看看那傢伙會不會再出現吧。
真是太~有趣了。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Did you call it a pet child?
Seems like they are completely leaving that guy to the adventurer
scripts.translation:
[新人]
你叫它“小可愛”？
看來他們把這傢伙全交給冒險者處理了。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
If you want, do not hesitate to tell me any time.
I will give you a mission to kill the pet child.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
想接任務的話隨時告訴我。
我會交給你獵殺小可愛的任務。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion squadder]
Do you want me to send you out of the operation zone?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者隊員]
要我送你離開行動區域嗎？

scripts.text: Leave.
scripts.translation: 離開

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text:
[Rebellion squadder]
Well, good luck.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者隊員]
好，祝你順利。

scripts.text: - Cannot progress with quest because you have too many items in your possession. -
scripts.translation: - 你的物品欄裡東西太多，無法繼續任務。 -

scripts.text:
[Tess]
... How many more facilities like this are there in Schwaltzvalt?
Haa ...
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
...施瓦茨瓦爾特還有多少這樣的設施？
唉...

scripts.text:
[Tess]
Fortunately, the letter seems to have arrived.
There is a reward that we prepared for you but we have not given it to you yet. So I sent this letter to invite you.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
幸好信似乎已經送到了。
我們早就為你準備了獎勵，卻一直沒機會給你，所以才寄信邀請你過來。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
And our president said that his excellency would grant you enough compensation if you continue to help us get rid of the unwanted experimental subjects.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
總統說，如果你願意繼續幫忙清除那些不需要的實驗體，他會給你相應的報酬。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
As you helped our republic, his excellency is trying to get you some useful stuff for adventurers.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
你幫了共和國的忙，總統正想給你準備些冒險者用得上的東西。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
The ^4d4dffSchwartz Honor Token^000000 that I am about to give you is a sort of reward currency used in the Rebellion as well.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
我接下來給你的^4d4dff施瓦茨榮譽徽章^000000，也是反叛者使用的一種獎勵貨幣。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
Since you are an adventurer, we thought it would be helpful for you.
You can exchange it for an item you need.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
你是冒險者，拿著它應該能派上用場。
可以用來兌換你需要的物品。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
You may have received it already through the Rebellion.
Since this token is a prize for someone who did a job for Schwaltzvalt ...
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
你可能已經從反叛者那裡領過這種徽章了。
這是給幫助施瓦茨瓦爾特完成任務之人的獎勵...

scripts.text:
[Tess]
If you want, you can receive them by continuing to help us.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
只要繼續幫我們，就能再得到一些。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
So, we would like to give you simple requests or missions.
This kind of association is likely to continue for a while.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
所以我們想委託你一些簡單的差事或任務。
這種合作恐怕還會持續一陣子。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
Thank you for your support in advance.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
先謝謝你的協助。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
Since there are still some researchers hiding inside the laboratory, we plan to investigate it.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
實驗室裡還有一些研究員躲著，我們打算繼續搜查。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
Please take charge of the investigation.
If you do this for us, we will give you the Schwartz Honor Token.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
請負責調查。
完成後，我們會給你施瓦茨榮譽徽章。

scripts.text: Accept.
scripts.translation: 接受

scripts.text: Reject.
scripts.translation: 拒絕

scripts.text:
[Tess]
Not now?
Then get some rest and come back please.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
現在不方便嗎？
那就先休息一下，之後再來吧。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
Since we don't know where they are hiding, start looking in corners such as cabinets and boxes.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
我們不知道他們藏在哪裡，先找找櫃子、箱子之類的角落。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
After finding researchers, please hand them over to a Rebellion squad member near you.
Thank you for your support in advance.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
找到研究員後，請把他們交給附近的反叛者隊員。
先謝謝你的協助。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
Inside the laboratory, there are still some researchers hiding somewhere.
Please find them and hand them over to a Rebellion squad member.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
實驗室裡還有研究員藏著。
請找到他們，交給反叛者隊員。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
Thank you for your support in advance.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
先謝謝你的協助。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
We already heard of your performance from the Rebellion.
Thank you for cooperating with the republic.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
反叛者已經告訴我們你的表現了。
感謝你協助共和國。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
We attacked them all of a sudden, and we expect more of them are still hiding. But we will find them sooner or later.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
我們突然發動襲擊，估計還有不少人藏著。不過遲早會把他們找出來。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
We attacked them all of a sudden, and we expect more of them are still hiding.
We will try to find those guys for now.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
我們突然發動襲擊，估計還有不少人藏著。
眼下先把他們找出來。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
If possible, I would ask you to investigate again.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
方便的話，想請你再調查一次。

scripts.text: Leave it to me.
scripts.translation: 交給我吧

scripts.text: No thank you.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝

scripts.text:
[Tess]
.......
Then we cannot afford it.
... No, no.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
...
那我們可承擔不起。
...不，不是那樣。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
You're so cool, as usual.
Then could you please find the dregs hiding deep inside the laboratory and shaking like leaves?
I mean, the researchers.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
你真可靠。
能不能請你找出躲在實驗室深處、嚇得發抖的那些傢伙？
我是說研究員。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
As usual, please find the researchers who are hiding and hand them over to a Rebellion squad member.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
照舊，找到躲起來的研究員後，把他們交給反叛者隊員。

scripts.text:
[Yudmil]
No ... why did I volunteer for this?
scripts.translation:
[尤德米爾]
不...我當初為什麼要主動報名？

scripts.text: What's wrong with the Gunslinger?
scripts.translation: 槍手怎麼了？

scripts.text:
[Yudmil]
Gunslinger is a place made by the Rebellion to train the upcoming generation, so they have a close relationship.
scripts.translation:
[尤德米爾]
槍手訓練營是反叛者培養新一代成員的地方，雙方關係很密切。

scripts.text:
[Yudmil]
I heard that there was special training with the Rebellion so I volunteered. And what am I doing now?
I never imagined that I would be sent to this laboratory full of monsters!
scripts.translation:
[尤德米爾]
聽說反叛者有特別訓練，我就主動報名了。結果我現在在做什麼？
我做夢也沒想到會被派到這座滿是魔物的實驗室！

scripts.text:
[Yudmil]
Arrrgh, especially Ms. Elena ... She makes us suffer ...
scripts.translation:
[尤德米爾]
啊...尤其是埃琳娜小姐...她把我們折騰慘了...

scripts.text: - Cannot progress with quest because you have too many items in your possession. -
scripts.translation: - 由於您持有的物品過多，無法繼續任務。-

scripts.text:
[Yuslan]
Inside the laboratory, there is pandemonium due to the experimental subjects that broke out.
Although we kill them, more of them come out from somewhere. I came out rest for a while.
scripts.translation:
[尤斯蘭]
實驗體逃出來後，實驗室裡一片混亂。
我們殺掉一批，又有更多從不知哪裡冒出來。我出來歇口氣。

scripts.text: Help him defeat Chimeras.
scripts.translation: 幫他擊敗凱美拉

scripts.text: Wish him good luck.
scripts.translation: 祝他好運

scripts.text:
[Yuslan]
Well ... Yeah. This is a part of training, too. Phew.
scripts.translation:
[尤斯蘭]
嗯...沒錯，這也是訓練的一部分。呼。

scripts.text:
[Yuslan]
Then, please kill 10 of each
^4d4dffMaterial type Chimeras^000000 and
^4d4dffHuman type Chimeras^000000
wandering around in the laboratory!
scripts.translation:
[尤斯蘭]
請去擊敗在實驗室裡遊蕩的^4d4dff物質型凱美拉^000000和^4d4dff人型凱美拉^000000，各10只！

scripts.text:
[Yuslan]
Thanks to your support, we can pause for breath!
Cheer up, Adventurer!
scripts.translation:
[尤斯蘭]
多虧你幫忙，我們總算能喘口氣了！加油，冒險者！

scripts.text:
[Yuslan]
Just defeat 10 of each type. That's all I ask.
They are ^4d4dffMaterial type Chimeras and Human type Chimeras.^000000
scripts.translation:
[尤斯蘭]
每種擊敗10只就行了。
分別是^4d4dff物質型凱美拉和人型凱美拉^000000。

scripts.text:
[Yuslan]
... The In Vivo Experiment is really horrible.
scripts.translation:
[尤斯蘭]
...活體實驗真是太可怕了。

scripts.text:
[Yuslan]
Wow, you did a great job for us!
Thank you.
Thanks to your support, we managed to get a good rest.
scripts.translation:
[尤斯蘭]
哇，你幫了我們大忙！
謝謝你。
多虧你，我們總算能好好休息了。

scripts.text:
[Yuslan]
Please be with us next time!
scripts.translation:
[尤斯蘭]
下次也請來幫忙！

scripts.text:
[Yuslan]
Hey, thank you for your great job.
But there are still more monsters inside.
We are trying our best to get rid of them. But honestly, it's tough.
scripts.translation:
[尤斯蘭]
嘿，幹得漂亮，謝謝你。
不過裡面還有很多魔物。
我們正在努力清理，但說實話，實在難對付。

scripts.text:
[Yuslan]
Where do all of these experimental subjects come from?
scripts.translation:
[尤斯蘭]
這些實驗體到底是從哪兒冒出來的？

scripts.text:
[Yuslan]
They come out continuously. I can't imagine how many experiments they conducted.
I mean, Chimeras.
scripts.translation:
[尤斯蘭]
它們不停地出現，真不敢想他們做了多少實驗。
我是說凱美拉。

scripts.text:
[Yuslan]
I never imagined that Chimeras would be tougher than Heart Hunters ...
scripts.translation:
[尤斯蘭]
我真沒想到凱美拉比心之獵手還難對付...

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Don't pick a fight with USU recklessly.
When people start fighting, I'll be the only one who feels annoyed.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
別隨便跟USU的人起衝突。
真打起來，最後煩心的只有我。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Although I leashed them, they keep thinking about running out ...
Maybe their brains are filled with gunpowder. Silly weirdos.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
我明明把他們拴住了，他們還是一直想著溜出去...
腦子裡大概全是火藥吧，一群怪人。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Cookie? I don't like sweets.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
綠餅人？我不愛吃甜食。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Lebedev guys baked it...
Then, I have no choice but to taste it. Give it to me.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
列別捷夫那群人烤的啊...
那我只能嚐嚐了。拿來。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
...Why are you empty-handed? Where is the cookie?
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
...你怎麼空著手？餅乾呢？

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
It smells good.
Seems like they gave a great effort. Tell them thanks.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
聞起來不錯。
看來他們很用心，替我謝謝他們。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Wait, who are you?
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
等等，你是誰？

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
I haven't seen you before.
You can't be in this place. Strangers like you are not supposed to be here.
^FF0000>>>Snap<<<^000000
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
我以前沒見過你。
你不該出現在這裡。陌生人不能進來。
^FF0000>>>弓身彈影<<<^000000

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Tell me exactly how you got here and where you came from unless you want to die.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
除非你想送命，否則就老實交代你怎麼進來的、從哪裡來的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I am... You revealed you're an adventurer who came to help Secret Wings and requested cooperation to the Rebellion.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我...你發現自己是來協助秘密之翼的冒險者，並請求反叛者合作。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Secret Wings? They are just rookies. All they do is suck up to the president.
You're so brave. Who told you to visit me?
I don't want to dance to chicks flapping their wings. Just go away.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
秘密之翼？不過是一群菜鳥，整天只會討好總統。
你膽子倒不小。誰讓你來見我的？
我可不想被那些乳臭未乾的小丫頭擺佈。滾吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, wait please. In fact, I... no, my companion...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不，等等！其實是我...不，是我的同伴...

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Your companion saved Gonie?
...... So? You want a reward?
I really hate those who try to use other's lives as they please.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
你的同伴救了戈尼？
...所以呢，想要報酬？
我最討厭拿別人的性命當籌碼的人。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Well... I have a better idea.
Unlike the wimp chatting downstairs, you look quite interesting.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
嗯...我倒有個更好的主意。
你可比樓下那個只會瞎聊的軟蛋有意思多了。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
You said you were just an adventurer, didn't you?
Great. If you defeat me in a fight, I will listen to your story.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
你說自己只是個冒險者，對吧？
很好，打贏我，我就聽你說。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Pardon?

[USU commander Elena]
Let's fight! I will listen to someone who fights me.
Talk to me when you are ready. Then I will let you enter the waiting room of the arena.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
來打一場！我只聽能和我交手的人說話。
準備好後再來找我，我會讓你進競技場候場室。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Should I fight you all of a sudden? Well, I don't feel like...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
突然就要打架？可是我不太想...

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
If you don't want to fight, I guess you don't need any cooperation. Go back.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
不想打的話，那你也不需要我們的合作。回去吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(I'm in trouble. What shall I do?)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
（糟了，我該怎麼辦？）

scripts.text: Fight Elena.
scripts.translation: 和埃琳娜交手

scripts.text: I don't listen to someone weaker than me.
scripts.translation: 我不聽弱者說話

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(I have no choice. Let's prepare for the fight and talk to Elena Volkova again.)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
（沒辦法了。準備好戰鬥，再去找埃琳娜·沃爾科娃。）

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I don't listen to someone weaker than m...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我不聽弱者說話...

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Hmm? I misheard something. Haha, could you repeat it?
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
嗯？我好像聽錯了。哈哈，再說一遍好嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes... I'll do it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧...我去就是了。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Great. Tell me when you are ready.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
很好。準備好了就告訴我。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Are you ready?
Shall we go to the waiting room now?
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
準備好了嗎？
現在去候場室嗎？

scripts.text: Go to the waiting room
scripts.translation: 去候場室

scripts.text: Don't go to the waiting room.
scripts.translation: 不去候場室

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
In the waiting room, there is ^0000CDIvan, the person in charge of entrance in arena^000000.
Enter the arena according to the order in reference to Ivan's guide.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
候場室裡有負責競技場入場的^0000CD伊萬^000000。
按伊萬的指引依次入場。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
You have two minutes. If you defeat me during two minutes, you win.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
你有兩分鐘。兩分鐘內擊敗我就算你贏。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
If you want to surrender during the fight, tell ^0000CDSorita^000000 beside Ivan.
Then you're going to be told off.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
如果戰鬥中想投降，就告訴伊萬旁邊的^0000CD索麗塔^000000。
之後你可要挨訓了。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Hmm... By the way, are you really going to fight me?
I am an expert in killing people. And fighting is not your main occupation. You cannot beat me.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
嗯...你真的要跟我打嗎？
我可是殺人專家，而戰鬥又不是你的本行。你贏不了我的。

scripts.text: But I will fight.
scripts.translation: 但我還是要打

scripts.text: I agree with you. I give up.
scripts.translation: 我聽你的，認輸

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Good. Knowing one's limit is wise.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
很好，懂得量力而行才明智。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
You're a cleric. Fighting is not your duty. I'm sure your companion also knows that.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
你是牧師，戰鬥不是你的職責。我想你的同伴也明白。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Besides, you're just an adventurer. You have no business with us and those guys either. I'm afraid you might get hurt.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
況且你只是個冒險者，和我們、和那些人都沒有關係。我不想看你受傷。

scripts.text: No, I will fight.
scripts.translation: 不，我要打

scripts.text: ...I think you're right. I give up.
scripts.translation: ...你說得對，我認輸

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
You're wise. You don't have to get hurt yourself being nosy.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
你很明智。別多管閒事，害自己受傷。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
You must a fool who doesn't know what's going on.
Do you think I'm kidding? Or your life is too heavy and you'd like to put everything down?
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
你一定是個不知天高地厚的傻瓜。
你以為我在開玩笑？還是活膩了，想把一切都放下？

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
This is the final warning. You stay out of this.
Tell the guy downstairs that you had no choice because I intimidated you.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
這是最後一次警告，別插手這件事。
告訴樓下那傢伙，是我威脅你，你才不得不放棄。

scripts.text: This is my problem too.
scripts.translation: 這也是我的事

scripts.text: Since I don't want to die, I give up.
scripts.translation: 我還不想死，認輸

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
You're wise. Life is important, especially when it's mine.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
你很明智。生命很重要，尤其是我的命。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
...Why is this your problem?
That talkative guy is a stooge of the President. But you're an adventurer who can just leave.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
...這關你什麼事？
那個話癆是總統的走狗，你不過是個想走就能走的冒險者。

scripts.text: This is the problem of those who trust me.
scripts.translation: 這是信任我的人的事

scripts.text: I guess I'd better go.
scripts.translation: 我還是走吧

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
You're wise. Enjoy your adventure in a safer place.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
你很明智。去更安全的地方繼續冒險吧。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Well, well, well.
Haha, you are so obstinate.
I like your spirit. You said you need a cooperation? Why not? I agree.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
哎呀...哈哈，你還真固執。
我喜歡有膽識的人。你說想和我們合作？行啊，我答應。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh... Pardon?!

[USU commander Elena]
You said you needed my approval to persuade us. So I approve it.
I like spunky fellows. It's fun to fight with them.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
你說需要我的認可，好說服他們。那我認可就是了。
我喜歡有膽量的人，和他們交手很有意思。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Ah, don't misunderstand it. I'm not saying I will fight you. I'm saying that I will be on your side.
I didn't mean to fight you anyway.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
啊，別誤會。我不是說要和你打，而是會站在你這邊。
我本來也沒打算和你交手。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
I don't mess with clerics. I don't feel good after fighting them.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
我不和牧師動手。打完他們，我那天的運氣總會變差。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
So I'll support the cooperation with the Secret Wings. Do you need my signature?
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
所以我支援和秘密之翼合作。需要我簽字嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, you don't have to. Please show your opinion in front of others next time.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不用。下次請當著大家的面表明態度。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
No problem.
Since you are our cooperator now, go around and see if there is anyone who has any problem.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
沒問題。
既然現在是我們的合作者，就四處看看有沒有人遇到麻煩。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Who knows? If you keep helping them, they might have good feeling about you.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
誰知道呢？你要是一直幫他們，他們說不定會對你有好感。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
While we never forget the blood that we must take a revenge for, we do not forget the gratitude either.
If you help them, they will give you a token proving your honor.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
我們不會忘記該報的血仇，也不會忘記別人的恩情。
你幫了他們，他們會給你一枚榮譽證明。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Just like the one I'm giving you now.
If you want to know what this is for, ask the stubborn guy named 'Strasse' below the stairs.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
就像我現在給你的這枚。
想知道它有什麼用，就去樓梯下找那個叫“斯特拉瑟”的固執傢伙問問。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Aren't you going to fight me?
Haven't you come here to ask for the cooperation between the Secret Wings and Rebellion?
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
不跟我打了嗎？
你不是來請求秘密之翼和反叛者合作的嗎？

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Will you give up the fight?
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
要放棄戰鬥嗎？

scripts.text: Give up the fight.
scripts.translation: 放棄戰鬥

scripts.text: Do not give up the fight.
scripts.translation: 繼續戰鬥

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Good. I will wait for you.
Tell me when you feel like fighting.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
好，我等你。
想打的時候再來找我。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
...... Hmm.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
...嗯。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
A coward who's scared at me won't be helpful for the Rebellion at all.
Get lost.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
連和我交手都害怕的人，幫不了反叛者。
滾吧。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
... Hmm. So this is it.
If you want to fight me again, I will give you another chance.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
...嗯，原來如此。
還想再和我打的話，我可以再給你一次機會。

scripts.text: Enter the waiting room.
scripts.translation: 進入候場室

scripts.text: Do not enter the waiting room.
scripts.translation: 不進候場室

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Great. You have guts.
Ivan will guide you inside.
If you want to surrender during a fight, tell Sorita.
Let's do it!
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
很好，有膽量。
伊萬會帶你進去。
想在戰鬥中投降，就告訴索麗塔。
來吧！

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Aren't you going to fight me?
Haven't you come here to ask for the cooperation with the Rebellion?
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
不跟我打了嗎？
你不是來請求和反叛者合作的嗎？

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Will you give up the fight?
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
要放棄戰鬥嗎？

scripts.text: Give up the fight.
scripts.translation: 放棄戰鬥

scripts.text: Do not give up the fight.
scripts.translation: 繼續戰鬥

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Good. I will wait for you.
Tell me when you feel like fighting.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
好，我等你。
想打的時候再來找我。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
...... Hmm.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
...嗯。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
A coward who's scared at me won't be helpful for the Rebellion at all.
Get lost.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
連和我交手都害怕的人，幫不了反叛者。
滾吧。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Haha! I lost.
My feeling was right. It was such a thrilling fight after a long time!
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
哈哈！我輸了。
我的直覺果然沒錯。好久沒打得這麼痛快了！

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
As I promised, I will listen to you. Go ahead.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
我說話算話，會聽你說的。講吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(So she's listening to me now. Persuading her will be much more difficult.)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
（她現在肯聽我說了。要說服她恐怕更難。）

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. I have come to request a cooperation between the Secret Wings and the Rebellion.
In order to persuade the people of Rebellions, I would like to ask you for help...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的，我是來請求秘密之翼和反叛者合作的。
為了說服反叛者，我想請你幫忙...

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Okay. I will help you.
What should I do?
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
好，我幫你。
需要我做什麼？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Pardon? You haven't heard my story yet...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
什麼？你還沒聽我說完呢...

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
You don't have to tell me the story. You've already told me the story physically. If I can fight on the same side with you, I will welcome whatever it is.
So I support the cooperation with the Secret Wings. Do you need my signature?
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
不用你解釋。剛才交手時，你已經用行動說明了一切。只要能和你並肩作戰，我什麼都願意。
所以我支援和秘密之翼合作。需要我簽字嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, you don't have to. Please show your opinion in front of others next time.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不用。下次請當著大家的面表明態度。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Good. ...... By the way,
If you have time, visit the arena any time.
I will fight you even if you come every day.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
很好。...對了，
有空就來競技場找我。
你每天來，我每天都奉陪。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Since you are our cooperator now, go around and see if there is anyone who has any problem.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
既然現在是我們的合作者，就四處看看有沒有人遇到麻煩。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Who knows? If you keep helping them, they might have good feeling about you.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
誰知道呢？你要是一直幫他們，他們說不定會對你有好感。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
While we never forget the blood that we must take a revenge for, we do not forget the gratitude either.
If you help them, they will give you a token proving your honor.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
我們不會忘記該報的血仇，也不會忘記別人的恩情。
你幫了他們，他們會給你一枚榮譽證明。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Just like the one I'm giving you now.
If you want to know what this is for, ask the stubborn guy named 'Strasse' below the stairs.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
就像我現在給你的這枚。
想知道它有什麼用，就去樓梯下找那個叫“斯特拉瑟”的固執傢伙問問。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Hi. What is it now?
Have you met our members?
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
嗨，怎麼了？
你見過我們的成員了嗎？

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Hi. What is it now?
A fight? Welcome!
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
嗨，怎麼了？
想打架？好啊！

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
...... Hmm.
Are you sure you have to fight me now?
If you really think so, come back tomorrow. I called it a day now.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
...嗯。
你確定現在要和我打？
真想打的話，明天再來吧。我今天收工了。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
...... Hmm.
No. Not now.
I would like to fight you when you are in the top condition. Come back tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
...嗯。
今天不行。
我想等你狀態最好的時候再交手。明天來吧。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Oh, great!
Tell me when you are fully ready. I will go to the waiting room.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
哦，太好了！
準備妥當後告訴我，我會去候場室。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Hmm...?
I told you. I don't fight clerics.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
嗯...？
我說過，我不和牧師打。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I would like to fight you! Please allow me!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我想和你交手！請答應我！

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Oh, every time I beat the hell out of a cleric, I become quite unlucky on that day. It's true.
So I'd rather not fight a cleric...
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
唉，每次把牧師打得落花流水，我那天就會倒霉。這是真的。
所以我還是不想和牧師打...

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
............
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
...

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
...Huh, look at your eyes. I have no choice but to fight you.
But I will ^0000CDgo very easy on^000000 you. Don't make drama after you defeat me.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
...呵，看看你的眼神。我只好跟你打了。
不過我^0000CD會手下留情^000000。你輸了可別演得太誇張。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Are you ready?
Shall we go to the waiting room now?
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
準備好了嗎？
現在去候場室嗎？

scripts.text: Go to the waiting room
scripts.translation: 去候場室

scripts.text: Don't go to the waiting room.
scripts.translation: 不去候場室

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
In the waiting room, there is ^0000CDIvan, the person in charge of entrance in arena^000000.
Enter the arena according to the order in reference to Ivan's guide.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
候場室裡有負責安排競技場入場的^0000CD伊萬^000000。
按伊萬的指引依次入場。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
You have two minutes. If you defeat me during two minutes, you win.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
你有兩分鐘。只要在兩分鐘內打敗我，就算你贏。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
If you want to surrender during the fight, tell ^0000CDSorita^000000 beside Ivan.
Then you're going to be told off.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
如果戰鬥中想投降，就告訴伊萬旁邊的^0000CD索麗塔^000000。
不過之後會挨訓。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Aren't you going to fight me?
Hm...
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
不跟我打了嗎？
嗯...

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Will you give up the fight?
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
要放棄戰鬥嗎？

scripts.text: Give up the fight.
scripts.translation: 放棄戰鬥

scripts.text: Do not give up the fight.
scripts.translation: 繼續戰鬥

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Great, I will be waiting.
I enjoy fighting you.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
好，我等你。
我很喜歡和你交手。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
As I told you, you don't have to do this... You're so persistent.
Well, I remember I told you that I like it.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
我說過你不必非這麼做...還真執著。
不過，我記得自己說過喜歡這一點。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
...You made me expect it. And what are you doing now?
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
...害我還期待了一下。結果你在做什麼？

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Good idea. You'll be quite sad if you are beat up without having done anything wrong. Won't you?
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
這主意不錯。要是你明明沒做錯事，卻被打了一頓，肯定會很委屈吧？

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Don't you think you've had enough of it by now? If you want to quit, tell me any time.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
你還沒受夠嗎？想退出的話隨時告訴我。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
...Hmm. You're not in a top condition?
If you want to do this again, welcome.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
...嗯，狀態不太好嗎？
想再挑戰的話，隨時歡迎。

scripts.text: Enter the waiting room.
scripts.translation: 進入候場室

scripts.text: Do not enter the waiting room.
scripts.translation: 不進候場室

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Ho, you have the guts.
Ivan will guide you inside.
If you want to surrender, tell Sorita.
Let's do it!
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
呵，有膽量。
伊萬會帶你進去。
想投降就告訴索麗塔。
來吧！

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
I like it.
Ivan will guide you inside.
If you want to surrender, tell Sorita.
Let's do it!
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
我喜歡。
伊萬會帶你進去。
想投降就告訴索麗塔。
開始吧！

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
You're not in a top condition? Go inside and take some rest.
Shall we stop?
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
狀態不好嗎？進去休息一下吧。
還要繼續嗎？

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
You're not in a top condition?
Take care of yourself.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
狀態不太好嗎？
照顧好自己。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Don't make me feel sorry for you.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
別讓我替你感到難堪。

scripts.text: Give up the fight.
scripts.translation: 放棄戰鬥

scripts.text: Do not give up the fight.
scripts.translation: 繼續戰鬥

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Hey, you don't have to do this...
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
喂，你沒必要非得這樣...

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Great, I will be waiting.
I enjoy fighting you.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
好，我等著。
我很喜歡和你交手。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Right. Let's stop the fight.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
好吧，結束戰鬥。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
...We have no choice. Come back later.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
...看來也只能這樣了。以後再來吧。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
I told you that I'd ^0000CDgo easy on you^000000. Although won the fight, you didn't actually win it. Got it?
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
我說過會^0000CD手下留情^000000。你雖然贏了，但那不算真正打贏我。明白嗎？

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
...Being mean is not my character. This is why I don't want to be entangled with clerics...
Hey, pronounce the benediction for me before leaving.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
...我可沒那麼刻薄。這就是我不想和牧師打交道的原因...
喂，走之前給我施個祝福。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Hahaha, great fight!
What a pity. I wanted to win today...
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
哈哈，打得真精彩！
可惜，我今天本來想贏的...

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
I'm glad that you are becoming stronger.
I can see the result of steady training.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
看到你越來越強，我很高興。
看來你一直在認真訓練。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Come back. I can fight you everyday.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
再來吧，我隨時奉陪。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Not busy? That's good.
Enjoy it while you can.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
不忙嗎？那很好。
趁現在好好享受吧。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Not busy? That's good news.
Apart from fighting... I would like to ask you for a favor.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
不忙？那正好。
除了打架...我還想請你幫個忙。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
I'm not sure if I can say this to an outsider... But you are close to the Rebellion now.
Will you keep the secret?
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
我不確定該不該告訴外人...不過你現在和反叛者關係不錯。
你能替我保密嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, I will.
scripts.translation: 是的，我願意

scripts.text: It will be difficult.
scripts.translation: 這會很困難

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
... Then I can't tell you.
Forget what I've said.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
...那我就不能告訴你了。
忘了我剛才說的話吧。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Yes. Make sure you keep the secret.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
好。記得保守秘密。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Good. First of all... do you know about USU that I am commanding?
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
很好。首先...你知道我指揮的USU是什麼嗎？

scripts.text: Superior... unit?
scripts.translation: 超級...部隊？

scripts.text: Isn't it where you isolated problem children?
scripts.translation: 不是專門收容問題兒童的地方嗎？

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
... No. It's not true.
It's actually the opposite.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
...不是，才不是那樣。
其實恰恰相反。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
... What?
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
...什麼？

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Haha... Kaka. Right. You know very well about it.
But don't say that in front of the troops. They might shoot you.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
哈哈...咔咔。沒錯，你還挺了解的。
不過別在隊員面前這麼說，他們可能會開槍。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
USU stands for ^0000CDUnder Seal Unit^000000. It's a group of weirdos who did some crazy things.
Since they had done great job for the Rebellion, we isolate them with lead on their neck rather than death penalty or discharging.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
USU是^0000CDUnder Seal Unit^000000的縮寫，是一群做過瘋狂事的怪人。
他們曾為反叛者立下大功，所以我們沒有處死或開除他們，而是給他們戴上鉛項圈，隔離起來。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
As I told you, it's a unit outside our regulation. So I can't tell you about it in detail. But we do several things that Rebellions don't do.
You can imagine all you want, including murder or violence. It will be worse than that.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
正如我所說，這是個不受常規約束的單位，詳情我不能透露。不過，我們會做一些反叛者不會做的事。
你儘管往謀殺、暴力之類的方向想，實際情況還要糟。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
But we still have a absolute rule. We don't mess up with other Rebellions.
Although we let them do whatever they want outside, we teach them who's holding their lead.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
不過我們有一條鐵規：絕不傷害其他反叛者。
他們在外面愛怎麼鬧都行，但我們會讓他們知道誰掌握著他們的鉛項圈。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
And there are new members... ^0000CDJana Levedeva^000000 and ^0000CDIlya Lebedev^000000. They are twins and still young.
Although they are young, their ability is outstanding. The problem is that they are out of control.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
最近又來了兩個成員...^0000CD雅娜·列別傑娃^000000和^0000CD伊利亞·列別捷夫^000000。他們是年紀還小的雙胞胎。
雖然年幼，能力卻很出色，只是管不住自己。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
They skip the training and hurt a squadder by causing an accident during training... Recently, they tried to run away from the unit and got caught. So the duty manager and I had a hard time.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
他們逃訓練，還在訓練時鬧出事故，傷了一名隊員...最近又試圖逃離部隊，結果被抓了回來。值班主管和我為這事忙壞了。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
According to the regulation, we have to discharge them.
... But they are still under age. According to the commander of their former unit, they don't have parents.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
按規定，我們必須開除他們。
...可他們還未成年。據他們原部隊的指揮官說，他們沒有父母。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
If we kick out these guys, they might become hooligans. At the worst, they will be involved in crime.
It sounds funny that I'm saying this as a commander of USU...
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
要是把他們趕出去，他們可能會變成街頭混混，甚至走上犯罪的路。
我這個USU指揮官說這種話，聽起來倒挺諷刺...

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
At least I don't want to see kids disgracing themselves.
But by looking at what they are doing, they will live as animals with lead in USU at best.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
至少我不想看著孩子們自甘墮落。
可照他們現在這樣，在USU裡戴著鉛項圈、像野獸一樣活著，或許已經算最好的結果了。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
... Maybe they are already regarding me as an enemy. So they won't listen to me.
I know how to make them listen to me. But it will only make the situation worse.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
...他們可能已經把我當成敵人，所以不會聽我的。
我知道怎麼讓他們聽話，但那隻會讓情況更糟。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
So I request you to check their problem and solve it, adventurer.
If they don't say anything, ask other fellows around them.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
所以想請你調查並解決他們的問題，冒險者。
他們要是不肯說，就問問周圍的人。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Would you help me?
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
你願意幫我嗎？

scripts.text: I will help.
scripts.translation: 我願意幫忙

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
I don't want to demand you to do this.
It's a problem inside our unit. So we'd better handle ourselves.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
我不想勉強你。
這是我們部隊內部的問題，最好還是自己解決。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Forget what I told you.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
把我剛才說的話忘了吧。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Thanks.
^0000CDYana and Ilya twins^000000 are in the lobby.
They have bright silver hairs and they're always together. You'll find them easily.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
謝謝。
^0000CD雅娜和伊利亞這對雙胞胎^000000在大廳裡。
他們有一頭亮銀色的頭髮，總是形影不離，很容易認出來。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
In case you don't get any outcome after talking to them, talk to other fellows.
The mess personnel... and another fellow in the outside store seems to want to say something.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
如果和他們談不出結果，就問問其他人。
比如食堂的工作人員...還有外面商店裡的那個人，他似乎也有話想說。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
So, you talked to them?
Hmm, not yet...
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
談過了嗎？
嗯，還沒有啊...

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
You are the only one I can trust now.
I'll count on you, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
現在我只能相信你了。
拜託你了，冒險者。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Did you talk to them?
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
你和他們談過了嗎？

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
If you cannot judge it easily, you can talk to ^0000CDother fellows around them^000000.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
要是拿不準，就去問問^0000CD他們周圍的人^000000。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
So, how is it going?
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
怎麼樣了？

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Hmm... Not at all?
I though they might open their mind to a stranger. But I was wrong.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
嗯...一點進展也沒有嗎？
我還以為他們會對陌生人敞開心扉，看來是我想錯了。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
...There's someone you should talk to lastly.
I didn't want to do this.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
...最後還有個人你得去談談。
我本來不想這麼做的。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Go downstairs and find ^0000CDEricsson Adler, commander of a detached force^000000. He must be nearby the fireplace.
He's middle-aged man... and a former boss of the twins.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
去樓下找^0000CD獨立分隊指揮官埃裡克松·阿德勒^000000，他應該在壁爐附近。
他是個中年人...也是那對雙胞胎以前的上司。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Since the guys have been assigned to my unit, I wanted to take care of them here. But they're not helping us.
If I ask Adler about the guys, it won't look so good. That's why I am requesting you. Please.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
他們既然被分到我的部隊，我本想在這裡照看他們，可他們一直不配合。
我直接去問阿德勒會顯得不太好，所以才請你幫忙。拜託了。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
^0000CDEricsson Adler, commander of a detached force^000000 must be nearby the fireplace.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
^0000CD獨立分隊指揮官埃裡克松·阿德勒^000000應該在壁爐附近。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
He's a former boss of the twins.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
他是那對雙胞胎以前的上司。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
How's it going on now?
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
現在進展如何？

scripts.text: You told Elena Volkova what Lebedev twins told you.
scripts.translation: 你把列別捷夫雙胞胎告訴你的事轉告給埃琳娜·沃爾科娃。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
So... That was the reason.
I had already heard about that accident.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
原來...是這麼回事。
那場事故我早就聽說了。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
But I had no idea they were feeling such a burden.
Since they were out of control... there was no way for me to recognize it.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
但我沒想到他們一直揹負著這麼大的壓力。
他們當時行為失控...我也就沒能察覺。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Well, they're still kids after all. Since they have great ability, Me and other squadders treated them as adults.
We should not have done it...
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
他們終究還是孩子。能力又那麼出眾，我和其他隊員就把他們當大人看待了。
我們本不該這樣...

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
And I should have talked to Adler beforehand.
Thanks, {0}. You helped me so much.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
而且我應該早點和阿德勒談談。
謝謝你，{0}，你幫了我大忙。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
I guess I have to tell them something anyway.
Will you help me once again? Tell them that I'm looking for them. And you come with them please.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
不管怎樣，我都得和他們談談。
能再幫我一次嗎？告訴他們我在找他們，然後陪他們一起回來。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
The twins will be nearby the place where they've always been.
Tell them about me and come back with them.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
雙胞胎應該還在平時待的地方附近。
告訴他們我找他們，再帶他們回來。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
So you're all here? I've heard the whole story.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
你們都來了啊？事情經過我已經聽說了。

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
Yes.
scripts.translation:
[伊利亞·列別捷夫]
是。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
......Yes...
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
...是...

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Jana Levedeva and Ilya Lebedev! Attention!
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
雅娜·列別傑娃、伊利亞·列別捷夫！立正！

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Are you insane? You ran away from the unit for a private reason. And you hurt your companion!
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
你們瘋了嗎？為了私事擅自離隊，還傷了同伴！

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
This may look like a mercenary group like a piece of garbage. But we deal with people's life. We have disciplines that you must abide by.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
我們看起來也許像一群烏合之眾，但我們肩負著他人的性命，有必須遵守的紀律。

scripts.text:
[Lebedev twins]
......
scripts.translation:
[列別捷夫雙胞胎]
...

scripts.text:
[Lebedev twins]
......We're sorry...
scripts.translation:
[列別捷夫雙胞胎]
...對不起...

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
But before I scold you about it...
I am sorry.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
不過在責備你們之前...
我得先向你們道歉。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
I didn't know that you had been forced so much and could not consider it. And I wasn't there for counseling even though I was your boss.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
我不知道你們承受了這麼大的壓力，也沒考慮到你們的處境。身為上級，我卻沒能及時開導你們。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
This is totally my fault and my mistake.
I apologize. You had a rough time of it.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
這完全是我的責任，是我做錯了。
對不起，讓你們受苦了。

scripts.text:
[Lebedev twins]
......No, no... We have to apologize.
scripts.translation:
[列別捷夫雙胞胎]
...不，不...該道歉的是我們。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
From now on, I will pay more attention to you.
Would you please try to make sure this never happens again?
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
以後我會多關心你們。
你們也要努力別再讓這種事發生，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
...No... We are the ones who should apologize.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
...不...該道歉的是我們。

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
It will never happen again...
scripts.translation:
[伊利亞·列別捷夫]
以後絕不會再發生了...

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Since this is a military group, you have regulations to abide by.
But since you are minors, I would like to give you an opportunity to grow as much as possible.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
這裡是軍事組織，你們必須遵守規章。
不過你們還未成年，我想給你們機會好好成長。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Jana Levedeva and Ilya Lebedev. I will exclude you from the real fight for some time.
Instead, feel free to do the works that you can do inside the unit.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
雅娜·列別傑娃、伊利亞·列別捷夫，我會暫時不讓你們參加實戰。
這段時間就在部隊裡做些力所能及的事吧。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
You can make new friends, start a hobby or enhance your shooting ability. You can even do things that I cannot expect.
Do what you want to do. Make sure you abide by the regulations.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
你們可以交朋友、培養興趣，或練習射擊。想做些別的也行。
做自己想做的事，但別違反規定。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
So we're... not being kicked out?
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
所以...我們不會被開除？

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Don't make me say it twice. I told you I was responsible for what happened.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
別讓我重複。我說過，這件事由我負責。

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
Oh... Thank you so much!
And... Sorry.
scripts.translation:
[伊利亞·列別捷夫]
哦...真的太感謝了！
還有...對不起。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
Thank you, commander...!
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
謝謝您，指揮官...！

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
That's all about it. You can go back now. There's something I'd like to discuss with the adventurer.
And if you need anything, talk to me any time.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
事情就是這樣。你們可以回去了，我還有事要和冒險者談。
需要幫忙的話，隨時來找我。

scripts.text:
[Lebedev twins]
Yes!
scripts.translation:
[列別捷夫雙胞胎]
是！

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Phew...
Great job, {0}.
Thanks to your support and concern, we managed to do this.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
呼...
幹得好，{0}。
多虧你支援並關心他們，我們才順利解決了這件事。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Ha... I told them to do what they want. And they will wonder what to do for a while.
For those guys to do what they want, they'll need your help again.
Please help them at that time.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
哈...我讓他們做自己想做的事，他們可能一時還不知道該做什麼。
那兩個孩子還需要你的幫助。
到時候請多照應他們。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
......Thanks.
I will count on you in the future.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
...謝謝。
今後也拜託你了。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Are you taking care of them well?
Wow, I am relieved that they have a babysitter now.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
你把他們照顧得不錯嘛？
哇，現在有人看著他們，我就放心了。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Haha! Just kidding. Thank you for your support. You're so reliable.
Take care of the guys please.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
哈哈，開玩笑的。謝謝你幫忙，你真可靠。
那群孩子就拜託你照看了。

scripts.text:
[Tough Guy Sorita]
What is it now?
scripts.translation:
[硬漢 索麗塔]
又怎麼了？

scripts.text: I want to go out.
scripts.translation: 我想出去

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 沒什麼

scripts.text:
[Tough Guy Sorita]
Do not talk to me when you have nothing to say.
scripts.translation:
[硬漢 索麗塔]
沒事就別來煩我。

scripts.text:
[Tough Guy Sorita]
What are you talking about? So you're telling me you would like to run away without fighting? Aren't you?
scripts.translation:
[硬漢 索麗塔]
你說什麼？你想不戰而逃？

scripts.text:
[Tough Guy Sorita]
You must be kidding. What kind of nonsense is this! Why did you come here in the first place and annoy me?
scripts.translation:
[硬漢 索麗塔]
開什麼玩笑？這是什麼蠢話！你一開始來這裡就是為了找我麻煩嗎？

scripts.text:
[Tough Guy Sorita]
Dang, I have been quite upset after the commander gave me this useless work. And you make me even more upset. Get the hell out of here!
scripts.translation:
[硬漢 索麗塔]
可惡，指揮官派給我這種無聊差事，我已經夠煩了。你還來火上澆油。給我滾出去！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
Who are you?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領]
你是什麼人？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
If you are lost, go downstairs and talk to others.
They will let you know how to get out of here.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領]
迷路的話就下樓問問其他人。
他們會告訴你怎麼出去。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
Who are you?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領]
你是什麼人？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
If you are lost, go downstairs and talk to the others.
They will let you know how to get out of here.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領]
迷路的話就下樓問問其他人。
他們會告訴你怎麼出去。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
Hey, you two there!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領]
喂，你們兩個！

scripts.text:
[Young Rebellion]
Yes!!! Yep!!!
scripts.translation:
[年輕的反叛者]
是！！！到！！！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
Escort this adventurer safely downstairs.
Seems like he has lost his way.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領]
安全地把這位冒險者帶到樓下。
看來他迷路了。

scripts.text:
[Young Rebellion]
Yes! I will!!!!
scripts.translation:
[年輕的反叛者]
是！遵命！！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
And if by any chance...... Well, I guess you already know that part. I will hand it to you.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領]
要是出了什麼事...算了，後面的事你應該清楚。交給你了。

scripts.text:
[Young Rebellion]
Oh.. Yes Sir!
scripts.translation:
[年輕的反叛者]
哦...遵命，長官！

scripts.text:
[Young Rebellion]
Please follow me, this way.
scripts.translation:
[年輕的反叛者]
請跟我來，這邊走。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wait!

[Rebellion leader]
Is there anything else?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領]
還有什麼事？

scripts.text: Tell the leader about having saved Gonie.
scripts.translation: 告訴首領你救了戈尼

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
Oh!
I see!
Thank you so much for helping our youngster.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領]
哦！
原來如此！
非常感謝你救了我們的年輕成員。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
Hmm.. As I expected......
Gonie......
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領]
嗯...果然如此...
戈尼...

scripts.text:
[Young Rebellion]
The one who went to Einbroch not long ago......
scripts.translation:
[年輕的反叛者]
就是不久前去艾音布羅克的那個人...

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
Ah!
That guy?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領]
啊！
是那傢伙？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
Haha!
This fellow is full of chivalry! It's difficult to find people like this nowadays.
Normally they just pass by......
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領]
哈哈！
這傢伙真有俠義心腸！如今這樣的人可不多了。
一般人都會直接走掉...

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
Especially after finding that he was wearing a Rebellion suit.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領]
尤其是知道他穿著反叛者制服之後，更沒人願意幫忙。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
What do you say?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領]
你覺得呢？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
By looking at your eyes, I see you haven't come to hear gratitude from us.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領]
看你的眼神就知道，你不是來聽我們道謝的。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
The man called Lazy who came with you...
He's been wandering around here.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領]
和你一起來的那個懶散...
他一直在這一帶打轉。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
You helped Gonie by chance. But you didn't come here by chance. Did you?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領]
你救戈尼或許是偶然，但你來這裡絕不是偶然，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
You'd better think twice before you answer.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領]
回答前最好想清楚。

scripts.text: Talk about cooperation.
scripts.translation: 談談合作

scripts.text: Go back.
scripts.translation: 回去

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
Be careful on your way home.
The public order is not so good in this area.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領]
回去時小心。
這一帶治安不太好。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
Help?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領]
幫忙？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
Ha...
I think you are misunderstanding something.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領]
哈...
我看你是誤會了。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
Surely, I want to express my gratitude for what you did for Gonie.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領]
你救了戈尼，我當然想向你道謝。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
But!
What you are saying now is a totally different issue.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領]
但是！
你現在說的是另一回事。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
Secret Wings?
Ha! Don't make me laugh!
The fact you say it now shows that you know something about the relationship between us and them. Am I right?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領]
秘密之翼？
哈，別逗我笑了！
你既然提起他們，就說明你知道我們和他們的關係，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
If you don't, that means you are just being exploited. Then you just have to go back gently.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領]
如果你什麼都不知道，那就只是被人利用了。識相的話，趕緊回去吧。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
This is all I can tell you.
Please leave now.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領]
我能說的就這些。
請回吧。

scripts.text:
[Young Rebellion]
Please follow me, this way.
scripts.translation:
[年輕的反叛者]
請跟我來，這邊走。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
Leave the adventurer alone.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領]
別管那個冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
He must know his position better than anyone else.
The man called Lazy, too.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領]
他應該比誰都清楚自己的處境。
那個叫懶散的也是。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
Secret Wings?
Ha! Don't make me laugh!
The fact you say it now shows that you know something about the relationship between us and them. Am I right?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領]
秘密之翼？
哈，別逗我笑了！
你既然提起他們，就說明你知道我們和他們的關係，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
If you don't, that means you are just being exploited. Then you just have to go back gently.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領]
如果你什麼都不知道，那就只是被人利用了。識相的話，趕緊回去吧。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
This is all I can tell you.
Please leave now.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領]
我能說的就這些。
請回吧。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
What is it?
Are you still here?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
什麼事？
你還沒走？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
If I didn't see a ghost, you are living a pretty long life. Aren't you?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
要是我沒看錯，你還真是命大。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
Sir!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者衛隊長 拉西斯]
長官！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Ah!
Guard leader!
Good that you're here.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
啊！
衛隊長！
你來得正好。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Take this fellow out, now.
I thought you would leave on your own, if you cared for your life. But you are still hanging around here.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
現在就把這傢伙趕出去。
我還以為惜命的話你早就走了，沒想到還賴在這裡。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
It's so annoying to see this rat wandering around in my space.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
看這隻老鼠在我的地盤上亂竄，真讓人心煩。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
There's something more important now. Here's a letter from Dien.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者衛隊長 拉西斯]
現在有更重要的事。這是迪恩寄來的信。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
A letter from Dien?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
迪恩的信？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
Yes. Here it is...
scripts.translation:
[反叛者衛隊長 拉西斯]
是，給您...

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
It's quite unusual to receive a letter from her.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
她居然會寫信來，真少見。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Let me see... I agree. Do you agree, too?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
我看看...我同意。你也同意吧？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Hmm?
Agree with what?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
嗯？
同意什麼？

scripts.text: Talk about cooperation.
scripts.translation: 談談合作

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Hmm..........
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Guard leader...
I think I have seen a phantom. Would you like to read it?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
衛隊長...
我好像看見了幽靈。你要讀讀這封信嗎？

scripts.text:

Yeah?
Yes! Sir!
scripts.translation:

啊？
遵命！長官！

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

Yes! Sir!

啊？
遵命！長官！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
What?
The commander?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
什麼？
指揮官？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
What the hell... Is that jerk still alive after sending this letter to the commander?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
搞什麼...那個混蛋給指揮官寄了這封信，居然還活著？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
What did the commander say?
He is not the type of a man who would just sit down after listening to it. Is he?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
指揮官怎麼說？
他可不是聽完就會袖手旁觀的人，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
Erst agrees with it, too.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者衛隊長 拉西斯]
厄斯特也同意了。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
What?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
什麼？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Ha!
This is nonsense.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
哈！
胡說八道。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
I cannot accept this.
I don't know what you did to them. But I will talk to them again.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
我不能接受。
我不知道你對他們說了什麼，但我還要再和他們談談。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Guard leader!
Where is Dien?
In the room?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
衛隊長！
迪恩在哪兒？
在房間裡嗎？

scripts.text:
[Dien]
You don't have to come in, Rupert.
It was so noisy outside, so I came out. It was you.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
魯伯特，不用進來了。
外面太吵，我就出來看看。原來是你。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
I cannot accept this.
I don't know what you did to them. But I will talk to them again.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
我不能接受。
我不知道你對他們說了什麼，但我還要再和他們談談。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Guard leader!
Where is Dien?
In the room?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
衛隊長！
迪恩在哪兒？
在房間裡嗎？

scripts.text:
[Dien]
You don't have to come in, Rupert.
It was so noisy outside, so I came out. It was you.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
魯伯特，不用進來了。
外面太吵，我就出來看看。原來是你。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Guard leader!
What are you doing!
Escort Dien to the room.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
衛隊長！
你在做什麼！
送迪恩回房間。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
You and I just do not appear to communicate.
I didn't know you were so stubborn...
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前輩 迪恩]
看來我們就是沒法好好溝通。
沒想到你這麼固執...

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
It's all because of you, Dien.
I still remember you telling me a story about them. You were so angry with them. Now you make this choice.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
這都是你害的，迪恩。
我還記得你以前提起他們時有多憤怒。現在你卻做出這種決定。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
As you put on years, your memory and judgment are not as good as they used to be.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
年紀大了，記憶和判斷力都不如從前了。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
What!
What have you just said!!!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前輩 迪恩]
什麼！
你剛才說什麼！！！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
At that time, you were just an infant in diapers. How do you happen to know so much about them?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前輩 迪恩]
那時候你還只是個穿尿布的嬰兒，怎麼會知道那麼多？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
Did you experience that incident yourself?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前輩 迪恩]
那場事故是你親身經歷的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
I'm the one who saved your life during the ravage of war.
And just look at your big mouth now!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前輩 迪恩]
當年戰亂時，是我救了你一命。
你看看你現在這張嘴！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
Is it the way I taught you?
Come on, say that again!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前輩 迪恩]
這是我教你的嗎？
來，再說一遍！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Arrggh!!!
What the hell are you doing!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
啊啊！！
你在幹什麼！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Just release your hold.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
快放手。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
Dien! Please calm down!
You shouldn't do this here!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者衛隊長 拉西斯]
迪恩！冷靜點！
別在這裡動手！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
You just shut up!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前輩 迪恩]
你給我閉嘴！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
Ha...
scripts.translation:
[反叛者衛隊長 拉西斯]
哈...

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Whatever you say, I'm against it!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
不管你說什麼，我都反對！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
You are still chattering with the big mouth!
Aren't you?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前輩 迪恩]
你這張嘴還真是停不下來啊！
不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Arrggh!!!
Come on, it hurts!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
啊啊！！
喂，痛啊！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
What are you doing! They are all looking at you!!!!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
你在幹什麼！大家都看著呢！！！！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
Well, I don't care who's looking at me.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前輩 迪恩]
哼，我才不在乎誰看著。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
What have you done so far with that vengeance alone?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前輩 迪恩]
你光想著復仇，這些年到底做成什麼了？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
Are you going to hate them forever, doing nothing until I die?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前輩 迪恩]
你打算一直恨他們，什麼都不做，直到我死嗎？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
How many years do you think I have ahead!!!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前輩 迪恩]
你覺得我還能活多少年！！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
By looking at you now, I'm sure you can live for 100 more years!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
看你現在這精神頭，我敢說你還能活一百年！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
Great!
Let me live for 100 more years and pull out your beard!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前輩 迪恩]
好啊！
那我就再活一百年，把你的鬍子拔光！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Arrgh!!!!
Stop it!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
啊！！
住手！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Ah!
Okay! I got it!
Do as you wish!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
啊！
好好好，我知道了！
隨你便！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
Here you go.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前輩 迪恩]
給你。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
But you will to have to face the consequences. Be prepared!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
不過你得承擔後果。等著瞧！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
That's exactly what I was hoping for.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前輩 迪恩]
這正合我意。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
No...
Guard leader!
Tell each senior and commander to gather now.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
不...
衛隊長！
通知所有前輩和指揮官，立刻集合。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Let me make this clear.
We will help you. But don't expect too much help.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
我把話說清楚。
我們會幫你，但別指望我們出太多力。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
There is no reason why we have to sacrifice for you.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
我們沒有理由為你們犧牲。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
Hey! You are saying this again!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前輩 迪恩]
喂！你又來了！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
Since you got the approval from Rupert, {0} why don't you go back for report?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前輩 迪恩]
既然魯伯特已經同意了，{0}，你回去彙報吧。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
It seems like the youngsters will be busy for a while. Please help the old people, whenever you have time.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前輩 迪恩]
年輕人們接下來會忙一陣子。有空的話，也請幫幫我們這些老人家。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
Ah!! Rupert!
Talk to me before the meeting.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前輩 迪恩]
啊！魯伯特！
開會前先跟我談談。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Let me make this clear.
We will help you. But don't expect too much help.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
我把話說清楚。
我們會幫你，但別指望我們出太多力。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
There is no reason why we have to sacrifice for you.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
我們沒有理由為你們犧牲。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
I read it, too. What you have said just now was written there.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者衛隊長 拉西斯]
我也看過了。你剛才說的內容，信裡都寫了。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
The same thing was written in the letter that I handed to Erst.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者衛隊長 拉西斯]
我交給厄斯特的那封信裡，寫的也是同樣的內容。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
Dien!
It's dangerous outside. There are outsiders there.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者衛隊長 拉西斯]
迪恩！
外面有危險，還有外人。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
It's alright. Larcis.
They are not so dangerous.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
沒事，拉西斯。
他們沒什麼威脅。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Dien!
I was about to visit you.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
迪恩！
我正要去找你。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Your letter... What does it mean?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
你那封信...是什麼意思？

scripts.text:
[Dien]
As written in the letter.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
信裡寫的就是我的意思。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Are you saying that you agreed to help the Secret Wings?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
你是說你同意幫助秘密之翼？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
Yes.
As I wrote in the letter.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前輩 迪恩]
是的。
信裡已經寫得很清楚了。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
Ridsh, Cotnes and I will agree to help the Secret Wings.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前輩 迪恩]
裡德什、科特內斯和我，都同意幫助秘密之翼。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Even Ridsh and Cotnes...? No. I can't believe that you agree to it, even after I have heard it from you personally.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
連裡德什和科特內斯都...？不，我親耳聽你說了，還是不敢相信你們會同意。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
I heard Erst agrees as well.
Since there are so many people who agree to it, you should not resist it alone.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前輩 迪恩]
我聽說厄斯特也同意了。
既然這麼多人都贊成，你也別一個人硬扛。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
I can't laugh it off this time.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
這次我可笑不出來。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
You are the one who knows how silly this is more than anyone else.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
沒人比你更清楚這件事有多荒唐。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
Of course I do.
That's why I accepted it.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
我當然清楚。
所以我才答應。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Why!!!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
為什麼！！！

scripts.text:
[Dien]
The time is passing. Rupert.
We cannot stick on the same spot forever.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
時間不等人，魯伯特。
我們不能永遠停在原地。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Although the time passes, it doesn't mean that the past goes away!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
時間會流逝，但過去不會因此消失！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
We sacrificed too much to forget it!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
我們已經付出太多，怎麼可能忘掉！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Regarding this issue, I, as the person in charge here, will decide on it.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
這件事由我負責，我會做決定。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Trying to respect you as a senior, I have overlooked your behavior so far. However, this time, you crossed the line.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
我一直尊重你是前輩，才容忍你到現在。但這次你越界了。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Now! Please go back to your room and enjoy your tea party.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
現在，回房間去喝茶吧。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
Wait!
I can't ignore what you've just said.
Are you trying to neglect my opinion, and myself as well?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前輩 迪恩]
等等！
你剛才那番話我不能當沒聽見。
你是想無視我的意見，連我這個人也一起無視嗎？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
Wait!
I can't ignore what you've just said.
Are you trying to neglect my opinion, and myself as well?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前輩 迪恩]
等等！
我不能當沒聽見你剛才那番話。
你是想無視我的意見，連我這個人也一起無視嗎？

scripts.text:
[Young Rebellion]
I joined the Rebellion, because their shooting looked so cool to me. But now I am so busy handling the documents that I have no time to get my hands on a gun.
scripts.translation:
[年輕的反叛者]
我加入反叛者，是因為他們開槍的樣子很帥。可現在整天忙著整理檔案，連摸槍的時間都沒有。

scripts.text:
[Young Rebellion]
The problem is that I feel like this work suits me.
scripts.translation:
[年輕的反叛者]
問題是，我覺得這工作還挺適合我。

scripts.text:
[Young Rebellion]
When I'm lucky, I can get some snacks from seniors.
scripts.translation:
[年輕的反叛者]
運氣好的時候，前輩們還會給我些零食。

scripts.text:
[Young Rebellion]
It's amazing that the taste is different when I purchase the snacks myself.
scripts.translation:
[年輕的反叛者]
真奇怪，自己買來的零食吃起來就是不一樣。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Why do you have so many things here? Your bag has to be light to carry a lot of new stuff.
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
你怎麼帶這麼多東西？把背包騰空些，才好裝新戰利品。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Why do you have so many things here? Your bag has to be light to carry a lot of new stuff.
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
你怎麼帶這麼多東西？把背包騰空些，才好裝新戰利品。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Oh~ It's wonderful here. It's so cozy. ^0000cdWhat is this place for^000000? I want to stay here for a day.
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
哦~這裡真棒，好舒服。^0000cd這是什麼地方^000000？我想在這兒待一天。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I never imagined there would be a place like this behind the store... What's this?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我真沒想到商店後面還有這種地方...這裡是做什麼的？

scripts.text:
[Lucky]
A sanatorium that looks after novices and senior citizens. There is nothing to see here. And it's too cold in here and your mouth might be twisted if you sleep here. That's why you'd better leave after drinking the tea.
scripts.translation:
[拉基]
這是照顧新手和老人的療養院，沒什麼好看的。這裡還很冷，睡在這兒嘴巴可能會凍歪，喝完茶就趕緊走吧。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
You are too stingy. How can you do this to me after I saved his life?
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
你也太小氣了。我好歹救了他的命，你怎麼能這樣？

scripts.text:
[Lucky]
I gave you a cup of tea and I promised you to compensate. What else do you need?
scripts.translation:
[拉基]
我給你倒了茶，也答應補償你了。你還想要什麼？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
There are things you cannot buy.
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
有些東西是錢買不到的。

scripts.text:
[Lucky]
Well, then, you're leaving me with my gratitude.
scripts.translation:
[拉基]
好吧，那我就只好心懷感激了。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
No. According to my experience so far, everything that I cannot buy is useless.
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
不。照我的經驗，買不到的東西都沒用。

scripts.text:
[Lucky]
I can't figure out what you want. Have a sit there anyway. I will give you a cup of tea that you desired.
scripts.translation:
[拉基]
我真搞不懂你要什麼。先坐下吧，我給你泡杯你想喝的茶。

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Lucky~~~ Where have you been!! I've been waiting for a while! I'm going out for a mission and wish me a good luck.
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
拉基~~~你去哪兒了！！我等了好一會兒！我要出任務了，祝我好運吧。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Rookie!!!! Help me arrange the warehouse quickly. There are bunch of them and I can't do it alone. Hurry up.
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
新人！！快來幫我整理倉庫！東西太多了，我一個人忙不過來。快點！

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Hey, I came before you. Didn't I?
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
喂，我比你先來的，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Denny]
But I'm in a hurry!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
可我趕時間！

scripts.text:
[Lucky]
I have a customer. I will get to you after giving them cups of tea. Both of you, please wait a minute.
scripts.translation:
[拉基]
我還有客人，等給他們上完茶就來。你們兩個先等一下。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
I'm in a hurry...
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
我趕時間...

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
I can wait! I cannot put pressure on Lucky.
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
我可以等！我不能催拉基。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
I can wait too!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
我也可以等！

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
They are looking for you everywhere. You are so popular. Aren't you?
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
大家到處找你呢，你還真受歡迎啊。

scripts.text:
[Senior]
Rookie, where have you been? Everyone's looking for you.
scripts.translation:
[前輩]
新人，你跑哪兒去了？大家都在找你。

scripts.text:
[Senior]
He has healthy legs, so he can go around.
scripts.translation:
[前輩]
他腿腳好著呢，能自己到處跑。

scripts.text:
[Senior]
Lucky, bring a cup of tea.
scripts.translation:
[前輩]
拉基，泡杯茶。

scripts.text:
[Senior]
Lucky, they are strangers. Who are they?
scripts.translation:
[前輩]
拉基，這兩個人是誰？看著面生。

scripts.text:
[Lucky]
They saved Gonie's life. They came to this quiet Einbech. They found injured Gonie ^0000cdaccidentally^000000 and healed him. Then they brought him ^0000cdright^000000 here.
scripts.translation:
[拉基]
他們救了戈尼的命，還專程來到這偏僻的艾音貝赫。他們^0000cd偶然^000000發現受傷的戈尼，治好他後，又^0000cd正好^000000把他送來了這裡。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Yes. I did it. I did it!
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
沒錯，是我乾的！是我！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You take too much credit to yourself after helping someone.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你幫了人就這麼愛居功嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
You have to exaggerate your performance. That's the way to be appreciated by others.
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
得把功勞說得誇張點，別人才會賞識你嘛。

scripts.text:
[Lucky]
So, why did you come here? By the way, who are you?
scripts.translation:
[拉基]
那麼，你們來這裡做什麼？對了，你們是誰？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Me? Lazy. Although it's not my real name, call me Lazy now.
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
我？叫我懶散就行，雖然這不是真名。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
I am an, ^0000cdagent of Secret Wings^000000, an institution directly responsible to the President of Schwaltzvalt.
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
我是^0000cd秘密之翼^000000的特工，該機構直接向施瓦茨瓦爾特總統負責。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hey! Why did you tell them who you are all of a sudden? You kept telling me not even to mention it. And you revealed it officially!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
喂！你怎麼突然把身份說出來了？你之前還一直叫我別提這件事，結果自己倒是公開說了！

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
It's all right. This is our destination. ^0000cdClana Nemieri^000000, the stronghold of Rebellions.
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
沒關係，這裡就是我們的目的地——^0000cd克拉納·內米埃裡^000000，反叛者的據點。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Then the store outside the door was a ^0000cdtrickery^000000. The collapsed man is a member of ^0000cdRebellion^000000... That's why...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
所以門外那家店只是個^0000cd幌子^000000，那個倒下的人是^0000cd反叛者^000000成員...我明白了...

scripts.text: Clank.
scripts.translation: 咔噠。

scripts.text:
Clank.
Clank.
scripts.translation:
咔噠。
咔噠。

scripts.text:
Clank.
Clank.
Clank.
scripts.translation:
咔噠。
咔噠。
咔噠。

scripts.text:
Clank.
Clank.
Clank.
Clank.
scripts.translation:
咔噠。
咔噠。
咔噠。
咔噠。

scripts.text:
[Senior]
Get out of here now!
scripts.translation:
[前輩]
立刻給我滾出去！

scripts.text:
[Senior]
We get rid of them!
scripts.translation:
[前輩]
把他們趕出去！

scripts.text:
[Lucky]
Hey, calm down please! Put your guns in! No wonder you are hot headed elders!!
scripts.translation:
[拉基]
喂，冷靜點！把槍收起來！難怪你們這些老前輩脾氣這麼火爆！！

scripts.text:
[Lucky]
Although they have come here with a fishy purpose, it's true that they carried injured Gonie all the way here. Behave yourself, old men.
scripts.translation:
[拉基]
他們的目的雖然可疑，但確實一路把受傷的戈尼背了過來。你們這些老傢伙，冷靜點。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
You are not surprised? So you knew it.
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
你一點也不驚訝？看來你早就知道了。

scripts.text:
[Lucky]
I didn't know who you were. But I knew you had a certain purpose. I had not told you my name but you were shouting 'Come out Rookie'. So I had a clue.
scripts.translation:
[拉基]
我不知道你們是誰，但知道你們另有目的。我還沒告訴你名字，你就在喊“新人出來”，這讓我起了疑心。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
I heard that the brain of a Rebellion is filled with bullets, but maybe not every Rebellion! So, is your name Lucky, or Rookie?
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
我聽說反叛者個個腦子裡都裝著子彈，不過看來也不是所有人都這樣嘛！所以你到底叫拉基還是新人？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
^0000cdRookie^000000. Lucky is my nickname.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
^0000cd我叫新人^000000，拉基是綽號。

scripts.text:
[Senior]
Rookie! You already knew who he was, and you..!!
scripts.translation:
[前輩]
新人！你早就知道他們是誰了吧？你這傢伙...！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
I told you! Old men, are you deaf now? I didn't know who they were! This is unfair!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我說了，我不知道他們是誰！老傢伙們，你們聾了嗎？這不公平！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
If they had an intention to attack us, they would have done it already, rather than asking for tea. And what can these two do against many of us?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
他們要是想襲擊我們，早就動手了，何必坐下來喝茶？而且就他們兩個，能拿我們這麼多人怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Whatever they do, you are going to handle them. Aren't you? You are legends of the Rebellion.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
不管他們打什麼主意，你們這些反叛者傳奇人物肯定能應付吧？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
I don't know where they come from. But by the time they came all the way here, perhaps they need to talk to the seniors. I will bring the tea and enjoy the talk.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我不知道他們來自哪裡，但他們大老遠趕來，肯定有事要和前輩們談。我去泡茶，順便聽聽。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Hahaha! Nice to meet you. Did I surprise you by coming in all of a sudden in leisure hours?
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
哈哈哈！很高興見到各位。我突然在休息時間來訪，沒打擾你們吧？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
But I am not a dangerous person, so please relax. And this adventurer is much less dangerous.
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
不過我不是什麼危險人物，放輕鬆。至於這位冒險者，就更沒什麼威脅了。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
This person is an adventurer who settled various problems of the continent, including Schwaltzvalt. The adventurer is currently under the protection of Rune Midgarts Kingdom.{0}
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
這位冒險者解決過大陸各地的問題，包括施瓦茨瓦爾特的麻煩，目前受到盧恩·米德加茲王國的保護。{0}

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
And I am a member of Secret Wings, an institution directly responsible to the President of Schwaltzvalt Republic. Since the President guarantees my identification, you don't have to worry.
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
我是秘密之翼的成員，直接向施瓦茨瓦爾特共和國總統負責。總統能證明我的身份，你們不用擔心。

scripts.text:
[Senior]
How can I trust you?
scripts.translation:
[前輩]
憑什麼信你？

scripts.text:
[Senior]
You are the most dangerous guy here!
scripts.translation:
[前輩]
你才是這裡最危險的人！

scripts.text:
[Senior]
President? Since I heard that unpleasant word, let me wash my ears!
scripts.translation:
[前輩]
總統？光聽到這個討厭的詞，我就想洗洗耳朵！

scripts.text:
[Senior]
What is a spoiled crow of the President doing here?
scripts.translation:
[前輩]
總統的寵兒跑到這裡來幹什麼？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
That's what I am about to tell you now. Haha. So please put your guns down... Let's sit down first.
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
這正是我要解釋的事。哈哈，先把槍放下...我們坐下來談吧。

scripts.text:
[Senior]
Hey, you are standing up too!
scripts.translation:
[前輩]
喂，你自己不也站著嗎！

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Ahaha. I've got a disease that I can't sit down. By the way... As a guest, I couldn't come here with empty hands. This is a specialty good of Yuno... Please have some.
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
啊哈哈，我有病，坐不下來。對了...既然是客人，總不能空手來。這是尤諾特產...請嚐嚐。

scripts.text:
[Senior]
Guest? You're just a jerk.
scripts.translation:
[前輩]
客人？你只是個混蛋。

scripts.text:
[Senior]
What do you mean by guest? We never invited you.
scripts.translation:
[前輩]
你算什麼客人？我們可沒邀請你。

scripts.text:
[Senior]
We never know what you put on this food! There is nothing we would like to hear from you. So get out of here!
scripts.translation:
[前輩]
誰知道你在食物裡下了什麼！我們沒什麼要聽的，滾出去！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Drink tea, please.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
請喝茶。

scripts.text:
[Senior]
As soon as you drink the tea, leave at once~ We won't see you off!
scripts.translation:
[前輩]
喝完就趕緊走~我們可不送你！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Where are you going? I brought the tea in reference to the number of people here.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
你去哪兒？我可是照人數把茶都拿來了。

scripts.text:
[Senior]
I don't drink tea in uncomfortable place. I don't want to have an upset stomach while drinking tea.
scripts.translation:
[前輩]
我才不在這種不自在的地方喝茶，免得喝得胃不舒服。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Come on, what's wrong with you~ You can drink it so quickly. It's not good after it gets cold. Your stomach must have got cold by now. You're not so healthy either.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
哎呀，你這是怎麼了~茶得趁熱喝，涼了就不好了。你的胃八成已經著涼了，身體也不太好嘛。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Can't you just drink the tea before leaving? I struggled to get this tea... You also liked it...
scripts.translation:
[新人]
喝完茶再走不行嗎？我費了好大勁才弄到這些茶...你明明也喜歡喝...

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
And if we feel uncomfortable, they also feel uncomfortable. So it's not such a bad condition. Come on. Drinking a cup of tea is not a hard thing to do.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
而且我們不舒服，他們也會不舒服，這不正好嗎？來吧，喝杯茶又不難。

scripts.text:
[Senior]
I mean, the spoiled crow of the President-
scripts.translation:
[前輩]
我只是說，總統的寵兒——

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Please. The tea is innocent. have a peaceful tea time. Never fight in front of food. You taught me all these words. Didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
拜託，茶是無辜的。大家好好喝茶，別在食物面前爭吵。這些話不都是你教我的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Senior]
Ahem, ahem.
scripts.translation:
[前輩]
咳咳。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Wow~ This tea is great. It matches well with this specialty good. Try it. The President prepared it for you.
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
哇~這茶真好喝，配這道特色點心正合適。嚐嚐吧，這是總裁特意為你準備的。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Please listen to me. I'm here to ask you a very difficult request.
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
請聽我說。我這次來，是想拜託你們一件非常棘手的事。

scripts.text:
[Senior]
Why should we accept a difficult request?
scripts.translation:
[前輩]
我們為什麼要接受一個困難的請求？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
That's why I came here. This mission cannot be accomplished by anyone except Rebellion. So the President sent me here.
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
所以我才來這裡。這項任務只有反叛者才能完成，總裁才派我前來。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
I think it will be such a confidential and cautious story. Please take this...
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
這件事需要高度保密，也得謹慎處理。請先收下這個...

scripts.text:
[Senior]
Just tell us your point.
scripts.translation:
[前輩]
直接說重點。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Yes! Although you pretend not to know, it's the story you all know.
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
是的！雖然你們裝作不知道，但這其實是你們都知道的故事。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
The President certainly regrets what happened in the past. His excellency has always been thinking about you and wanted to start a talk.
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
總裁確實對過去發生的事感到後悔。他一直掛念著你們，也想找機會談一談。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Upon your approval, his excellency wants to meet you in person, apologize, and wants to have an opportunity to harmonize with you.
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
只要你們同意，總裁就想親自與你們見面道歉，希望有機會修復彼此的關係。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
I was also extremely sad to hear what happened to you. And I was looking for a chance to meet you and talk to you.
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
