你確定要把它們交給我嗎？

scripts.text: Of course.
scripts.translation: 當然

scripts.text: Sorry. I need it.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我還要用

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
Yeah. I am just requesting you.
If you have more important thing to do, don't worry about me.
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
嗯，我只是問問。
你要是有更重要的事要忙，不用顧慮我。

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
Thank you, adventurer...
Although I cannot give you money, let me give you this.
If possible, I would like to ask you for a favor tomorrow too.
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
謝謝你，冒險者...
雖然不能給你錢，還是請收下這個。
如果方便的話，明天也想再請你幫忙。

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Jack]
Seems like you are looking for someone. What is it?
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠 傑克]
看起來你在找人。有什麼事？

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Jack]
An advice for repairing weapons? Well, but you are not a Blacksmith, are you?
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠 傑克]
想問修理武器的建議？不過，你不是鐵匠吧？

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Jack]
Oh, you have come here after being requested by the member of our guild. Let me see it.
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠 傑克]
哦，你是受我們公會成員所託來的。讓我看看武器。

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Jack]
Come on. I have to look at the weapon to give you an advice.
I am a Blacksmith, not a psychic.
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠 傑克]
快拿來。得先看看武器，我才能給你建議。
我可是鐵匠，又不是通靈師。

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Jack]
Hmm. This is definitely the skill of our guild member. She has developed the method we taught her.
Her skill is good. Hmm, but...
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠 傑克]
嗯，這確實是我們公會成員的手藝。她把我們教的方法融會貫通了。
手藝不錯。不過...

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Jack]
This is... Hmm, I see...
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠 傑克]
這個...嗯，我明白了...

scripts.text: Jack is scrutinizing Rachel's revolver.
scripts.translation: 傑克正在仔細檢查瑞秋的左輪手槍。

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Jack]
This is not a matter of her skill. It's the materials.
Since there are so many impurities mixed in the metal, it mush have been hard for her to handle this. But she barely did it.
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠 傑克]
這不是她手藝的問題，而是材料的問題。
金屬裡混進了太多雜質，她處理起來一定很不容易。不過她還是勉強修好了。

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Jack]
Go back and tell her she must use the metal with higher purity.
This is not the problem of someone who handles it. I won't be surprised if it exploded while she was repairing it.
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠 傑克]
回去告訴她必須使用純度更高的金屬。
這不是操作手法的問題。她修理時要是把槍弄炸了，我也不會意外。

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Jack]
Go back and tell her. It might be exploded in the meantime...
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠 傑克]
快回去告訴她吧。說不定等你回去時，武器已經炸了...

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Jack]
An experienced Blacksmith can recognize the status of the weapon just by feeling the vibration on the arm when he/she smashes that weapon with a hammer.
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠 傑克]
經驗豐富的鐵匠用錘子敲擊武器時，只需感受手臂傳來的震動，就能判斷武器的狀態。

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Jack]
In addition to that, The real master must check it with eyes and ears as well.
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠 傑克]
除此之外，真正的大師還必須用眼睛觀察、用耳朵聆聽。

scripts.text:
[Danae]
This is delicious. No mission yet?
scripts.translation:
[達娜厄]
真好吃。還沒有任務嗎？

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
Yeah. They told me to stand by.
scripts.translation:
[湯米]
是啊，他們讓我待命。

scripts.text:
[Danae]
Oh, I'm waiting for my off-duty day. I will go to Yuno to eat something delicious.
scripts.translation:
[達娜厄]
哦，我在等休假日呢。到時我要去尤諾吃點好吃的。

scripts.text:
[Grinder]
Oh, it was so hard. Wasn't it?
scripts.translation:
[研磨工]
哦，任務很辛苦吧？

scripts.text:
[Fang]
Not that hard. Did I tell you the story when I went to Hermes Fletue?
scripts.translation:
[方]
沒那麼辛苦。我跟你講過我去赫爾墨斯·弗勒特的事嗎？

scripts.text:
[Grinder]
Yes, you did. More than thousand times.
scripts.translation:
[研磨工]
講過了，超過一千遍了。

scripts.text:
[Fang]
I told you not to drink the tea while you are holding the gun. What if you spill it on it?
scripts.translation:
[方]
我說過，拿著槍時別喝茶。要是灑到槍上怎麼辦？

scripts.text:
[Grinder]
Yeah, I will finish drinking first.
scripts.translation:
[研磨工]
好吧，我先把茶喝完。

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
Why do you keep wiping it?
scripts.translation:
[湯米]
你怎麼一直擦它？

scripts.text:
[Danae]
I always have to take care of it.
scripts.translation:
[達娜厄]
我得經常保養它。

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
You're so diligent.
scripts.translation:
[湯米]
你真勤快。

scripts.text:
[Fang]
I'm so tired. I will sleep after drinking a cup of tea.
scripts.translation:
[方]
我累壞了。喝完這杯茶我就去睡覺。

scripts.text:
[Grinder]
You said No.1 priority is reporting and No.2 is the gun, after the mission. Didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[研磨工]
你不是說任務結束後，第一要務是彙報，第二要務是保養槍嗎？

scripts.text:
[Fang]
I will do it after sleeping.
scripts.translation:
[方]
我睡醒了再做。

scripts.text:
[Grinder]
Oh? You once told me I must die after those No.1 and No.2 jobs!
scripts.translation:
[研磨工]
咦？你以前還說，完成第一和第二要務後就可以去死了！

scripts.text:
[Fang]
That's only for newbies. Not for me.
scripts.translation:
[方]
那是對新人的要求，對我可不適用。

scripts.text:
[Ben]
Ah, I'm so hungry. Nothing happened during my patrol today.
scripts.translation:
[本]
啊，我餓死了。今天巡邏時什麼事都沒發生。

scripts.text:
[Ben]
What was for the dinner?
scripts.translation:
[本]
晚飯吃什麼？

scripts.text:
[Markman]
I love reading books during my night duty. Where is the episode 3?
scripts.translation:
[馬克曼]
我喜歡值夜班時看書。第三集放哪兒了？

scripts.text:
[Markman]
Rookie! Where is the episode 3? Rookie! Rookie!!
scripts.translation:
[馬克曼]
新人！第三集放哪兒了？新人！新人！！

scripts.text:
[Tott]
Night fishing is the best fishing of all. The sound of water, small light and the feeling of being alone at night.
scripts.translation:
[托特]
夜釣是最棒的。聽著水聲，看著微光，獨自在夜裡垂釣，感覺真好。

scripts.text:
[Tott]
So I come out here quite often. The water is so dirty here that there is no fish here. I just enjoy the feeling.
scripts.translation:
[托特]
所以我常來這裡。這裡的水太髒，一條魚也沒有。我只是喜歡這種感覺。

scripts.text:
[Maymay]
Oh, I have to finish this.... zzzz
scripts.translation:
[梅梅]
哦，我得把這個做完...呼...（打鼾）

scripts.text:
[Corona]
This light, so beautiful. It's perfect!
scripts.translation:
[科羅娜]
這光真美，太完美了！

scripts.text:
[Corona]
Look at this. Isn't this light beautiful? It's glanced on the lamp.
scripts.translation:
[科羅娜]
快看，這光是不是很美？燈上還映出了它的光芒。

scripts.text:
[Corona]
Ha.. This is perfect. I will wipe it more so that there will be more brilliant light.
scripts.translation:
[科羅娜]
哈...太完美了。我要再擦擦，讓光芒更加耀眼。

scripts.text: Seems like you have too many belongings. Let's try it again after you remove some.
scripts.translation: 你的物品欄裡東西太多了。請先清理一些，再來試試。

scripts.text: Your belongings are too heavy. Let's try it again after you reduce the weight.
scripts.translation: 你的負重太高了。請先減輕負重，再來試試。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
A customer? I wasn't going to do business today. I'm too tired.
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
有客人？我今天本來不打算做生意，累死了。

scripts.text: I heard similar words somewhere.
scripts.translation: 我好像在哪裡聽過類似的話

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
It's just your imagination. There is no one like me in the world.
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
那只是你的錯覺。世上沒有第二個我這樣的人。

scripts.text: ^0000ffBut he still looks familiar.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff不過，他看起來還是很眼熟。^000000

scripts.text: It's a waste of time
scripts.translation: 浪費時間

scripts.text: Tell me what you sell
scripts.translation: 告訴我你賣什麼

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
Huh, go away.
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
哼，走開。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
Schwartz Honor Token, an item issued by the nation and whose transaction between individuals is prohibited. I take those items from people and upgrade their gear.
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
施瓦茨榮譽徽章是國家發行的物品，禁止個人之間交易。我會從別人那裡收取徽章，幫他們升級裝備。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
After betraying a rival in the same field, I got the secret method of upgrading. Since then, I have been working in the shadows like this ... Oh, forget it. This is not a pleasant story.
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
我背叛了同行的競爭對手，才得到這套秘密升級方法。從那以後，我就一直在暗中做這種生意...算了，這不是什麼愉快的往事。

scripts.text: (He DOES look familiar ...)
scripts.translation: (他確實看起來很眼熟...)

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
Anyway, if you have bunch of tokens and do not just throw them away, visit me. We can make a good trade.
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
總之，如果你有一堆徽章又不想扔掉，就來找我吧。我們可以做筆好交易。

scripts.text: What kind of trade?
scripts.translation: 什麼交易？

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
I provide a special upgrade for Agenda Robes, Consultation Robes and Mercenary Rings type A and B. In return, I take Schwartz Honor Tokens.
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
我可以特殊升級議程外袍、商事外袍，以及A型和B型傭兵之戒。作為交換，我收取施瓦茨榮譽徽章。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
Well, I don't have to continue nagging like this. Just bring me the tokens when there is gear that you would like to upgrade. Then we can talk about the trade in detail.
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
好了，我就不繼續囉嗦了。等你有裝備想升級時，帶徽章來找我，到時再詳談交易內容。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
Have you come for the trade? Tell me what you need.
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
你是來交易的嗎？說說你需要什麼。

scripts.text: Tell me the terms of the trade
scripts.translation: 告訴我交易條件

scripts.text: Upgrade my robe
scripts.translation: 升級我的外袍

scripts.text: Upgrade my ring
scripts.translation: 升級我的戒指

scripts.text: Initialize the upgraded capacity level of my robe
scripts.translation: 重置我的外袍升級效果

scripts.text: Initialize the upgraded capacity level of my ring
scripts.translation: 重置我的戒指升級效果

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
Listen. I won't say it twice.
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
聽好了，我只說一遍。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
I take 20 Schwartz Honor Token to upgrade the slot of an Agenda Robe or Consultation Robe. The maximum slots for the upgrade are two. And I will take 10 Schwartz Honor Token for initialization. Do you understand?
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
升級議程外袍或商事外袍的一個插槽，需要20枚施瓦茨榮譽徽章。最多可升級兩個插槽。重置需要10枚徽章。聽明白了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
Then it's Mercenary Ring type A and B. I take five tokens for upgrading a slot. The maximum slots for the upgrade are two. And I will take 10 tokens for initialization.
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
至於A型和B型傭兵之戒，每升級一個插槽需要5枚徽章，最多可升級兩個插槽。重置則需要10枚徽章。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
The initialization cannot be conducted at any time. I will only do it after you are granted two effects and cannot upgrade the gear any more. And ... then ...
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
不能隨時重置。只有在裝備已經獲得兩項效果、無法繼續升級時，我才會幫你重置。而且...到時候...

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
There is a slight problem. Mercenary Ring type A and B might be destroyed during the initialization. The probability is about 20 percent. Since they are small items, there are serious side effects when eliminating the upgraded effect.
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
有個小問題：重置A型或B型傭兵之戒時，戒指可能會損壞，機率大約是20%。戒指是小型物品，移除升級效果時會產生嚴重的副作用。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
I look forward to having a good business relationship with you, fellow.
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
期待和你合作愉快，朋友。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
For the Consultation Robe and Agenda Robe, you need 20 Schwartz Honor Tokens for each slot. Are you sure you want to upgrade it?
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
升級商事外袍或議程外袍的每個插槽都需要20枚施瓦茨榮譽徽章。你確定要升級嗎？

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 不要

scripts.text: Let's do it
scripts.translation: 開始升級

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
Since I am busy, do not talk to me pointlessly from now on.
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
我很忙，以後沒事別來打擾我。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
You are taking off your gear.
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
你正在脫下裝備。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
Hey, grow up. If you want to upgrade your gear, you must put it on properly first.
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
認真點。想升級裝備，就先把它穿戴好。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
No more upgrade is possible on this gear. Do you have anything else?
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
這件裝備已經不能再升級了。還有別的東西要升級嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
Listen, fellow. If you don't have any {0}, you cannot trade with me.
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
聽著，夥計。你沒有{0}就不能和我交易。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
Hmm, it's been done well. Check your item.
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
嗯，處理好了。檢查一下你的物品。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
You need five Schwartz Honor Tokens to upgrade a slot of Mercenary Ring type A and B equipped on your left slot. Are you sure you want to upgrade it?
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
升級佩戴在左側飾品欄的A型或B型傭兵之戒的一個插槽，需要5枚施瓦茨榮譽徽章。要升級嗎？

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text: Let's do it
scripts.translation: 開始升級

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
Since I am busy, do not talk to me pointlessly from now on.
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
我很忙，以後沒事別來打擾我。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
I forgot to tell you something. I only upgrade accessories equipped on the left slot. Equip it on your left slot first and then let me upgrade it.
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
我忘了告訴你，我只升級佩戴在左側飾品欄的飾品。請先把它裝備在左側，再來找我升級。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
Hey, grow up. If you want to upgrade your Mercenary Ring, you must put it on properly first.
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
認真點。想升級傭兵之戒，就先把它戴好。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
No more upgrade is possible on this gear. Do you have anything else?
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
這件裝備已經不能再升級了。還有別的東西要升級嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
Listen, fellow. If you don't have any {0}, you cannot trade with me.
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
聽著，夥計。你沒有{0}就不能和我交易。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
Hmm, it's been done well. Check your item.
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
嗯，處理好了。檢查一下你的物品。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
To initialize the Consultation Robe or Agenda Robe, you need 10 Schwartz Honor Tokens. The gear itself will not be destroyed. The card you already inserted and its smelting level will be safe as well.
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
重置商事外袍或議程外袍需要10枚施瓦茨榮譽徽章。裝備本身不會損壞，已經插入的卡片和精煉等級也會保留。

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text: Let's do it
scripts.translation: 開始重置

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
Since I am busy, do not talk to me pointlessly from now on.
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
我很忙，以後沒事別來打擾我。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
You are taking off your gear.
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
你正在脫下裝備。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
Whoops, this item has not been fully upgraded. The initialization is not possible yet.
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
哎呀，這件裝備還沒有完全升級，現在無法重置。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
Whoops, this item has not been fully upgraded. The initialization is not possible yet.
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
哎呀，這件裝備還沒有完全升級，現在無法重置。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
Listen, fellow. If you don't have any {0}, you cannot trade with me.
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
聽著，夥計。你沒有{0}就不能和我交易。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
Hmm, it's been done well. Check your item.
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
嗯，處理好了。檢查一下你的物品。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
You need 10 Schwartz Honor Tokens to upgrade Mercenary Ring type A and B equipped on your left slot.
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
升級佩戴在左側飾品欄的A型或B型傭兵之戒，需要10枚施瓦茨榮譽徽章。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
As I explained before, the initialization of rings is quite hard. ^ff0000The success rate is 80 percent.^000000 If it fails, the item is gone. Are you sure you want to do this?
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
正如我之前說的，重置戒指有風險。^ff0000成功率為80%。^000000失敗的話，戒指就會消失。你確定要重置嗎？

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text: Let's do it
scripts.translation: 開始重置

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
Since I am busy, do not talk to me pointlessly from now on.
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
我很忙，以後沒事別來打擾我。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
I am telling you in advance. Every time you initialize the ring, there is a 20 percent probability of destruction. Are you sure you want to continue?
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
先提醒你：每次重置戒指都有20%的機率損毀。確定要繼續嗎？

scripts.text: Stop
scripts.translation: 停止

scripts.text: Continue
scripts.translation: 繼續

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
Yes. Good idea.
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
好主意。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
I forgot to tell you something. I only initialize accessories equipped on the left slot. Equip it on your left slot first and then let me initialize it.
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
我忘了告訴你，我只重置佩戴在左側飾品欄的飾品。請先把它裝備在左側，再來找我重置。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
Whoops, this item has not been fully upgraded. The initialization is not possible yet.
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
哎呀，這件裝備還沒有完全升級，現在無法重置。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
Whoops, this item has not been fully upgraded. The initialization is not possible yet.
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
哎呀，這件裝備還沒有完全升級，現在無法重置。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
Listen, fellow. If you don't have any {0}, you cannot trade with me.
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
聽著，夥計。你沒有{0}就不能和我交易。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
Oh, you are unlucky today. Your gear has been badly damaged.
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
哎呀，你今天運氣不好，裝備嚴重損壞了。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
Hmm, it's been done well. Check your item.
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
嗯，處理好了。檢查一下你的物品。

scripts.text:
[Butterfly Merchant]
... ... ... ... ...
Do you need {0}?

[Imperial Operator]
Hello.
We have ^4d4dffImperial^000000 equipment that can be exchanged for {0}.
I will guide you to exchange items according to your job.
scripts.translation:
[帝國操作員]
你好。
我們這裡有可以用{0}兌換的^4d4dff帝國^000000裝備。
我會根據你的職業為你介紹兌換物品。

scripts.text:
[Strasse]
You have too much in your inventory.
Please make it lighter and come back.
scripts.translation:
[斯特拉瑟]
你的背包裡東西太多了。
請先清理一些，再來試試。

scripts.text:
[Strasse]
You have too much in your inventory.
Please make it lighter and come back.
scripts.translation:
[斯特拉瑟]
你的背包太重了。
減輕負重後再來。

scripts.text:
[Strasse]
Hello. How may I help you?
scripts.translation:
[斯特拉瑟]
你好，有什麼需要我幫忙？

scripts.text:
[Strasse]
Hmm... You don't have any Schwartz Honor Tokens.
Please come back after taking care of other tasks.
scripts.translation:
[斯特拉瑟]
嗯...你沒有施瓦茨榮譽徽章。
請先處理其他事情，之後再來。

scripts.text:
[Strasse]
Oh, you brought the Schwartz Honor Tokens.
I always thank you for your help.
We have to show you our gratitude in return.
scripts.translation:
[斯特拉瑟]
哦，你帶來了施瓦茨榮譽徽章。
一直以來承蒙你幫忙，非常感謝。
我們也應該好好答謝你。

scripts.text:
[Strasse]
For our cooperators who brought certain amount of tokens, we will grant gifts. Please choose items you require.
scripts.translation:
[斯特拉瑟]
凡是帶來一定數量徽章的協力者，我們都會贈送禮物。請選擇你需要的物品。

scripts.text:
[Strasse]
Which one would you like to select?
scripts.translation:
[斯特拉瑟]
你想選哪一件？

scripts.text: Agenda Robe
scripts.translation: 議程外袍

scripts.text: Consultation Robe
scripts.translation: 商事外袍

scripts.text: Costume Combat Vestige
scripts.translation: （時裝）戰鬥遺痕

scripts.text: Hat of Republic
scripts.translation: 共和國之帽

scripts.text: Mercenary Ring A type
scripts.translation: 傭兵之戒A型

scripts.text: Mercenary Ring B type
scripts.translation: 傭兵之戒B型

scripts.text:
[Strasse]
{0}? I got it.
You need {1} Schwartz Honor Tokens.
Are you sure you want this?
scripts.translation:
[斯特拉瑟]
{0}？知道了。
需要{1}枚施瓦茨榮譽徽章。
確定要兌換嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Strasse]
Please come back after you decided.
scripts.translation:
[斯特拉瑟]
決定好之後再來吧。

scripts.text:
[Strasse]
You don't have enough tokens...
Please collect some more.
scripts.translation:
[斯特拉瑟]
你的徽章不夠...
請再收集一些。

scripts.text:
[Strasse]
Here is your {0}.
scripts.translation:
[斯特拉瑟]
這是你的{0}。

scripts.text:
[Rotten]
Ah, I hate cleaning. Why don't they develop a machine that does the cleaning automatically?
scripts.translation:
[爛人]
唉，我討厭打掃。為什麼不發明一臺能自動打掃的機器呢？

scripts.text:
[Master]
You have too many items in your inventory. Why don't you come back after making it lighter? It looks too heavy.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
你的背包裡東西太多了。先清理一些，減輕負重再回來。

scripts.text:
[Master]
Authorized Personnel Only. Stay away.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
閒人免進。離遠點。

scripts.text:
[Master]
Adventurer, please take a good rest today. You must take of yourself.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
冒險者，今天好好休息。照顧好自己。

scripts.text:
[Master]
I will see you tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
明天見。

scripts.text:
[Master]
Welcome back, adventurer. Did you have a good rest mentally and physically?
scripts.translation:
[師父]
歡迎回來，冒險者。身心都休息好了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Master]
Last night, many weapons were not returned. I really have to teach these guys some lesson...
scripts.translation:
[師父]
昨晚有很多武器沒還回來。我真得好好教訓這些傢伙...

scripts.text:
[Master]
Anyway, I will count on you. ^0000cdGo down from Einbech and find Suspicious Heap of Earth^000000 and investigate it. Then ^0000cdbring about three broken guns^000000 please.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
總之，拜託你了。^0000cd從艾音貝赫往下走，找到可疑的土堆^000000並調查。然後請^0000cd帶回大約三把破損的槍^000000。

scripts.text:
[Master]
Ha........... There are so many guys who did not return their weapons.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
唉...這麼多人沒還武器。

scripts.text:
[Master]
Welcome, adventurer. You came back earlier than we expected. Didn't the Grudges attack you?
scripts.translation:
[師父]
歡迎回來，冒險者。你比預想中回來得早。沒被怨恨襲擊嗎？

scripts.text:
[Master]
So you've brought what I told you? Let's see...
scripts.translation:
[師父]
你把我要的東西帶來了嗎？我看看...

scripts.text:
[Master]
Hmm.. Not enough. I asked you to bring ^0000cdthree Broken Gun^000000.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
嗯...數量不夠。我讓你帶^0000cd三把破損的槍^000000。

scripts.text:
[Master]
^0000cdGo down from Einbech^000000 and investigate ^0000cdSuspicious Heap of earth^000000 in several places. Then you can find them.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
^0000cd從艾音貝赫往下走^000000，調查幾處^0000cd可疑的土堆^000000，就能找到它們。

scripts.text:
[Master]
Since there are Grudges, I know it's not easy. But we will count on you.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
那裡有怨恨，我知道這趟不容易。不過就拜託你了。

scripts.text:
[Master]
You've brought enough broken guns. But we cannot use them.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
破損的槍數量夠了，但這些不能用。

scripts.text:
[Master]
I guess you have to search at least five Heap of Earth and defeat about five Grudge.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
看來你至少得搜查五個土堆，再打倒大約五個怨恨。

scripts.text:
[Master]
I know you worked hard for us to bring them. Sorry to ask you once again.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
我知道你費了很大勁才把它們帶回來。抱歉還得再麻煩你一次。

scripts.text:
[Master]
My god... It's amazing. You've reclaimed all these weapons in that short time. They've been hiding so many weapons everywhere.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
天哪...真了不起！這麼快就找回了所有武器。他們竟然把武器藏得到處都是。

scripts.text:
[Master]
Adventurer, you must be tired today. Take a rest and come back after the ^0000cddawn^000000 tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
冒險者，你今天一定累壞了。好好休息，明天^0000cd天亮^000000後再來。

scripts.text:
[Master]
Thank you so much.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
非常感謝。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello? can I take a look around?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你好？我可以四處看看嗎？

scripts.text:
[Master]
Oh, you are the famous adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
哦，你就是那位有名的冒險者。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What am I famous for?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我有什麼名氣？

scripts.text:
[Master]
They say we had an outsider after a long time. And the outsider persuaded us to cooperate with the government.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
聽說很久沒外人來過了。那位外人還說服我們和政府合作。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I haven't done so much.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我沒做什麼大事。

scripts.text:
[Master]
But that's what I heard.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
可我聽到的就是這樣。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
By the way, what is this place? Since there are so many guns, I guess this is an armory.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
對了，這是什麼地方？這裡有這麼多槍，應該是軍火庫吧？

scripts.text:
[Master]
Sort of. We lend weapons for Rebellions here.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
差不多吧。我們在這裡把武器借給叛亂軍。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
They have their own weapons. And you lend them more?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他們自己有武器，你們還要借給他們更多？

scripts.text:
[Master]
You are right. But according to the task and circumstance, sometimes we need additional weapons
scripts.translation:
[師父]
沒錯。不過根據任務和情況，有時確實需要額外的武器。

scripts.text:
[Master]
And for newbies, we don't know which gun is suitable for each of them. So they have to try many different guns.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
新人不清楚哪種槍適合自己，所以得多試幾種。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So they can borrow them here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
所以他們可以在這裡借槍。

scripts.text:
[Master]
Yes. They must write down the period, names and the purpose on the ledger. When returning them, they only have to sign.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
是的。他們必須在登記簿上寫明借用期限、姓名和用途。歸還時籤個名就行。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It's inconvenient. I thought you would just lend them without any procedure.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
真麻煩。我還以為直接借給他們就行，不用這麼多手續。

scripts.text:
[Master]
Originally, they used to borrow and returned guns without having to write anything. But almost nobody returned them. We have limited resources so we cannot just keep producing and purchasing our weapons.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
以前借還槍都不用登記，可幾乎沒人歸還。資源有限，我們不能一直生產和購買新武器。

scripts.text:
[Master]
That's how we developed a system like this. It's due to the guys living here.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
這裡的人害我們不得不建立這套制度。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This is the ledger...

[Master]
Don't scrutinize it. Just in case you forgot, you are an outsider.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
別仔細看。別忘了，你是外人。

scripts.text:
[Master]
Please keep in mind that we have been the most mysterious and exclusive organization in Schwaltzvalt lately.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
記住，施瓦爾茨瓦爾德最近一直是最神秘、最排外的組織。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It's amazing. What are these red lines?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
真厲害。這些紅線是什麼？

scripts.text:
[Master]
Those who did not return weapons.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
這些是沒歸還武器的人。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So many of them.. Even if you manage it thoroughly?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這麼多人...管理得再仔細也會這樣嗎？

scripts.text:
[Master]
Since these are not their private firearms, they handle them carelessly. They don't realize that they have to handle things with care.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
這些不是他們自己的槍，所以他們用起來很不愛惜，根本不懂得小心使用。

scripts.text:
[Master]
Once they are broken, they must bring them here to repair. But they just throw them away. They don't bring them back here even though we give them penalty, claiming that they lost them.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
槍壞了本該拿來修，可他們直接扔掉。就算我們罰他們，他們也謊稱弄丟了，不肯拿回來。

scripts.text:
[Master]
Oh! Great! Adventurer, if you have time, could you help us?
scripts.translation:
[師父]
哦！太好了！冒險者，你有空幫幫我們嗎？

scripts.text: I always like working.
scripts.translation: 我就喜歡幹活

scripts.text: Sorry. I can't
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我沒空

scripts.text:
[{0}]
All of a sudden? Maybe not now...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這麼突然？我現在可能沒空...

scripts.text:
[Master]
Well, it's not urgent. Please find them when you have time.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
不急，有空的時候幫忙找找就行。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. I will.

[{0}]
All of a sudden? Well, I always like working.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這麼突然？不過我就喜歡幹活。

scripts.text:
[Master]
It's good attitude. Please take a look the guys with red lines. And reclaim those weapons that they threw away.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
態度不錯。看看那些畫了紅線的人，把他們扔掉的武器找回來。

scripts.text:
[Master]
While they are on mission, most of them reclaim their weapons once they are broken. By the time they arrive at Einbech, they think of me who scolds them and just throw the weapons away.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
他們出任務時，武器一壞通常就會找回來。可他們到了艾音貝赫，一想到我會訓人，就把槍扔了。

scripts.text:
[Master]
Sometimes I reclaim them when I have time. Sometimes I send newbies to bring the. But as you see, we have been quite busy lately.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
我有空時會去找，有時也派新人去拿。不過你也看到了，最近大家都很忙。

scripts.text:
[Master]
And once you touch the wreckage...
scripts.translation:
[師父]
而且一碰那些殘骸...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What happens?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
會發生什麼？

scripts.text:
[Master]
Oh... Grudges of guns come out and attack you. You have to see them yourself. Seeing is believing.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
哦...槍的怨恨會跑出來攻擊你。你得親眼看看才知道。

scripts.text:
[Master]
Go around ^0000cdseveral places in the field below Einbech ^000000 and reclaim ^0000cdBroken Guns^000000 inside Suspicious Heap of Earth.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
去艾音貝赫下方的野外^0000cd幾個地點^000000轉轉，從可疑土堆裡找回^0000cd破損的槍^000000。

scripts.text:
[Master]
Let me see from the newest one... Bring ^0000cdabout three of them^000000 please. If you bring too many of them, it will be hard to repair.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
讓我看看最新的那批...請帶^0000cd大約三把^000000回來。帶太多的話，修理起來會很麻煩。

scripts.text:
[Master]
Welcome back. Have you brought what I ask you for?
scripts.translation:
[師父]
歡迎回來。把我要的東西帶來了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Master]
Hmm.. Not enough. I asked you to bring three Broken Gun.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
嗯...數量不夠。我讓你帶三把破損的槍。

scripts.text:
[Master]
Go down from Einbech and investigate Suspicious Heap of Earth in several places. Then you can find them.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
從艾音貝赫往下走，調查幾處可疑的土堆，就能找到它們。

scripts.text:
[Master]
Since there are Grudges, I know it's not easy. But we will count on you.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
那裡有怨靈，我知道這趟不容易。不過就拜託你了。

scripts.text:
[Master]
You've brought enough broken guns. But we cannot use them.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
你帶回來的破槍數量夠了，但這些不能用。

scripts.text:
[Master]
I guess you have to search at least five Heap of Earth and defeat about five Grudge.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
看來你至少得搜查五個土堆，再打倒大約五個怨靈。

scripts.text:
[Master]
I know you worked hard for us to bring them. Sorry to ask you once again.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
我知道你費了很大勁才把它們帶回來。抱歉還得再麻煩你一次。

scripts.text:
[Master]
You have brought enough amount. Thank you so much.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
數量夠了。非常感謝。

scripts.text:
[Master]
By the way, he should be here now.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
對了，他現在應該到了。

scripts.text:
[Daryl]
I'm here.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
達里爾，你來了。

scripts.text:
[Master]
And your weapon?
scripts.translation:
[師父]
你的武器呢？

scripts.text:
[Daryl]
I don't have it.
scripts.translation:
[達里爾]
我沒帶。

scripts.text:
[Master]
Why not?
scripts.translation:
[師父]
為什麼？

scripts.text:
[Daryl]
I lost it.
scripts.translation:
[達里爾]
我弄丟了。

scripts.text:
[Master]
Heck, good job.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
哼，幹得真好啊。

scripts.text:
[Daryl]
Well, not such a good job.
scripts.translation:
[達里爾]
呃，這可不是什麼好事。

scripts.text:
[Master]
You did a great job. So you'll lose your weapon again, won't you?
scripts.translation:
[師父]
你幹得真不錯啊。然後又把武器弄丟了，是吧？

scripts.text:
[Daryl]
No.
scripts.translation:
[達里爾]
沒有。

scripts.text:
[Master]
What did I tell you? You can lost yourself, but never lose your weapon!
scripts.translation:
[師父]
我跟你說過什麼？你可以把自己弄丟，但絕不能把武器弄丟！

scripts.text:
[Daryl]
Sorry.
scripts.translation:
[達里爾]
對不起。

scripts.text:
[Master]
It doesn't look like an attitude of someone who's sorry. You lost something you borrowed. Now give me yours.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
你這副樣子可不像在道歉。你把借來的東西弄丟了，現在把自己的武器交出來。

scripts.text:
[Daryl]
No! Never! Don't touch me! Yikes!
scripts.translation:
[達里爾]
不！絕不！別碰我！哇！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well... Can I leave now?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那個...我現在可以走了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Daryl]
No, you can't! I don't know who you are. But please save me!
scripts.translation:
[達里爾]
不行！我不知道你是誰，但求你救救我！

scripts.text:
[Master]
Right! We have to compensate you. First, let's see who threw this away.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
沒錯，我們得補償你。先看看是誰把這東西丟掉的。

scripts.text:
[Master]
Let's see... Who threw this away..? The serial numbers are...
scripts.translation:
[師父]
我看看...是誰把它丟掉的...序列號是...

scripts.text:
[Master]
... Daryl?
scripts.translation:
[師父]
...達里爾？

scripts.text:
[Daryl]
Yeah, huh?
scripts.translation:
[達里爾]
嗯？怎麼了？

scripts.text:
[Master]
The weapon you borrowed last time.. You said you lost it, didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[師父]
你上次借走的那把武器...不是說弄丟了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Daryl]
My god. Why is it there...
scripts.translation:
[達里爾]
天哪，它怎麼會在那裡...

scripts.text:
[Master]
You begged me for the weapon!! Just because it's not yours, you broke it like this and threw it away? Why didn't you do this to your own weapon?
scripts.translation:
[師父]
你當時可是苦苦求我借給你的！！就因為不是自己的，你就把它弄壞後扔掉了？怎麼不拿自己的武器這麼幹？

scripts.text:
[Daryl]
My Lady!! I have to treasure it!!!
scripts.translation:
[達里爾]
我的女士！！我得好好珍惜它！！！

scripts.text:
[Master]
This is not the first time and I have the smoking gun here. You have nothing to say now!
scripts.translation:
[師父]
這已經不是第一次了，而且證據就在眼前。這下你沒話說了吧！

scripts.text:
[Master]
We will keep your Lady for a while. You reflect on yourself in the training room for some time!
scripts.translation:
[師父]
我們先把你的女士扣在這裡。你去訓練室好好反省一陣子！

scripts.text:
[Master]
Trainees!!!
scripts.translation:
[師父]
學員們！！！

scripts.text:
[Master]
Come and drag him out!
scripts.translation:
[師父]
過來把他拖出去！

scripts.text:
[Daryl]
What???
scripts.translation:
[達里爾]
什麼？？？

scripts.text:
[Daryl]
No! Not the target please! I don't want to die yet!!! I'm sorry! It's my fault! I'll never do it again!
scripts.translation:
[達里爾]
不！不要把我當靶子！我還不想死啊！！！對不起！都是我的錯！我再也不敢了！

scripts.text:
[Master]
You must be so tired by now. Take some rest. Can we count on you tomorrow? If you are interested, come back to us after the dawn.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
你一定累壞了，先休息吧。明天還能拜託你嗎？有興趣的話，天亮後再回來找我們。

scripts.text:
[Master]
Thank you so much.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
非常感謝。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You've reclaimed enough of them. Let's go back to the Master.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你已經找回足夠多的東西了。我們回去找師父吧。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Why do you carry so many stuffs? Unless you want to give them away, make your bag lighter and come back.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
你怎麼帶了這麼多東西？除非是要送人的，不然先清理一下背包再回來。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Why do you carry so many stuffs? Unless you want to give them away, make your bag lighter and come back.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
你怎麼帶了這麼多東西？除非是要送人的，不然先清理一下背包再回來。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
If you value your life, don't stimulate the people here. Many of them are short-tempered.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
想活命就別惹這裡的人，他們很多脾氣都不好。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
As you promised me, just drink a cup of tea and go back.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
答應過我的話，就喝杯茶然後回去吧。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Did you meet all of them? They must be on the 2nd floor.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
都見過了嗎？他們應該在二樓。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Can you see the doors on the 2nd floor? Just visit four of them.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
看到二樓那些門了嗎？隨便拜訪四間就行。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
As long as you behave yourself... nothing bad will happen. Maybe...?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
只要你規規矩矩的...就不會出什麼事。大概吧...？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Did you meet everyone on the 2nd floor? Great job. It must have been frightening.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
二樓的人都見過了嗎？幹得好。一定嚇壞了吧。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Although they are quite frightening... they are all good people.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
他們看起來確實挺嚇人...不過都是好人。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Don't you have to report to Lazy now?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
你現在該去向懶散彙報了吧？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Rookie, how have you been?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
新人，最近怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Adventurer, how was your business? Lazy told me that I could fully trust you.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
冒險者，事情辦得怎麼樣？懶散說他完全信任你。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
All of us are also eager and preparing many things. We should not disappoint that person~
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我們大家也都很期待，正在準備很多東西。可不能讓那個人失望啊~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I will do my best. Rookie, what have you been doing recently? How was your talk with Lazy?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我會盡力的。新人，你最近在忙什麼？和懶散聊得怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
I'm still here. This fellow cannot leave immediately. Neither can I.
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
我還在這裡呢。這傢伙不能馬上離開，我也走不了。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
What I've been doing recently?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我最近在忙什麼？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Adventurer? I told you to take a good rest. Didn't I?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
冒險者？我不是叫你好好休息嗎？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
At this time of the day, everyone is taking a rest. Please go back and rest.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
現在大家都在休息。請回去休息吧。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
I'm afraid you will collapse from overwork. The health is the most important. Please take some rest.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我擔心你會累垮。身體健康最重要，請好好休息。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Welcome, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
歡迎，冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Although you didn't have to come here, you took the trouble. I mean... Thanks.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
你其實不用特地跑這一趟的...我是說，謝謝你。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...You told me I had to come here, didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...不是你說我必須來的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Here come Denny again, the superstar!!!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
超級巨星丹尼又登場啦！！！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Well, speak of the devil.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
說曹操，曹操到。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Yikes! It's cold!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
哎呀！好冰！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
My job is to prevent such a fool from doing silly things.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我的工作就是防止這種笨蛋做傻事。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Oh, come on! Who keeps putting the bucket here? Every time I take it away, somebody puts it here again! Who is it? Is it a pervert who enjoys watching other people's feet getting wet?
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
喂！你怎麼能這樣對我？是誰老把水桶放在這兒？我每次拿走，就又有人放回來！到底是誰？難道是個喜歡看別人腳被淋溼的變態？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
It's me.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
是我。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Hey! How can you do this to me?
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
喂！你怎麼能這樣對我？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
As long as you ^0000cdwalk on the pipe^000000 instead of the stairs, it's your fault. The pipe is innocent. How can you do that to the pipe!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
誰叫你^0000cd不走樓梯，偏要踩著管道走^000000。水管是無辜的，你怎麼能這樣對它！

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Look. There are four walls and four corners. So there must be four stairs. There are only two stairs and it's so inconvenient on the sides where there are no stairs!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
你看，這裡四面牆、四個角，理應有四段樓梯。結果只有兩段，沒有樓梯的那兩邊走起來太不方便了！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Do not complain it to me. Talk to the one who designed this place.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
別跟我抱怨，去找設計這裡的人說。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Where is that person!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
那個人在哪裡！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
He's dead. Not here.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
死了，不在這裡。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
...... You are doing this to me on purpose, aren't you? Why do you hate mu so much?
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
...你是故意整我的吧？你為什麼這麼討厭我？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Why do you think I put this bucket here?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
你覺得我為什麼把水桶放在這兒？

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Because you like to see my feet get wet.
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
因為你喜歡看我的腳被淋溼。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Hey!!! Are you saying I'm a pervert? You keep walking on the pipe every day with that huge boday. As a result, this skinny pipe is damaged! There! And there! Can you see the water leakage?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
喂！！！你說我是變態？你每天都踩著那根管道走，光是你那龐大的身軀就快把細管壓壞了！看這裡，還有那裡！看到漏水了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Oh, it's true.
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
哦，好像真是這樣。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
I put the bucket there to receive the leaking water! Once the pipe is entirely broken, there will be a flood in this place! Don't you have the brain to think of it?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我放水桶是為了接漏出來的水！管道要是徹底破了，這裡就會淹水！你就沒想過這一點嗎？

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Well, I didn't think about it. Why don't you repair the pipe?
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
嗯，我沒想到。那你為什麼不修好管道？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
That's why I've been waiting here!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
所以我才一直在這裡等啊！

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Oh~ I see. Then I'll count on you! Make it solid! If you have enough time, please make something I can hold on.
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
哦~我懂了。那就拜託你了！把它修結實點！有空的話，再做個讓我能抓住的東西。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
No. I will just supervise it.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
不，我只負責監督。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Then who's going to repair it? There's nobody here.
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
那誰來修？這裡又沒有別人。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Are you sure there's nobody here?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
你確定這裡沒人嗎？

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
冒險者？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
No, I can't make our guest work.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
不行，不能讓客人幹活。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Then?
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
那怎麼辦？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Do you know who it is?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
你知道該誰去嗎？

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Oh... me?
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
哦...我嗎？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Exactly! As a reward, I will give you an opportunity to bring the parts to repair the pipe.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
沒錯！作為獎勵，我給你一個機會，讓你去拿修管道的零件。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Well, I'm quite busy...
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
可是我很忙...

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
I know you are off-duty today.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我知道你今天休假。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
I'm so hungry and have to eat... I should take care of my kitty... And...
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
我餓了，得去吃飯...還得照顧我的小貓...還有...

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
You are the one who damaged it. So you must repair it.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
管道是你弄壞的，所以必須由你修。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Please, please! To repair this, we need some metal things. To get them, I have to enter the mine!!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
拜託了！修管道需要一些金屬零件。要拿到它們，我就得進礦坑！！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
That's correct! Go get them now.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
說得對！現在就去拿。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
I'm afraid of the mine. Please don't send me to the mine. Please... Brother, please...
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
我怕礦坑，別讓我去那裡。拜託...大哥，求你了...

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Ouch, you are right. Then what shall we do...? We need to repair it as soon as possible.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
唉，你說得也有道理。那我們怎麼辦...？必須儘快修好才行。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
What if someone else brings the parts and I repair it?
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
要不讓別人把零件帶來，我來修？

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Please do this for me, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
冒險者，求你幫幫我。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Hey! How can you say that to the guest!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
喂！你怎麼能讓客人做這種事！

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Hey, why! Adventurers normally carry about 30,000 metal things in their pockets! That's what I found from most adventurers!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
為什麼不行！冒險者通常隨身帶著三萬個金屬零件！我觀察過很多冒險者，都是這樣！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Is that... true?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
真...真的嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, I never bring that many.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
才沒有，我從來不帶那麼多。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Hey, look at that!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
喂，你聽見了嗎！

scripts.text:
[Denny]
But you can get them so easily! Since we have only handled stuffs like guns, it's hard for us to get them. I've seen many adventures who get those items quite easily.
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
可冒險者要弄到這些東西很容易啊！我們只接觸槍械之類的東西，很難弄到零件。我見過好多冒險者輕輕鬆鬆就拿到了。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Is that... true?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
真...真的嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, it isn't...

[Denny]
Everyone says no to this question. But they still get them like a piece of cake! I saw them!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
大家都這麼回答，可他們拿起來還是輕輕鬆鬆的！我親眼看見了！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Adventurer, I don't know whether it is true or not. But would you mind bringing them for us?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
冒險者，我也不知道他說的是真是假。不過，你願意幫我們帶一些回來嗎？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
This pipe will be destroyed completely. Then there will be flood here. Since this place is a hideout, it will be revealed once it is flooded. Then... We will...
scripts.translation:
[新人]
這根管道很快就會徹底破裂，到時這裡會淹水。這裡既然是據點，一旦被水淹就會暴露。然後...我們就...

scripts.text:
[Denny]
I'm so sad.
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
我好難過。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
We really have to repair it urgently. But this guy cannot go to the mine due to a certain reason. Also, I cannot go to the mine for other job. We will certainly compensate for your support.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我們確實急著修好管道。但這傢伙因為某些原因不敢去礦坑，而我還有別的任務，走不開。我們一定會答謝你。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Compensate? You never told me about it! Let me do it!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
答謝？你怎麼從來沒跟我說過！那讓我去吧！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
So you're going to the mine?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
所以你願意去礦坑了？

scripts.text:
[Denny]
No...

[{0}]
Now that you mention it... I will go. What do you need?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
既然你這麼說...我去。需要什麼？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
We need ^0000cdfive Steel and 15 Old Steel Plate^000000.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我們需要^0000cd5塊鋼鐵和15塊舊鋼板^000000。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
And please ^0000cddefeat Scrap Heaters^000000. About 10 of them! This is my personal request!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
還請^0000cd打倒廢鐵暖爐^000000。大約10只！這是我個人拜託你的！

scripts.text: Accept.
scripts.translation: 接受

scripts.text: Reject.
scripts.translation: 拒絕

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It will be difficult for me. I'm sorry that you have to find someone else.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我可能辦不到，抱歉，你們得另找別人。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Oh, why!!!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
為什麼！！！

scripts.text:
[Denny]
I'm so sad!!!!!!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
我好難過！！！！！！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Phew, he's so rude. We have no choice. I will look for someone else to do it. You don't have to worry about this.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
唉，他真沒禮貌。沒辦法，我再找別人幫忙。你不用擔心。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I can do that.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我可以幫忙。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Look! What did I say? Every adventurer is strong!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
看吧！我說什麼來著？冒險者都很強！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Hey, would you reject it in front of someone? Adventurer? You don't have to do this.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
喂，怎麼能當著人家的面拒絕呢？冒險者，你不用勉強。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Welcome. See you soon.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
歡迎。回頭見。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Yes! We will be waiting!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
好！我們等你！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Be careful!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
小心！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Great job, adventurer. I must have been hard for you to take that job all of a sudden.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
幹得好，冒險者。突然接下這份委託，肯定很辛苦。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Here come Denny again, the superstar!!!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
超級巨星丹尼又登場啦！！！

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Adventurer! Have you brought them all? Let me see.
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
冒險者！東西都帶齊了嗎？讓我看看。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Well... As I told you, please bring ^0000cdfive Steel and 15 Old Steel Plate^000000. We need them to repair the pipe.
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
嗯...就像我說的，請帶^0000cd5塊鋼鐵和15塊舊鋼板^000000。我們要用它們修水管。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Adventurer, you know how to take shortcuts. I like it.
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
冒險者，你挺會走捷徑嘛。我喜歡。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
But I really need them. So please bring them to me. Will you?
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
不過我真的需要它們。能帶給我嗎？拜託了。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Superstar Denny is going home now!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
超級巨星丹尼要回家啦！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
What kind of superstar is that? After all, we are counting on you. He is more persistent than he looks. So I am saying this for you.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
這算哪門子超級巨星？總之就拜託你了。他看著不怎麼樣，其實很固執。我這是為你好。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
You have brought the Steel and Old Steel Plates...
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
鋼鐵和舊鋼板都帶來了...

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Apparently, you did not defeat ^0000cd10 Waste Stoves^000000. I cannot smell the iron.
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
看來你還沒打倒^0000cd10只廢鐵暖爐^000000。我還聞不到鐵味。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Although it is my private request, I wish you could do it for me.
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
雖然這是我個人的請求，但還是希望你能幫我。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Superstar Denny is going home now!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
超級巨星丹尼要回家啦！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
What kind of superstar is that? After all, we are counting on you. He is more persistent than he looks. So I am saying this for you.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
這算哪門子超級巨星？總之就拜託你了。他看著不怎麼樣，其實很固執。我這是為你好。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Wow~~~ Great! You never disappoint me!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
哇~~~太棒了！你果然沒讓我失望！

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Let me spread your legendary story around the entire continent! Everyone needs to know that!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
我要把你的傳奇故事傳遍整個大陸！讓所有人都知道！

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Then I will go and prepare for repairing! I will count on you again!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
那我去準備修理了！下次還拜託你！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
He went back only after saying what he wants. How spoiled! But I didn't educate him like that.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
這傢伙只顧著說自己的事，說完就回去了。真被寵壞了！不過我可沒這麼慣著他。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Please take a good rest today. We will count on you again tomorrow. You must be exhausted.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
今天好好休息吧。明天還得拜託你，你一定累壞了。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Welcome, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
歡迎，冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Although you didn't have to come here, you took the trouble. I mean... Thanks.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
雖然你其實不用特地過來，但還是謝謝你跑這一趟。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...You told me I had to come here, didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...不是你說我必須來的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Yikes, it's so cold!
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
哎呀，好冷！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
I have to listen to complaints of all the people. That's a problem.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我得聽所有人的抱怨，真傷腦筋。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
What's so cold? It's the same as yesterday
scripts.translation:
[新人]
冷什麼？跟昨天一樣啊。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Hey, my feeling is so accurate. It's colder today. Look. You put on more clothes.
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
我的感覺很準，今天更冷了。你看，你穿得更厚了。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Oh! When did I get dressed like this!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
咦！我什麼時候穿成這樣的！

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Let's see... I thought so. The fireplace is weaker now. No firewood?
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
讓我看看...果然，壁爐火力變弱了。沒柴火了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Well, it's true.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
嗯，確實如此。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Once this last firewood is burnt out, I will die... Last... firewood...
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
最後一根柴火燒完，我就要死了...最後一根柴火...

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Who told you that you'd die? You're so healthy!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
誰說你會死？你明明很健康！

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Come on, Just echo my words while I'm sentimental!!
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
拜託，我正多愁善感呢，你就順著我的話說嘛！！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Oh, don't die. If you die, who's going to take care of those 12 kids. Please don't die.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
別死啊！你死了，誰照顧那12個孩子？千萬別死。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Hey! Who are my kids! And why do I have to feed them? What happened?
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
喂！那些孩子是誰的？我為什麼要養他們？怎麼回事？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Your spouse... died during a mission.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
你的配偶...在任務中去世了。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
My god! So who's my spouse?
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
天哪！那我的配偶是誰？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Well... The Teddy bear?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
嗯...泰迪熊？

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Oops! No! Let's say this adventurer is my spouse.
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
哎呀，不是！就說這位冒險者是我的伴侶吧。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Hey! That's rude!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
喂！這也太失禮了！

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Adventurer~ Aren't isn't it cold now?
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
冒險者~你不覺得現在很冷嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well. Not really...

[Cyan]
Oh, this jacket looks good. That's why you don't feel cold. We always receive cheap clothes so we can easily fell the cold.
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
哦，你這件外套真不錯，難怪不覺得冷。我們總是領到便宜衣服，很容易感到寒冷。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
The adventurer is busy now. What are you talking about?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
冒險者現在很忙。你在說什麼呢？

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Listen to me and look around here. This place is a cold building made of iron and stone.
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
聽我說，再看看周圍。這裡是座用鐵和石頭建成的冰冷建築。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
And since we are in a place located nearly underground, it's always cold and damp. You know the feeling? The cold and damp air kills us.
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
而且這裡靠近地下，總是又冷又潮溼。你知道那種感覺嗎？這種溼冷的空氣簡直能要人命。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
That's why we always make a fire in the fireplace to warm the air, boil the tea and bake some sweet potatoes...
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
所以我們總在壁爐裡生火，暖屋子、燒水泡茶，還烤紅薯...

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
In any case, that fireplace is a blessing that grants us so many things. But the fire is about to go out due to the lack of firewood.
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
總之，壁爐給我們帶來許多便利。可柴火不夠，火快熄了。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Since it's too cold, I can't go out. So would you please bring me some firewood, my dear?
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
外面太冷了，我出不去。親愛的，能幫我帶些柴火嗎？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Hey! You're being rude to the adventurer! Just distinguish the reality and fantasy!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
喂！別對冒險者這麼無禮！分清現實和幻想！

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Well, I distinguish them too well. Rather than living in this cold stony room, I would like to jump into the river!
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
我分得可清楚了。與其住在這冰冷的石屋裡，我還不如跳進河裡！

scripts.text: Do you need the fuel?
scripts.translation: 你需要燃料嗎？

scripts.text: I have to leave now.
scripts.translation: 我現在得走了

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Can I leave now?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我現在可以走了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
My dear, are you leaving me? I'm suffering from the cold weather!
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
親愛的，你要丟下我嗎？我都快被凍壞了！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Adventurer, don't worry about Cyon. I will take care of this fellow.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
冒險者，別擔心賽安。我會照看好她。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
My dear, come back if you miss me!
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
親愛的，想我了就回來哦！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. I will.

[{0}]
I see! I got it! So you won't commit a suicide if I bring the fuel?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我明白了！所以只要我帶來燃料，你就不會尋死了，對嗎？

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Oh dear, you are so kind and lovely.
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
哎呀，你真是又善良又可愛。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
You've dont it again. I've gotta hand it to you.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
你又來這套了。真拿你沒辦法。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
I need some Burnt Trees, about 10 of them. Since they are well-dried, they will be burnt well. And there's better coal to keep the fire long. Bring some coal please, three of them.
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
我需要大約10根焦木。它們曬得很乾，燒起來正合適。還要些煤，讓火燒得更久。請帶3塊煤來。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Coal? Why? It leaves too much ash.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
煤？為什麼？那會留下很多灰。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
To me, the efficiency is the most important! The warmest is the best!
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
對我來說，效率最重要！越暖和越好！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I see. Please stop fighting. I will bring them. 10 Burnt Tree and three coal. Right?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
知道了，別吵了。我會帶來的：10根焦木和3塊煤，對嗎？

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Oops! And defeat 10 Waste Stoves!
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
哎呀！還要打倒10只廢鐵暖爐！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Why?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
為什麼？

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
You need to defeat them to get coal!
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
因為要打倒它們才能拿到煤！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Come on. The adventurer knows it already.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
拜託，冒險者早就知道了。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Be careful, my dear~
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
小心哦，親愛的~

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Phew... We will count on you anyway. Regardless of what that fellow told you, everyone will get a cold once the fire goes out.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
唉...總之就拜託你了。不管她怎麼說，火一滅，大家都會著涼。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Adventurer, seems like you gave so much effort!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
冒險者，看來你費了不少勁！

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Welcome back, dear!!! Have you got them all for me? Right?
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
親愛的，歡迎回來！！！東西都帶齊了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Oh, it's not there. And it's not enough... Perhaps you forgot what we told you to bring?
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
哦，還沒齊...數量也不夠...你是不是忘了我們讓你帶什麼？

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
10 Burnt Tree and three coal. I feel so cold. See you, dear.
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
10根焦木和3塊煤。我好冷啊。再見，親愛的。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
And don't forget to defeat about 10 Waste Stoves! I will be sleeping in by bed. It's so cold!
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
還有，別忘了打倒大約10只廢鐵暖爐！我要回床上睡覺了，好冷！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
That's so spoiled. Adventurer, We will count on you again. If you don't bring them, Cyan will pester you all day long.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
真是被寵壞了。冒險者，還得再拜託你一次。不把東西帶回來，賽安會纏著你一整天。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Oh, you have the firewood... What about Waste Stoves? You didn't defeat them?
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
哦，你帶來柴火了...那廢鐵暖爐呢？沒打倒它們嗎？

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
You must get them, dear. Waste Stoves release the fine firewood only after they are shaken about 1,000 times.
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
乖，得去打倒它們。廢鐵暖爐被搖上大約一千次後，才會掉落上好的柴火。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Defeat ^0000cd10 Waste Stoves^000000. I will be sleeping in by bed. It's so cold!
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
打倒^0000cd10只廢鐵暖爐^000000。我要回床上睡覺了，好冷！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
That's so spoiled. Adventurer, We will count on you again. If you don't bring them, Cyan will pester you all day long.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
真是被寵壞了。冒險者，還得再拜託你一次。不把東西帶回來，賽安會纏著你一整天。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Wow! You've brought all of them! My dear, you are so reliable!
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
哇~~~都帶齊了！親愛的，你真可靠！

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Okay. Put the wood and coal in... Fire!!!!!!!!
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
好，把木頭和煤放進去...點火！！！！！！

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Oh, it's warm now. As warm as your love~
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
哦，暖和起來了。就像你的愛一樣溫暖~

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Could you please stop saying 'dear'? You are repeating my joke too much.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
能不能別總叫“親愛的”？你把我的玩笑重複太多次了。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Hey! You started!
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
嘿，是你先開始的！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
It was a joke. Joke! Joke! Joke!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我那是在開玩笑。玩笑！玩笑！玩笑！

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Anyway, I like the adventurer! I won't let the adventurer go! Never!
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
不管怎樣，我喜歡這位冒險者！我不會讓你走的！絕不！

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
So my dear, will you come back tomorrow?
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
親愛的，明天還會回來嗎？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Not again!!!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
又來了！！！

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
These are only enough for today. Of course we must make a fire every single day!
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
這些燃料只夠今天用。當然，我們每天都得生火！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, I see. Stop fighting. I will come back tomorrow if I remember.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦，我知道了。別吵了。如果我記得的話，明天會再來的。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
My dear, you are so kind! But I may not be here tomorrow for a mission. Please don't be disappointed!
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
親愛的，你真好！不過我明天可能要出任務，不一定在這裡。別失望哦！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
I don't think the adventurer will ever be disappointed.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我想冒險者才不會失望。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Now I will go in and sleep. See you!
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
那我進去睡覺了。再見！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Phew, I am exhausted as well. Please take a good rest now and come back after the ^0000cddawn^000000.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
唉，我也累壞了。好好休息，明天^0000cd天亮^000000之後再回來。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Welcome, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
歡迎，冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Although you didn't have to come here, you took the trouble. I mean... Thanks.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
歡迎，冒險者。雖然你其實不用特地過來，但還是謝謝你跑這一趟。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
... You told me I had to come here, didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...不是你叫我必須來的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Twinkle twinkle little star~ My shooting star, you are still beautiful.
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
一閃一閃亮晶晶~我的流星，你依然如此美麗。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
It's to make those kids quiet.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
這是為了讓那些孩子安靜下來。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Are you fumbling it again! It might run down!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
你又在亂摸了嗎！小心把它弄壞！

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
It was you who told me to possess it all the time!
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
是你叫我一直帶著它的！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
I didn't mean to wash it every hour! You're so stubborn!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我可沒叫你每小時都洗一次！你真固執！

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
By the way, that's not important. I think there is something terribly wrong with my shooting star.
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
對了，那不重要。我覺得我的流星出了大問題。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
What? Flaw? Talk to the master there...
scripts.translation:
[新人]
什麼？有瑕疵？去問那邊的師父...

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
No. That's not the flaw I am talking about. Although its name is Shooting Star, it doesn't twinkle at all.
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
不是那種瑕疵。它雖然叫流星，卻一點也不閃。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
What kind of flaw is that? It doesn't matter how it looks! The performance more important!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
這算什麼瑕疵？外觀不重要，效能才重要！

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Oh, Lucky... Lucky, Lucky! Although you live in a place like this, your sense has to be youthful. That's the way you stay young. It's as important as being physically healthy.
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
哎呀，拉基...拉基，拉基！就算住在這種地方，也要保持年輕的心態。這樣才能永葆青春，這和身體健康一樣重要。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Why is it so important?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
為什麼那麼重要？

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Okay. Here's an item with a good performance and dull outward. And here's another one with a good performance and good outward. Which one would you choose?
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
好吧，這裡有一件效能好但外觀普通的東西，還有一件效能和外觀都很出色的東西。你會選哪一個？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
I like something dull.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我喜歡樸素的。

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Look at your taste... You really don't know the trend, do you?
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
看看你的品味...你完全不懂潮流，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Regardless of the trend, it's my constant taste.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
不管潮流怎麼變，我一直都喜歡樸素的東西。

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Yes, I see. I respect your taste. Then please respect my taste too.
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
嗯，我明白了。我尊重你的喜好，也請你尊重我的喜好。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
... Right.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
...好吧。

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Oh, what can I do? This part has to be thin... Right! I want to add some glitters to ammunitions.
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
唉，怎麼辦呢？這部分必須做得很薄...對了！我想在彈藥上加些閃光粉。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Why do you need them for ammunitions?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
彈藥上為什麼要加閃光粉？

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Since it's Shooting Star, it must twinkle! The Shooting Start that generates its last light by burning itself! The glitters will be spread... Just by imagining it, it's so beautiful.
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
既然叫流星，就應該閃閃發亮！像燃燒自己、綻放最後光芒的流星！閃光粉會四處飛散...光想想就覺得太美了。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
If you do that, you will get tracked.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
你那樣做會暴露行蹤的。

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
It's okay. I can publicize myself through the entire Continent. Let me grinder something hard and put it...
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
沒關係，正好能讓我揚名整個大陸。讓我先把堅硬的東西磨碎，再加進去...

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Well. Do as you wish. If you like converting so much, why don't you become an assistant of the master there?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
好吧，隨你。既然這麼喜歡改造，怎麼不去給那邊的師父當助手？

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
I prefer being on active duty. By the way... How do I get them?
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
我更喜歡待在一線工作。對了...要怎麼弄到那些材料？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
What are you talking about? You have to go out and get them yourself.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
你在說什麼？當然得自己出去找。

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
No. I have these many stuffs to look after. Besides, I don't have enough time. Oh, adventurer! Wait please! Talk to me for a minute!
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
不行，我有這麼多東西要照看，根本沒時間。哦，冒險者！等等！請聽我說幾句！

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Yes! Yes! I really need your help now! I'm glad you are here so that I can ask you for a favor.
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
對！我現在真的很需要你的幫助！正好你在這裡，我可以拜託你了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
May I ask you what it is...?

[Magenta]
Do you have any hard and glittering stone?
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
你有堅硬又閃亮的石頭嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I don't have any.

[Magenta]
So it was a false rumor that adventurers bring about 30,000 gems in their bags.
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
原來“冒險者包裡都帶著三萬顆寶石”只是個謠言啊。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I don't know where you heard that rumor from.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我不知道你是從哪裡聽來這種傳聞的。

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
My friend told me. Hmm.. What can I do? Can I ask you for a favor, adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
是我朋友告訴我的。嗯...怎麼辦才好？冒險者，能幫我個忙嗎？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Oh, you shouldn't be asking such a thing. The adventurer is our guest.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
哎呀，不該這樣拜託客人的。

scripts.text: What is it?
scripts.translation: 什麼事？

scripts.text: I'm quite busy...
scripts.translation: 我現在很忙...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm quite busy...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我現在有點忙...

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
The adventure is busy! You shouldn't be asking such a thing!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
冒險者正忙著呢！你不該這麼麻煩人家！

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
I see... Please come back if you remember it later on. I will be waiting for you. Bye... then.
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
我知道了...以後想起來的話，請再來找我。我會等你的。那...再見。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
See you later. Be careful.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
回頭見。路上小心。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That's all right. What would you like to request?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
沒關係。你想拜託我什麼？

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
So it's true that adventurers are kind!
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
果然冒險者都很善良！

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
I need some glittering stuffs to decorate my Shooting Star. Let me see... I need pieces of crystal and black crystal that twinkle transparently.
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
我想找些閃閃發光的東西裝飾我的流星。讓我看看...需要透明閃亮的水晶和黑色水晶碎片。

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
I wish I can go by myself and pick up good crystals one by one. But since I have to look after these stuffs, I cannot. I need so much time to clean and assemble them... Phew...
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
要是能親自去挑選水晶就好了。可我得照看這些東西，根本走不開。清理和組裝就要花很多時間...唉...

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Of course I will compensate you for your support. Please help me.
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
當然會答謝你的幫忙。請幫幫我。

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Please bring ^0000cd 10 pieces of crystal and 10 pieces of black crystal^000000. You can get them by defeating ^0000cdObsidians and Minerals^000000. Be careful!
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
請帶^0000cd10塊水晶和10塊黑色水晶^000000。擊敗^0000cd黑曜石和礦石魔^000000就能得到。小心！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Phew. He's so loud. I will count on you, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
唉，他真吵。冒險者，就拜託你了。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Welcome back, adventurer. I know you are suffering from the weird guy.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
歡迎回來，冒險者。我知道那個怪人讓你很頭疼。

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
You've come! Have you brought everything I asked for? Let me see!
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
你來了！我拜託的東西都帶來了嗎？讓我看看！

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Ah!!!! Not enough quantity!!! Adventurer, I thank you for helping us. But this is not enough!
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
啊！！！數量不夠！！！冒險者，謝謝你幫忙，但這些還不夠！

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
We need ^0000cd10 pieces of crystal and 10 pieces of black crystal^000000. Please don't forget it this time!
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
我們需要^0000cd10塊水晶和10塊黑色水晶^000000。這次可別忘了！

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
You can get them from ^0000cdObsidians and Mineral^000000. So defeat them. I have to go now. See you!
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
擊敗^0000cd黑曜石和礦石魔^000000就能得到。快去打倒它們吧。我先走了，再見！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Phew, so complicated. We will count on you. That fellow is so persistent.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
唉，真複雜。就拜託你了，那傢伙可真執著。

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Well, well.... You've brought the pieces of crystal... But you didn't defeat enough Obsidians and Minerals.
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
哎呀...你帶來了水晶碎片...不過黑曜石和礦石魔還沒打夠。

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
We need a special vibration generated when Obsidians and Minerals die. That vibration enables the crystal to get broken into smaller pieces...
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
我們需要黑曜石和礦石魔死時產生的特殊震動。那種震動能讓水晶碎成更小的碎片...

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Sorry to request you again, adventurer. Please defeat ^0000cd10 Obsidians and 10 Minerals^000000. I will count on you.
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
冒險者，抱歉又要麻煩你。請擊敗^0000cd10只黑曜石和10只礦石魔^000000。拜託了。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Phew, so complicated. We will count on you. That fellow is so persistent.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
唉，真複雜。就拜託你了，那傢伙可真執著。

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Oh, you brought them all!
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
哦，你全都帶來了！

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
So it is true that adventurers are so talented. I was a bit worried when I was requesting.
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
看來冒險者確實很能幹。剛才拜託你的時候，我還有點擔心呢。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Where did you pick up that story?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
你從哪兒聽來的這種說法？

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Pick up that story? Are you saying the adventurer is not talented? After seeing with your eyes?
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
聽來的？你是說冒險者沒本事嗎？你明明親眼看到了呀？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
No, I mean...
scripts.translation:
[新人]
不，我是說...

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Sorry. Lucky has so many things to do... I apologize on behalf of him.
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
抱歉，拉基有很多事情要忙...我替他向你道歉。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No. It's okay.

[Magenta]
By the way, it's so beautiful, What a brilliant light... I would like to start working now.
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
對了，這光真美，真耀眼...我現在就想開始做了。

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Oh, come to think of it... Adventurer! Can you bring them tomorrow? They are so beautiful and I would like to try everything.
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
哦，對了...冒險者！明天能再帶一些來嗎？它們太漂亮了，我想把各種做法都試一遍。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
The adventurer is busy.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
冒險者很忙。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I will come back if I remember it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
如果我記得的話，會再來的。

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
I'm so glad!!! But I might be outside for a mission. In that case, don't panic and come back next time.
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
太好了！！！不過我明天可能會出任務。如果不在這裡，彆著急，下次再來。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I will.

[Magenta]
Thank you so much! I should start working. Be careful!
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
太感謝你了！我得開始工作了。小心點！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
That fellow is really loud, isn't he? I apologize on behalf of him. Please take a good rest and come back ^0000cdafter the dawn^000000.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
那傢伙真吵啊？我替他向你道歉。好好休息，^0000cd黎明之後^000000再回來。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Welcome, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
歡迎，冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Although you didn't have to come here, you took the trouble. I mean... Thanks.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
你其實不用特地過來...我是說，謝謝你。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...You told me I had to come here, didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...不是你叫我必須來的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Here come Denny again, the superstar!!!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
超級巨星丹尼又登場啦！！！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Can't you please skip that performance?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
能不能省掉這段表演？

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Adventurer, did you rest well? I rested well after completing the repair. I know you are not curious about it, but I'm telling you before you ask me.
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
冒險者，休息得好嗎？我修好之後休息得很好。雖然你可能不感興趣，但我還是先說了，免得你問我。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
But there's still some water leakage in the pipe. Once I repair one of them, there's another water leakage in another pipe.. I wish we could replace them with brand new pipes.
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
不過管道還有些地方在漏水。我剛修好一處，另一處又開始漏...真希望能換成全新的管道。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
That's why need Steel and Old Steel Plate.
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
所以我們需要鋼和舊鋼板。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Please defeat the ^0000cdScrap Heater^000000 and bring ^0000cdfive Steel and 15 Old Steel Plate^000000!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
請擊敗^0000cd廢鐵暖爐^000000，並帶回^0000cd5塊鋼和15塊舊鋼板^000000！

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Cheer up!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
加油！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Ouch, I'm so busy. Sorry to request you again. Go, adventurer!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
哎呀，我忙得不可開交。抱歉又要麻煩你了。去吧，冒險者！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Welcome back, adventurer. Thank you for your support. Our silly kid gave you some trouble.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
歡迎回來，冒險者。謝謝你幫忙。我們那個傻小子沒少給你添麻煩吧。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
The adventurer is here?
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
冒險者來了？

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Here come Denny again, the superstar!!!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
超級巨星丹尼又登場啦！！！

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Adventurer! Have you brought them all? Let me see.
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
冒險者！東西都帶來了嗎？讓我看看。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Well... As I told you, please bring ^0000cdfive Steel and 15 Old Steel Plate^000000. We need them to repair the pipe.
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
嗯...正如我說的，請帶^0000cd5塊鋼和15塊舊鋼板^000000來修管道。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Adventurer, you know how to take shortcuts. I like it.
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
冒險者，你真會走捷徑。我喜歡。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
But I really need them. So please bring them to me. Will you?
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
不過我真的需要這些。請帶給我，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Superstar Denny is going home now!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
超級巨星丹尼要回家啦！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
What a spoiled kid. I apologize on behalf of him. We will count on you for the rest items.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
真是個被寵壞的小子。我替他向你道歉，剩下的東西就拜託你了。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
You have brought the Steel and Old Steel Plates...
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
你帶來了鋼和舊鋼板...

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Apparently, you did not defeat ^0000cd10 Waste Stoves^000000. I cannot smell the iron.
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
看來你沒有打倒^0000cd10個廢爐^000000。我沒聞到鐵的味道。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Although it is my private request, I wish you could do it for me.
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
雖然這是我個人的請求，但還是希望你能幫我做到。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Superstar Denny is going home now!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
超級巨星丹尼要回家啦！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
What a spoiled kid. I apologize on behalf of him. We will count on you for the rest items.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
真是個被寵壞的小子。我替他向你道歉，剩下的東西就拜託你了。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Wow~~~ Great! You never disappoint me!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
哇~~~太棒了！你從沒讓我失望過！

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Let me spread your legendary story around the entire continent! Everyone needs to know that!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
我要把你的傳奇故事傳遍整個大陸！大家都該知道！

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Then I will go and prepare for repairing! I will count on you again!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
那我去準備修理了！之後還得拜託你！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
He went back only after saying what he wants. How spoiled! But I didn't educate him like that.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
他只顧著說自己想說的話，說完就回去了。真被寵壞了！我可沒把他教成這樣。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Please take a good rest today. We will count on you again tomorrow. You must be exhausted.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
今天好好休息吧。明天還要拜託你呢，你一定累壞了。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Welcome, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
歡迎，冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Although you didn't have to come here, you took the trouble. I mean... Thanks.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
你其實不用特地過來...我是說，謝謝你。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...You told me I had to come here, didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...不是你叫我必須來的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Yikes, it's so cold!
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
哎呀，好冷！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
I have to listen to complaints of all the people. That's a problem.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我得聽所有人的抱怨，真夠頭疼的。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
What's so cold? It's the same as yesterday
scripts.translation:
[新人]
哪裡冷了？跟昨天一樣啊。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Hey, my feeling is so accurate. It's colder today. Look. You put on more clothes.
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
嘿，我的感覺可準了，今天更冷。你看，你都多穿了幾件。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Oh! When did I get dressed like this!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
哦！我什麼時候穿成這樣的！

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Let's see... I thought so. The fireplace is weaker now. No firewood?
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
讓我看看...果然如此。壁爐的火弱下來了。沒柴火了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Well, it's true.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
嗯，好像是。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Once this last firewood is burnt out, I will die... Last... firewood...
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
最後一根柴燒完，我就要死了...最後一根柴...

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Who told you that you'd die? You're so healthy!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
誰說你要死了？你身體不是好好的嗎！

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Come on, Just echo my words while I'm sentimental!!
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
拜託！我煽情的時候，你就不能配合我一下嗎！！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Oh, don't die. If you die, who's going to take care of those 12 kids. Please don't die.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
哦，別死啊。你死了，誰來照顧那12個孩子？求你別死。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Hey! Who are my kids! And why do I have to feed them? What happened?
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
嘿！誰是我的孩子？為什麼要我養他們？到底怎麼回事？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Your spouse... died during a mission.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
你的伴侶...在任務中犧牲了。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
My god! So who's my spouse?
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
天哪！那我的伴侶是誰？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Well... The Teddy bear?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
嗯...泰迪熊？

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Oops! No! Let's say this adventurer is my spouse.
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
哎呀，不是！就說這位冒險者是我的伴侶吧。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Hey! That's rude!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
喂！這太沒禮貌了！

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Adventurer~ Aren't isn't it cold now?
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
冒險者~你不覺得現在很冷嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well. Not really...

[Cyan]
Oh, this jacket looks good. That's why you don't feel cold. We always receive cheap clothes so we can easily fell the cold.
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
哦，你這件外套真不錯，難怪不覺得冷。我們總是領到便宜衣服，一下子就能感受到寒氣。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
The adventurer is busy now. What are you talking about?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
冒險者現在很忙。你在說什麼呢？

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Listen to me and look around here. This place is a cold building made of iron and stone.
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
聽我說，再看看周圍。這裡是座用鐵和石頭建成的冰冷建築。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
And since we are in a place located nearly underground, it's always cold and damp. You know the feeling? The cold and damp air kills us.
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
而且這裡靠近地下，總是又冷又潮溼。你知道那是什麼感覺嗎？這種溼冷的空氣簡直能要人命。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
That's why we always make a fire in the fireplace to warm the air, boil the tea and bake some sweet potatoes...
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
所以我們總得在壁爐裡生火，暖暖屋子、燒水泡茶，再烤些紅薯...

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
In any case, that fireplace is a blessing that grants us so many things. But the fire is about to go out due to the lack of firewood.
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
總之，壁爐給我們帶來了許多溫暖，真是個寶貝。可是柴火不夠，火眼看就要熄了。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Since it's too cold, I can't go out. So would you please bring me some firewood, my dear?
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
外面太冷了，我出不去。親愛的，能幫我帶些柴火來嗎？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Hey! You're being rude to the adventurer! Just distinguish the reality and fantasy!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
喂！別對冒險者這麼無禮！分清現實和幻想！

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Well, I distinguish them too well. Rather than living in this cold stony room, I would like to jump into the river!
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
哼，我分得可清楚了。與其住在這冰冷的石屋裡，我還不如跳進河裡！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I see! I got it! So you won't commit a suicide if I bring the fuel?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我明白了！所以只要我帶來燃料，你就不會尋死了，對嗎？

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Oh dear, you are so kind and lovely.
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
哎呀，你真是又善良又可愛。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
You've dont it again. I've gotta hand it to you.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
你又來這套了。真拿你沒辦法。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
I need some Burnt Tree. About 10 of them. Since they are well-dried, they will be burnt well. And there's better than coal to keep the fire long. Bring some coal please. Three of them.
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
我需要大約10根焦木。它們曬得很乾，燒起來正合適。還需要煤，讓火燒得更久。請帶3塊煤來。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Coal? Why? It leaves too much ash.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
煤？為什麼？那會留下很多灰。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
To me, the efficiency is the most important! The warmest is the best!
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
對我來說，效率最重要！越暖和越好！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I see. Please stop fighting. I will bring them. ^0000cd10 Burnt Tree and three coal^000000. Right?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
明白了，別吵了。我會帶^0000cd10根焦木和3塊煤^000000來，對嗎？

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Oops! And defeat ^0000cd10 Waste Stoves^000000!
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
哎呀！還要擊敗^0000cd10個廢爐^000000！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Why?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
為什麼？

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
You need to defeat them to get coal!
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
你得擊敗它們才能拿到煤！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Come on. The adventurer knows it already.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
拜託了，冒險者肯定知道的。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Be careful, my dear~
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
小心點，親愛的~

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Phew... We will count on you anyway. Regardless of what that fellow told you, everyone will get a cold once the fire goes out.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
唉...總之就拜託你了。不管那傢伙怎麼說，火一滅，大家都會著涼。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Welcome back, adventurer. Thank you for your support. Our silly kid gave you some trouble.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
歡迎回來，冒險者。感謝你幫忙。我們那個調皮的小子沒少給你添麻煩吧。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
What? Adventurer? My dear?
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
什麼？冒險者？親愛的？

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
My dear~~~ You're late! I've been waiting for you for a long time! Have you brought the right one again? I mean, the firewood.
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
親愛的~~~你遲到了！我等你好久了！這次又帶對東西了嗎？我是說，柴火。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Oh, it's not there. And it's not enough... Perhaps you forgot what we told you to bring?
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
哦，沒帶齊...數量也不夠...你是不是忘了我們讓你帶什麼？

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
10 Burnt Tree and three coal. I feel so cold. See you, dear.
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
10根焦木和3塊煤。我好冷啊。再見，親愛的。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
And don't forget to defeat about 10 Waste Stoves! I will be sleeping in by bed. It's so cold!
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
還有別忘了打倒大約10個廢爐！我要回床上睡覺了，好冷！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Sorry. Some of our kids are spoiled... We will count on you.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
抱歉，我們有些孩子被寵壞了...就拜託你了。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Oh, you have the firewood... What about Waste Stoves? You didn't defeat them?
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
哦，你帶來柴火了...那廢爐呢？沒打倒它們嗎？

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
You must get them, dear. Waste Stoves release the fine firewood only after they are shaken about 1,000 times.
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
親愛的，必須把它們打倒。廢爐被搖晃大約一千次後，才會掉落上好的柴火。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Defeat ^0000cd10 Waste Stoves^000000. I will be sleeping in by bed. It's so cold!
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
打倒^0000cd10個廢爐^000000。我要回床上睡覺了，好冷！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Sorry. Some of our kids are spoiled... We will count on you.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
抱歉，我們有些孩子被寵壞了...就拜託你了。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Burnt Tree and coal, you have everything! That's why I like you, dear!
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
焦木和煤都帶齊了！親愛的，這就是我喜歡你的原因！

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Okay. Put the wood and coal in... Fire!!!!!!!!
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
好了，把木頭和煤放進去...點火！！！！！！

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Oh, it's warm now. As warm as your love~
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
哦，暖和起來了，就像你的愛一樣溫暖~

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Thank you so much! I will count you again later on! MY DEAR!
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
太感謝你了！親愛的，以後還要再拜託你！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
There he leaves again without saying goodbye to you. Sorry about him. Some of our kids are spoiled. But not every Rebellion is like that.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
他又沒跟你道別就走了。抱歉，他就是這樣。我們有些孩子被寵壞了，但不是每個反叛者都這樣。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Please take a good rest today. We will count on you again tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
今天好好休息吧。明天還要再麻煩你。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Welcome, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
歡迎，冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Although you didn't have to come here, you took the trouble. I mean... Thanks.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
你其實不用特地過來...我是說，謝謝你。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...You told me I had to come here, didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...不是你叫我必須來的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Wait!!! Adventurer! Please talk to me!
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
等等！！！冒險者，請跟我說句話！

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
I would be so sad if you leave without seeing me. I thought of a perfect design last night.
