scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
你要是不見我就走，我會很難過的。昨晚我想到了一個完美的設計。

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
And I made various stuffs and now I ran out of crystals... Would you mind if I ask you to get them?
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
我做了好多東西，現在水晶用完了...你能幫我找一些嗎？

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Defeat ^0000cdObsidian and Mineral^000000. Then bring me ^0000cd10 pieces of crystal and 10 pieces of black crystal^000000 please.
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
請擊敗^0000cd黑曜石和礦石魔^000000，再帶來^0000cd10塊水晶和10塊黑色水晶^000000。

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Eee you later! I have to go and arrange the stuffs I made. I will count on you!
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
回頭見！我得去整理做好的東西了。就拜託你啦！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Ouch, Sorry to request you again. It must be tough for you now.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
哎呀，抱歉又要麻煩你。你現在一定很辛苦吧。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Welcome back, adventurer. Thank you for your support. That flake gave you some trouble.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
歡迎回來，冒險者。謝謝你幫忙。那個古怪的傢伙沒少給你添麻煩吧。

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
You've come! Have you brought everything I asked for? Let me see!
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
你來了！我拜託的東西都帶來了嗎？讓我看看！

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Ah!!!! Not enough quantity!!! Adventurer, I thank you for helping us. But this is not enough!
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
啊！！！數量不夠！！！冒險者，謝謝你幫忙，但這些還不夠！

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
We need ^0000cd10 pieces of crystal and 10 pieces of black crystal^000000. Please don't forget it this time!
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
我們需要^0000cd10塊水晶和10塊黑色水晶^000000。這次可別忘了！

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
You can get them from ^0000cdObsidians and Mineral^000000. So defeat them. I have to go now. See you!
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
擊敗^0000cd黑曜石和礦石魔^000000就能得到。快去打倒它們吧。我先走了，再見！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Sorry. Some of our kids are spoiled... We will count on you.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
抱歉，我們有些孩子被寵壞了...就拜託你了。

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Well, well.... You've brought the pieces of crystal... But you didn't defeat enough Obsidians and Minerals.
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
哎呀...你帶來了水晶碎片...不過黑曜石和礦石魔還沒打夠。

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
We need a special vibration generated when Obsidians and Minerals die. That vibration enables the crystal to get broken into smaller pieces...
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
我們需要黑曜石和礦石魔死時產生的特殊震動。那種震動能讓水晶碎成更小的碎片...

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Sorry to request you again, adventurer. Please defeat ^0000cd10 Obsidians and 10 Minerals^000000. I will count on you.
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
冒險者，抱歉又要麻煩你。請擊敗^0000cd10只黑曜石和10只礦石魔^000000。拜託了。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Sorry. Some of our kids are spoiled... We will count on you.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
抱歉，我們有些孩子被寵壞了...就拜託你了。

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
You brought them all again!!! I'm beginning to respect you!
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
你又全都帶來了！！！我開始佩服你了！

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Thank you so much! Can I ask you for a favor again next time? This is great!!!
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
太感謝你了！下次還能再請你幫忙嗎？太好了！！！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
There he leaves again without saying goodbye to you. Sorry about him. Some of our kids are spoiled. But not every Rebellion is like that.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
他又沒跟你道別就走了。抱歉，他就是這樣。我們有些孩子被寵壞了，但不是每個反叛者都這樣。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Please take a good rest today. We will count on you again tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
今天好好休息吧。明天還要再麻煩你。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Let me take him out!
Seems like there are still some researchers hiding like this.
Please do us another little favor!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
讓我把他帶出來！
看來還有研究員躲在這種地方。
再幫我們一個小忙吧！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Let me take him out!
Seems like there are still some researchers hiding like this.
^4d4dffYou can stop searching and take a rest!^000000
We will search for the rest of them.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
讓我把他帶出來！
看來還有研究員躲在這種地方。
^4d4dff你可以停止搜尋，先休息一下！^000000
剩下的人我們來找。

scripts.text: The boy with silver hairs looked at me. He frowned and turned his head.
scripts.translation: 那個銀髮男孩看了我一眼，皺起眉頭，把頭扭開了。

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
......
scripts.translation:
[伊利亞·列別捷夫]
...

scripts.text:
Although you talk to him, he would not listen at all.
Seems like it's easier to talk to the girl.
scripts.translation:
你跟他說話，他也完全不理會。
看來和那個女孩說話會容易些。

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
.........
scripts.translation:
[伊利亞·列別捷夫]
...

[伊利亞·列別捷夫]
...

[伊利亞·列別捷夫]
...

scripts.text:
He held his lips tight and looking at me.
Seems like it's easier to talk to the girl.
scripts.translation:
他緊抿著嘴唇看著我。
看來和那個女孩說話會容易些。

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
......Don't talk to Jana.
scripts.translation:
[伊利亞·列別捷夫]
...別和雅娜說話。

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
......
scripts.translation:
[伊利亞·列別捷夫]
...

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
Don't talk to me either.
scripts.translation:
[伊利亞·列別捷夫]
也別跟我說話。

scripts.text:
He held his lips tight with a stubborn face..
Seems like it's easier to talk to the girl.
scripts.translation:
他緊緊抿著嘴唇，一臉倔強...
看來和那個女孩說話會容易些。

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
Jana... You're cute even when you're breathing...
scripts.translation:
[伊利亞·列別捷夫]
雅娜...連呼吸的樣子都好可愛...

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
...?!!!
Why did you overhear me?
scripts.translation:
[伊利亞·列別捷夫]
...？！！
你怎麼偷聽到了？

scripts.text:
He is furious. But he's the one who said that loud...
Seems like it's easier to talk to the girl.
scripts.translation:
他氣得不行，可明明是他自己說得那麼大聲...
看來還是和那個女孩說話比較容易。

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
Adventurer, could you please ask Jana?
scripts.translation:
[伊利亞·列別捷夫]
冒險者，能幫我問問雅娜嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
I mean.... how much she likes her older brother...
scripts.translation:
[伊利亞·列別捷夫]
我是說...她有多喜歡她哥哥...

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
Ilya, I heard that.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
伊利亞，我聽見了。

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
Gosh! No, no... I was just...!!
scripts.translation:
[伊利亞·列別捷夫]
天哪！不，不是...我只是...！！

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
I made cookies together with Jana. Yesterday, we read a book together. Tomorrow we will explore the dead mine...
scripts.translation:
[伊利亞·列別捷夫]
我和雅娜一起做了餅乾。昨天我們一起讀書，明天還要一起去探索廢棄礦坑...

scripts.text: Ilya Lebedev is be excited and boasting about what happened.
scripts.translation: 伊利亞·列別捷夫興奮地炫耀著剛才發生的事。

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
I want to be called by my first name, Ilya...
scripts.translation:
[伊利亞·列別捷夫]
我想讓她叫我的名字，伊利亞...

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
I mean... by Jana. Not by you.
scripts.translation:
[伊利亞·列別捷夫]
我是說...讓雅娜這麼叫，不是你。

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
Sometimes I wish she calls me 'brother'...
scripts.translation:
[伊利亞·列別捷夫]
有時候我希望她叫我“哥哥”...

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
Jana calls you Older {0}. And why does she call me Ilya...?!
scripts.translation:
[伊利亞·列別捷夫]
雅娜叫你“{0}前輩”，為什麼只叫我伊利亞...？！

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
Shooting? I like it. But it's not the only reason I practice it.
scripts.translation:
[伊利亞·列別捷夫]
射擊？我喜歡。但這不是我練習射擊的唯一原因。

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
Because I have to support Jana. I will shoot anyone who puts a hand on Jana.
scripts.translation:
[伊利亞·列別捷夫]
因為我得保護雅娜。誰敢對雅娜動手，我就開槍打誰。

scripts.text: Ilya Lebedev looks quite excited.
scripts.translation: 伊利亞·列別捷夫看起來很興奮。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
I don't want to be treated as a child.
Do not stroke my head.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
別把我當小孩子。
不許摸我的頭。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
Ilya is the only one who can call me Jana.
Call me Lebedeva.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
只有伊利亞能叫我雅娜。
請叫我列別傑娃。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
......Who are you?
You don't look like Rebellion.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
...你是誰？
你看起來不像反叛者。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You are right. I'm an adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你說得對，我是冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
How did an adventurer come in here?
scripts.translation:
[伊利亞·列別捷夫]
冒險者怎麼會跑到這裡來？

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
Are you the adventurer who defeated our commander?
So you're the one from the Secret Wings, aren't you?
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
你就是打敗我們指揮官的冒險者？
你是秘密之翼的人，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
Huhu, the old guys here hate the Secret Wings, but we don't care.
Since we want to fight hard in a mission, we welcome your proposal.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
呵呵，這裡的老傢伙們討厭秘密之翼，不過我們不在乎。
我們也想在任務中大顯身手，很樂意聽聽你的提議。

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
Whatever Jana likes, I like it too.
scripts.translation:
[伊利亞·列別捷夫]
雅娜喜歡什麼，我也喜歡。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
Have you brought any story filled with gunpowder?
...Well, we cannot be involved in the mission anyway.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
你帶來什麼硝煙瀰漫的故事了嗎？
...不過我們反正也不能參加任務。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You are still young.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你們還太年輕了。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
...We'll become adults in the near future.
We are not that much younger compared to other people here. Does putting on several years make any difference?
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
...我們很快就會長大。
比起這裡的其他人，我們也沒小多少。年紀差幾歲真的有區別嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
They all know that we have better abilities than adults.
If it wasn't for one thing... No, never mind.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
大家都知道我們的能力比成年人強。
要不是因為一件事...算了，沒什麼。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
It's so annoying...
Ilya, tell the adventurer to go away.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
真煩...
伊利亞，叫冒險者離開。

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
Please leave.
We don't want to talk to you any more.
scripts.translation:
[伊利亞·列別捷夫]
請離開。
我們不想再和你說話了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(So they started to hate me pretty early... What should I do?
Maybe I have to listen to ^0000CDRebellions around them^000000.)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
（他們這麼早就開始討厭我了...怎麼辦？
也許我該聽聽他們周圍^0000CD反叛者^000000的說法。）

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
Ah, Ilya. That person keeps irritating me.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
伊利亞，那個人一直惹我生氣。

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
Please leave.
I won't forgive you if you distress Jana.
scripts.translation:
[伊利亞·列別捷夫]
請離開。
要是你再讓雅娜難過，我不會放過你。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
You're here again?
We don't want to talk.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
你又來了？
我們不想說話。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(Ask them about the incident that happened in the past...)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
（問問他們過去發生的那件事...）

scripts.text: Ask them directly.
scripts.translation: 直接問

scripts.text: Beat around the bush.
scripts.translation: 旁敲側擊

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Did you throw a grenade to the civilian zone during your actual mission?
Why did you do that?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你們執行任務時，真的向平民區投擲了手榴彈嗎？
為什麼這麼做？

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
What...!!
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
什麼...！！

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
Where did you hear this story!
Hey, why are you saying that?
scripts.translation:
[伊利亞·列別捷夫]
你從哪兒聽來的！
喂，你為什麼這麼說？

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
Get lost! Stay away from Jana!
scripts.translation:
[伊利亞·列別捷夫]
滾開！離雅娜遠點！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(......Looks like a huge mistake. Let's go back to ^0000CDElena Volkova^000000.)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
（...看來我犯了個大錯。還是回去找^0000CDElena Volkova^000000吧。）

scripts.text:
[{0}]
There's something I would like to ask you.
I asked others and they say you were...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我有件事想問你們。
我問過其他人，他們說你們...

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
...Why do you pry into our private affairs?
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
...為什麼要打聽我們的私事？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I didn't pry into anything. I mean, they told me you look very tired these days...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我沒有打聽什麼。我是說，別人告訴我你們最近看起來很疲憊...

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
We are tired because someone is irritating us.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
我們會累，是因為有人一直惹我們生氣。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(......This is getting difficult. Let's go back to ^0000CDElena Volkova^000000.)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
（...這越來越難辦了。還是回去找^0000CDElena Volkova^000000吧。）

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
We don't want to talk to you. Just leave.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
我們不想和你說話，快走。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(...I guess they really hate me now.)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
（...看來他們真的討厭我了。）

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
You're here again?
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
你又來了？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
( I did take the cookie... Where is it?
Let's go back to Ericsson and talk to him.)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
（我確實拿了餅乾...餅乾在哪兒？還是回去找埃裡克森談談吧。）

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello, guys?

[Jana Levedeva]
...Do you have so much free time? Why do you keep stalking us?
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
...你很閒嗎？為什麼一直跟著我們？

scripts.text: There's something I would like to tell you.
scripts.translation: 告訴你們一件事

scripts.text: Want some cookie?
scripts.translation: 給你們餅乾？

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
I don't want to hear it.
Unless you pay us 1 million Zeny for listening to your story, leave now.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
我不想聽。除非你付我們100萬zeny聽你講，否則快走。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
I don't know what you are up to. But we...
...Wait, where did you get this cookie?
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
我不知道你打什麼主意。不過我們...等等，你從哪兒弄來的餅乾？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Someone you know well told me to give this to you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
一個你們熟悉的人讓我把這個交給你們。

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
......Commander Adler?
scripts.translation:
[伊利亞·列別傑夫]
...阿德勒指揮官？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
And he also said this.
Trust me. And tell the adventurer if you have any problem.
This is my request. Could you please tell me?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他還讓我轉告你們：相信我，有什麼問題就告訴冒險者。這是我的請求。你們能告訴我嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
......What...
That.. is a lie. How can I trust an adventurer...?
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
...什麼...那是謊話。我怎麼能相信冒險者...？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
As I told you earlier, please think about commander Adler.
He's so worried about you. So am I, and so is commander Volkova.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
就像我剛才說的，請想想阿德勒指揮官。他很擔心你們，我和沃爾科娃指揮官也一樣。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
We...
No. We won't tell you.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
我們...不，不會告訴你的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Please tell me one thing.
I heard you didn't ruin yourself like this before.
Why do you keep hurting yourself?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
請告訴我一件事。我聽說你們以前不是這樣的，為什麼總是傷害自己？

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
Why do you say that? What do you know about us?
You know nothing!
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
你為什麼這麼說？你瞭解我們嗎？你什麼都不知道！

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
...I was so..
scared...... so...
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
...我當時好...害怕...所以...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Scared...?

[Jana Levedeva]
And then... I got out of shape...
So I was scared... I did so... on purpose... sniffle.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
後來...我就失去了狀態...所以我很害怕...我是故意那樣做的...（抽泣）

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
......
scripts.translation:
[伊利亞·列別傑夫]
...

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
I'm sure you know what happened during our first mission... not long ago.
After that. Jana had such a hard time.
scripts.translation:
[伊利亞·列別傑夫]
我想你知道不久前我們的第一次任務出了什麼事...從那以後，雅娜一直很難受。

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
Because Jana and I had been so confident that we would do well.
Then it happened... and we... were so miserable.
scripts.translation:
[伊利亞·列別傑夫]
雅娜和我原本很有信心，覺得能做好。結果出了那件事，我們都...很難過。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
Sniffle. We didn't throw the grenade on purpose and we didn't enjoy it either. It's out fault. But, but...
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
（抽泣）我們不是故意扔手榴彈的，也不覺得那很好玩。是我們的錯，可是...可是...

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
We were punished and moved to USU... Then we felt that everyone else regards us as horrible kids.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
我們受罰後被調去了USU...感覺大家都把我們當成壞孩子。

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
We wanted to talk to commander Ericsson. But we couldn't, because we were assigned to another unit.
scripts.translation:
[伊利亞·列別傑夫]
我們想找埃裡克森指揮官談談，可我們被分派到別的部隊，沒法見他。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
We had no idea what to do. We just wanted to run away. Because everyone was blaming us and disappointed at us...
But we liked our unit and commander Ericsson...
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
我們不知道該怎麼辦，只想逃走。大家都在責怪我們，對我們失望...可我們喜歡原來的部隊和埃裡克森指揮官...

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
We thought that we had already ruined everything.
As everyone was already disappointed at us, we thought we could do whetever...
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
我們以為一切都被我們搞砸了。既然大家都對我們失望，我們就覺得可以為所欲為...

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
As we acted at our pleasure, things got worse and worse... So we were sacred...
Then we began to believe that we were the worst and hopeless kids...
scripts.translation:

可憐的孩子。
到頭來，你竟是這樣回來的。

scripts.text:
[Benedict Windsor]
I was expecting this.
When I found his Pecopeco, I knew something was wrong.
scripts.translation:
[本尼迪克特·溫莎]
我早就料到了。
發現他的大嘴鳥時，我就知道出事了。

scripts.text:
[Benedict Windsor]
But as I didn't see it with my eyes,
I had a slight hope in my mind.
scripts.translation:
[本尼迪克特·溫莎]
但我沒有親眼看到，
心裡還留著一絲希望。

scripts.text:
[Benedict Windsor]
....
... Should I welcome you, to see you again like this?
scripts.translation:
[本尼迪克特·溫莎]
...再次以這樣的方式見到你，我該歡迎你嗎？

scripts.text:
[Benedict Windsor]
... Thanks.
...
scripts.translation:
[本尼迪克特·溫莎]
...謝謝。
...

scripts.text:
[Benedict Windsor]
... That rocket belongs to Cheiron.
When they told me they would take them to Geffen's Magic_tower ...
scripts.translation:
[本尼迪克特·溫莎]
...那枚火箭是凱龍的。
他們說要把它送去吉芬魔法塔時...

scripts.text:
[Benedict Windsor]
I thought they would take good care of them.
... Why should my children end up like this?
scripts.translation:
[本尼迪克特·溫莎]
我以為他們會好好保管。
...為什麼我的孩子會落得這樣的下場？

scripts.text:
[Benedict Windsor]
What should I do now?
My wife and children have passed away.
What can I do ...
scripts.translation:
[本尼迪克特·溫莎]
我現在該怎麼辦？
妻子和孩子都去世了。
我還能做什麼...

scripts.text:
[Benedict Windsor]
You ...
......
scripts.translation:
[本尼迪克特·溫莎]
你...
...

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
Shrines and convents have a very close relationship.
They come to help us like this frequently.
scripts.translation:
[瑪格麗特]
神龕和修道院關係密切。
他們經常像這樣來幫助我們。

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
What brings you here?
scripts.translation:
[瑪格麗特]
你來這裡有什麼事？

scripts.text: Hands Rosary.
scripts.translation: 把念珠交給她

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
I know this stuff.
This is the Rosary that she was holding tightly in her small hand when she first came to this convent.
scripts.translation:
[瑪格麗特]
我認得這個。
這是索林剛來到修道院時，緊緊握在小手裡的那串念珠。

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
I can faintly feel the spirit of that girl, Sorin.
She's grown up a lot.
scripts.translation:
[瑪格麗特]
我隱約感受到了那個女孩索林的靈魂。
她已經長大了許多。

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
She was a tomboy. But since she met Seyren, she often pretended to be modest.
scripts.translation:
[瑪格麗特]
她以前是個假小子。不過自從遇見塞倫後，就經常裝得很文靜。

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
Jooshin loved the girl a lot, and she was taken so early.
....
scripts.translation:
[瑪格麗特]
喬信很疼愛那個女孩，可她這麼早就離開了。
...

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
... Thank you very much for giving this to me.
May the blessing of Jooshin be with you forever.
scripts.translation:
[瑪格麗特]
...非常感謝你把這個交給我。
願喬信的祝福永遠與你同在。

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
I used to visit the Capitolina convent with Sorin quite often.
With her high-spirited personality, she got along quite well with the monks.
scripts.translation:
[瑪格麗特]
以前我常和索林一起去卡皮托利納修道院。
她性格開朗，和那裡的武僧們相處得很好。

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
She also came here to relax when she needed some rest ...
scripts.translation:
[瑪格麗特]
她需要休息時也會來這裡放鬆...

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
... even though the path is quite rough.
If you are going back now, do you want me to send you to Prontera?
scripts.translation:
[瑪格麗特]
...雖然路確實很難走。
你現在要回去嗎？要我送你去普隆德拉嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, please.
scripts.translation: 是的，麻煩你

scripts.text: No thank you.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
If you need it later, do not hesitate to tell me.
scripts.translation:
[瑪格麗特]
之後需要的話，儘管告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
... Bye.
scripts.translation:
[瑪格麗特]
...再見。

scripts.text:
[Cleaver]
You can smelt your gears over there.
I don't take requests for personal production or smelting.
scripts.translation:
[克利弗]
你可以去那邊熔煉裝備。
我不接私人制作或熔煉的委託。

scripts.text:
[Cleaver]
Who's there? A shopper?
I don't accept personal production requests.
scripts.translation:
[克利弗]
誰在那兒？是來買東西的嗎？
我不接私人定製委託。

scripts.text:
[Cleaver]
Wait, can I see that Thimble Of Archer?
This decoration is ...
scripts.translation:
[克利弗]
等等，能讓我看看那個“弓箭手的手套”嗎？
這個裝飾是...

scripts.text:
[Cleaver]
Hey! What happened to Alt?
He made this decoration for the Thimble Of Archer when he visited here for the last time.
scripts.translation:
[克利弗]
嘿！阿爾特怎麼了？
他上次來這裡時，親手給“弓箭手的手套”做了這個裝飾。

scripts.text:
[Cleaver]
A jewel decoration on a Thimble Of Archer! I know it sounds crazy. But it took him several days ? he didn't even sleep!
scripts.translation:
[克利弗]
在“弓箭手的手套”上鑲寶石？聽起來確實瘋狂。他為此忙了好幾天，甚至連覺都沒睡！

scripts.text:
[Cleaver]
Since he was having a hard time making it, I was willing to help him. But he still made this Thimble Of Archer alone ...
scripts.translation:
[克利弗]
看他做得那麼辛苦，我本想幫忙。但他還是堅持獨自完成了這隻手套...

scripts.text:
[Cleaver]
Why do you have this?
scripts.translation:
[克利弗]
你為什麼帶著這個？

scripts.text: It's a relic.
scripts.translation: 這是一件遺物

scripts.text:
[Cleaver]
... What?
No ... Wait ... Wait a minute
I heard some rumors. I did ...
scripts.translation:
[克利弗]
...什麼？
不...等等...等一下。
我確實聽到過一些傳聞...

scripts.text:
[Cleaver]
But I still believed that no news is good news ...
In this way, all of a sudden ...
scripts.translation:
[克利弗]
但我一直以為沒有訊息就是好訊息...
沒想到突然就...

scripts.text:
[Cleaver]
... What ... What a fool.
Why did he make a gift that he cannot even deliver?
scripts.translation:
[克利弗]
...真是...傻瓜。
他為什麼要做一份根本送不出去的禮物？

scripts.text:
[Cleaver]
... Haa ...
Eventually, this is how it ends ...
scripts.translation:
[克利弗]
...唉...
結果還是變成這樣...

scripts.text:
[Cleaver]
Thank you ... for coming all the way here.
I have to delay my work for a while.
....
scripts.translation:
[克利弗]
謝謝你...特地跑這一趟。
我得暫時停下手裡的工作。
...

scripts.text:
[Cleaver]
Alt has an older brother.
... I will give this to him.
Since he is in a critical moment now, I will look for a chance to give it to him.
scripts.translation:
[克利弗]
阿爾特還有個哥哥。
...我會把這個交給他。
他現在正處在關鍵時期，我會找機會交給他。

scripts.text:
[Cleaver]
... Damn.
I cannot resume my work.
scripts.translation:
[克利弗]
...該死。
我沒法繼續工作了。

scripts.text:
[Guile Marovitz]
... If you want to become an Assassin, go east of the desert.
scripts.translation:
[蓋爾·馬羅維茨]
...想成為刺客的話，就去沙漠以東。

scripts.text:
[Guile Marovitz]
It's quite unusual.
What brought you here?
scripts.translation:
[蓋爾·馬羅維茨]
真少見。
你來這裡有什麼事？

scripts.text:
[Guile Marovitz]
This dagger is ...
Right. Eremes ...
has finally returned.
scripts.translation:
[蓋爾·馬羅維茨]
這把短劍是...
沒錯，艾雷姆斯...
終於回來了。

scripts.text:
[Guile Marovitz]
It's been a long time since I dispatched him ... He returned too late.
scripts.translation:
[蓋爾·馬羅維茨]
我派他出去已經很久了...可他回來得太晚了。

scripts.text:
[Guile Marovitz]
Is this mission failure or success?
... He is the type of guy who hates to have a mission fail.
scripts.translation:
[蓋爾·馬羅維茨]
這次任務到底是成功還是失敗？
...他最討厭任務失敗了。

scripts.text:
[Guile Marovitz]
I like guys who are serious about completing their missions. But in this case ... I wish he had just abandoned his mission and taken a vacation.
scripts.translation:
[蓋爾·馬羅維茨]
我喜歡認真完成任務的人。但這次...我倒希望他乾脆放棄任務，出去度個假。

scripts.text:
[Guile Marovitz]
I will take him ... well.
Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[蓋爾·馬羅維茨]
我會照顧好他...嗯。
謝謝你。

scripts.text:
[Guile Marovitz]
In this field, it is quite common to not have your companion come back after a mission.
scripts.translation:
[蓋爾·馬羅維茨]
幹我們這行的，同伴執行任務後沒能回來是常有的事。

scripts.text:
[Guile Marovitz]
Some lucky guys come back like this.
And he was quite lucky.
scripts.translation:
[蓋爾·馬羅維茨]
有些幸運兒能這樣回來。
他已經算很幸運了。

scripts.text:
[Guile Marovitz]
There's no need to be sad.
But it's just regrettable.
That's all.
scripts.translation:
[蓋爾·馬羅維茨]
沒必要難過。
只是有些遺憾。
就這樣。

scripts.text:
[Sherine]
In the past, the Hunter guild was in the Payon Forest.
And I grew up in Payon.
scripts.translation:
[謝琳]
以前獵人公會設在斐揚森林。
我也是在斐揚長大的。

scripts.text:
[Sherine]
That's why I visit Payon once in a while.
....
scripts.translation:
[謝琳]
所以我偶爾會回斐揚看看。
...

scripts.text:
[Sherine]
For some reason, I felt like coming here today.
Maybe it was for this.
scripts.translation:
[謝琳]
不知為何，今天我特別想來這裡。
也許就是為了這件事。

scripts.text:
[Sherine]
My silly sister.
... As a matter of fact, she cannot sew well.
scripts.translation:
[謝琳]
我那傻妹妹...
其實她根本不擅長縫紉。

scripts.text:
[Sherine]
She can barely sew on a button.
.......
scripts.translation:
[謝琳]
她連一顆釦子都縫不好。
...

scripts.text:
[Sherine]
One day, she asked me.
Would it be better for me to act more like a girl?
scripts.translation:
[謝琳]
有一天，她問我：
“我是不是應該更像個女孩子？”

scripts.text:
[Sherine]
Maybe I can just sew on a single button?
scripts.translation:
[謝琳]
“也許我至少能學會縫顆釦子？”

scripts.text:
[Sherine]
So I gave her this sewing box.
I don't know who she was thinking about when she took this.
scripts.translation:
[謝琳]
所以我把這個針線盒給了她。
不知道她拿著它時，心裡想的是誰。

scripts.text:
[Sherine]
.........
The spare button is missing.
... Would she have sewn it on well?
scripts.translation:
[謝琳]
...
備用釦子不見了。
...她縫上去了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Sherine]
I expected this, but I never imagined this thing would come back.
... Since it was her choice ... I must accept this ... But ...
scripts.translation:
[謝琳]
我早有預感，但沒想到它會以這種方式回來。
...既然是她自己的選擇...我必須接受...可是...

scripts.text:
Sherine is holding back her tears.
Leave her alone.
scripts.translation:
謝琳強忍著淚水。
請讓她一個人待一會兒。

scripts.text:
[Sherine]
... Thank ... you ...

[Sherine]
... Please leave me alone.
... I'm sorry.
scripts.translation:
[謝琳]
...請讓我一個人待著。
...對不起。
